例句: Common forms of public transportation in Taiwan include buses, trains, and the HSR. They allow people to travel from place to place conveniently.
翻譯: 臺灣常見的大眾交通運輸包含公車、火車和高鐵。它們讓人們可以便利地來往各地。

例句: Shortly after the serious car accident, the old woman with a broken leg was transported to the nearest hospital.
翻譯: 這場嚴重的車禍發生不久，這位腳骨折的老婦人就被運送至最近的醫院。

例句: The scientists hired by the government are working on a project to reduce pollution in the river.
翻譯: 這些受政府雇用的科學家正致力於一項降低河川汙染的計畫。
詞形變化: v.過去式：projected；過去分詞：projected；現在分詞：projecting | n.複數：projects
搭配詞: work on/carry out/set up a project

例句: To avoid getting stuck in traffic, Lillian took the subway instead of driving.
翻譯: 為避免被困在車陣中，Lillian搭乘了地鐵而非開車。

例句: The central air conditioning system is broken, and the whole building is extremely hot.
翻譯: 現在中央空調系統故障，整棟大樓都非常地熱。

例句: The country just introduced a new healthcare system that aims to help poor people receive better medical treatment.
翻譯: 該國家剛引進一套新的醫療保健制度，目的在幫助窮人獲得更好的醫療照護。

例句: The sailors explored the island carefully for the buried treasure marked on the map.
翻譯: 水手們小心翼翼地探索這座島嶼，為的就是標示在地圖上埋藏的寶藏。

例句: The owner began to explore the possibility of opening another restaurant since his first one was very successful.
翻譯: 這位業者開始探究開設另一間餐廳的可能性，因為第一間餐廳十分成功。

例句: It is impossible to make a full exploration of the universe.
翻譯: 想要探索全宇宙是不可能的。

例句: The Wright brothers made history when they invented the first aircraft in the early 20th century.
翻譯: 萊特兄弟在二十世紀初發明了第一架飛機，締造了歷史。

例句: The origin of life on Earth can be traced back to the ocean more than three billion years ago.
翻譯: 地球上生命的起源可追溯至三十億多年前的海洋。

例句: Although Mr. Gray’s son had been missing for more than two years, he never gave up hope of tracing his location.
翻譯: 縱使Gray先生的兒子已失蹤兩年多了，他仍不放棄找出兒子下落的希望。

例句: The smart fox broke loose from the trap and escaped without leaving a trace. It would be hard to catch it again in the big forest.
翻譯: 這隻聰明的狐狸從陷阱中掙脫沒留下一絲蹤跡。想要再從這一大片森林裡抓到牠可不容易。

例句:
Each person has his or her own unique fingerprints, and therefore
they can be used to identify criminals.
翻譯: 每個人都有其獨特的指紋，因此它們可以被用來辨識罪犯。

例句: Kyle needs to take a more serious attitude toward studying if he wishes to improve his grades.
翻譯: 這位前總統參與國慶日慶典，以展現他對國家的熱愛。

例句: The lake is located deep in the mountains, and travelers may get lost without a guide.
翻譯: 這座湖位處深山，若沒有導遊相伴，旅客可能會迷路。

例句: The staff used a flashlight to guide the audience to their seats in the dark theater.
翻譯: 工作人員用手電筒指引觀眾在黑暗的戲院裡入座。

例句: The fancy all-you-can-eat restaurant is always jammed with diners on weekends.
翻譯: 這間豪華的吃到飽餐廳在週末總是擠滿了用餐人潮。

例句: A serious car accident late at night caused a long traffic jam on the highway.
翻譯: 深夜一場嚴重的車禍造成了路上交通堵塞。

例句: Thanks to the Hsuehshan Tunnel, traveling between Taipei and Yilan has become much easier and faster.
翻譯: 幸虧有雪山隧道，往返臺北和宜蘭已變得容易和快速許多。

例句: The tap needs to be repaired. It keeps dripping.
翻譯: 這水龍頭需要修理。它一直在滴水。

例句: William collected the drips of the strange liquid in the test tube to find out what it really was.
翻譯: 從試管中收集了幾滴奇怪的液體來查明它到底是什麼。

例句: Some student groups proposed lowering the voting age from twenty to eighteen to allow more young people to vote.
翻譯: 有些學生團體提議將投票年齡從二十歲降低至十八歲來讓更多年輕人投票。

例句: The government accepted a proposal to build a sports center, so the villagers could have a place to exercise.
翻譯: 政府接受了一項興建運動中心的提案，來讓村民們有地方可以運動。

例句: We’re running out of fuel, but the nearest gas station is twenty miles away.
翻譯: 我們的燃料快用盡了，但最近的加油站還有20英里遠。

例句: The new department store is under construction, and it is scheduled to be completed by next September.
翻譯: 這家新的百貨公司正在建造中，預計於明年九月完工。

例句: Since Northern Europe is rich in wood resources, many buildings there are constructed of wood rather than bricks.
翻譯: 由於北歐富含木材資源，在那裡許多建築物都是由木頭建造而非磚瓦。
詞形變化: v.過去式：constructed；過去分詞：constructed；現在分詞：constructing | n.複數：constructs

例句: I accepted Cynthia’s offer to pay for my movie ticket, and I treated her to a tub of popcorn in return.
翻譯: 我接受了Cynthia替我付電影票錢的提議，並請她一桶爆米花作為回報。

例句: It is acceptable for students in this school to wear makeup and choose their hairstyles.
翻譯: 在這所學校，學生化妝和自由選擇髮型是可被接受的。
詞形變化: adj.比較級：more acceptable；最高級：most acceptable
搭配詞: be acceptable (for someone) to do something

例句: As soon as the traffic light turned green, the impatient driver sounded his horn to get the car ahead to move.
翻譯: 當紅綠燈一變成綠燈，那位不耐煩的駕駛便按喇叭叫前方的車子移動。

例句: The workers are replacing the tracks of the railroad which were badly damaged during the earthquake.
翻譯: 工人們正在更換在地震期間鐵路上嚴重受損的軌道。

例句: The hunter followed the deer through a track in the forest and waited for a chance to shoot it down.
翻譯: 這名獵人跟隨著鹿越過一條森林小徑，並等待機會射殺牠。

例句: An escaped prisoner who had been on the run for two months was finally tracked down by the police.
翻譯: 一名已潛逃兩個月的犯人終於受警方追緝到案。

例句: The city council hopes to revive the old market by adding new shops and events.
翻譯: 市議會希望透過增加新商店和活動來振興舊市場。
詞形變化: v.過去式：revived；過去分詞：revived；現在分詞：reviving

例句: Many tourists dream of visiting New York City to see Times Square and the Statue of Liberty.
翻譯: 許多遊客夢想造訪紐約市，去看看時代廣場和自由女神像。

例句: Cincinnati is a major city in Ohio, known for its beautiful riverfront and historic architecture.
翻譯: 辛辛那提是俄亥俄州的一個主要城市，以其美麗的河濱和歷史建築而聞名。

例句: As a proud Cincinnatian, she enjoys cheering for the local baseball team every season.
翻譯: 作為一個驕傲的辛辛那提人，她每個賽季都喜歡為當地棒球隊加油。

例句: Students have the option to choose between several elective courses next semester.
翻譯: 學生下學期有幾門選修課可以選擇。

例句: It's best to avoid driving through the city center during rush hour to save time.
翻譯: 為了節省時間，最好避開在交通尖峰時間開車經過市中心。

例句: Many commuters prefer taking the train instead of driving to work to avoid traffic jams.
翻譯: 許多通勤者喜歡搭火車而不是開車上班，以避免塞車。

例句: He has to commute for over an hour every day to get to his office in the city.
翻譯: 他每天必須通勤一個多小時才能到達市區的辦公室。
詞形變化: v.過去式：commuted；過去分詞：commuted；現在分詞：commuting | n.複數：commutes

例句: The new streetcar line makes it much easier for people to travel around the downtown area.
翻譯: 新的路面電車線讓大家在市區周圍旅行更加方便。

例句: In the quiet room, the only sound she could hear was the soft tick of the old grandfather clock.
翻譯: 在安靜的房間裡，她唯一能聽到的聲音是那座老爺鐘輕柔的滴答聲。

中譯: (尤指在公共場所的牆上等處的) 塗鴉，圖畫
例句: Some people consider graffiti a form of art, while others see it as vandalism on public property.
翻譯: 有些人認為塗鴉是一種藝術形式，而另一些人則將其視為對公共財產的破壞。

例句: Due to inflation, the price of everyday goods has increased significantly over the past year.
翻譯: 由於通貨膨脹，日常用品的價格在過去一年中顯著上漲。

例句: Choosing the right mode of transportation, like a bike or bus, can save you time and money.
翻譯: 選擇正確的交通方式，例如自行車或公車，可以為你節省時間和金錢。

例句: The new stadium turned out to be a white elephant, as it was rarely used after its grand opening.
翻譯: 新體育場結果變成了一個華而不實的物品，因為它在盛大開幕後很少被使用。

例句: Emma’ childhood bedroom seems frozen in time; her parents have kept it the same since she went to college twenty years ago.
翻譯: Emma的房間似乎凝藏於時光中；她的父母自她二十年前去讀大學後就一直將它保持原樣。

例句: Life is a journey filled with ups and downs, but every challenge makes us stronger.
翻譯: 生命是趟充滿起落的旅程，但每個挑戰都讓我們更為堅強。

例句: Because the power was out all night, we couldn’t fall asleep during the boiling hot summer night.
翻譯: 因為整晚停電，我們在這炎熱的夏天晚上根本無法入睡。

例句: Rumor has it that the unused subway station will be turned into a museum.
翻譯: 有傳言稱這閒置的地鐵站將要改建成博物館。

例句: Mr. and Mrs. Wu have been looking for a bigger apartment since their third child was born.
翻譯: 自從吳先生和吳太太的第三個孩子出生，他們就一直努力在尋找一間更大的公寓。

例句: Doctor Wang expects her son to follow in her footsteps. However, he is determined to be a singer.
翻譯: 王醫生期盼她的兒子能效法她也成為一位醫生。然而，他下定決心成為一名歌手。

例句: My father’s company pulled the plug on providing free coffee and snacks for its employees because of budget cuts.
翻譯: 我父親的公司終止提供員工免費的咖啡和點心，因為要節省預算。

例句: In the last two minutes before the game came to an end, Alex scored the winning goal, and our school team won the championship.
翻譯: 在比賽結束前的最後兩分鐘，Alex贏得致勝的一分，我們的校隊也贏得了冠軍。

例句: The students are in conflict with the teachers because they have different opinions on the new school rule.
翻譯: 這群學生和老師們發生衝突，因為他們對新校規意見相左。

例句: The company is facing a labor conflict with its employees over wages and benefits.
翻譯: 該公司正面臨與員工之間關於薪資和福利的勞資分歧。

例句: Ryan’s report about the killer conflicted with mine. His report said the killer was a grown man, but mine said the killer was a teenager.
翻譯: Ryan關於這位兇手的報告與我的相抵觸。他的報告說到這位兇手是一位成年人，但我的報告談到他是一名青少年。

例句: I can never win an argument with Alice about art because she knows more about it than I do.
翻譯: 我永遠無法在關於藝術的爭論中贏過Alice，因為她對藝術的了解比我多。

例句: Linda and her husband never argue about money, so they have a happy marriage.
翻譯: Linda和她的丈夫從不為錢爭吵，所以他們婚姻幸福美滿。
詞形變化: v.過去式：argued；過去分詞：argued；現在分詞：arguing

例句: After Peter asked his parents for their opinions, he made the decision to move out.
翻譯: 在Peter徵求父母的意見後，他決定要搬出去。

例句: There is a heated debate about the best age to start learning a second language.
翻譯: 關於開始學習第二語言的最佳年齡存在激烈的辯論。

例句: The teachers have been debating whether students should wear uniforms to school.
翻譯: 老師們不斷地在討論學生是否應該穿著制服上學。

例句: I believe that Darren can handle the problem very well. Just let him take care of it.
翻譯: 我相信Darren能夠好好地處理這個問題。就讓他來處理吧。

例句: Sabrina turned the handle and entered her brother’s room without knocking first, so he got mad at her.
翻譯: Sabrina沒有先敲門就轉動門把進入她哥哥的房間，所以他對她很生氣。

例句: After two hours of discussion, the students still have disagreements about the topic of their science project.
翻譯: 經過兩個小時的討論，學生們仍然對他們科學專題的主題意見不合。

例句: Jackie was always rude to people who disagreed with her, so she made a lot of enemies.
翻譯: Jackie總是對那些與她意見不合的人很無理，所以她樹立了很多敵人。

例句: Politics is a sensitive issue that should be avoided when you talk to someone for the first time.
翻譯: 政治是一個敏感的話題，第一次與人交談時應避免。
字尾: -ive (having the quality of; tending to (具有…特質的；傾向於…))

例句: Wendy is sensitive to other people’s feelings and often helps them with their problems.
翻譯: Wendy對他人的感受很敏感，並常常幫助他們解決問題。
字尾: -ive (having the quality of; tending to (具有…特質的；傾向於…))

例句: Jeff remained in the car while his girlfriend went to get some food at the convenience store.
翻譯: Jeff留在車裡，而他的女朋友到便利商店添購一些食物。

例句: The young couple held hands as they walked along the beach.
翻譯: 這對年輕夫妻手牽手沿著海灘散步。

例句: When I was walking on the street, a reporter asked me a couple of questions about recent social events.
翻譯: 我走在街上時，一位記者問了我一些關於近期社會事件的問題。

例句: Charlie attempted to work out the answer to this difficult math problem all by himself.
翻譯: Charlie試圖獨自找出這道數學難題的解答。

例句: Calvin made several attempts to make friends at school but never succeeded.
翻譯: Calvin曾多次嘗試在學校交新朋友，但從未成功。

例句: The salesperson tried to convince the customers of the safety of his company’s products.
翻譯: 這位銷售人員試圖說服顧客他所屬公司產品的安全性。

例句: The lioness defended her cubs against a pack of wild dogs.
翻譯: 母獅捍衛她的幼崽免於一群野狗的攻擊。

例句: The new mayor had a different position on the healthcare system in the city and decided to make some changes to it.
翻譯: 新市長對該市的醫療保健制度持不同的立場，並決定對其進行一些改變。

例句: The dog jumped onto the sofa and lay down in a comfortable position.
翻譯: 狗狗跳到沙發上並以舒適的姿勢趴下。

例句: The politician tried to put a positive spin on his policy, yet few people actually believed in him.
翻譯: 這位政治人物試圖以正面的方向詮釋他的政策，但很少人真的買單。
搭配詞: put a positive/negative spin on something

例句: The car went into a spin after it was hit by a truck.
翻譯: 這輛車被卡車擦撞後開始打轉。

例句: The dancer spun around beautifully on the stage.
翻譯: 舞者在舞臺上優美地旋轉。

例句: After the civil war, the president worked hard to heal the country.
翻譯: 內戰結束後，該總統努力讓這國家好轉起來。
詞形變化: v.過去式：healed；過去分詞：healed；現在分詞：healing

例句: Certain foods, such as vegetables, fruit, and milk, are helpful in healing cuts and wounds.
翻譯: 某些食物，如蔬菜、水果和牛奶，有助於治癒割傷和傷口。
詞形變化: v.過去式：healed；過去分詞：healed；現在分詞：healing

例句: There was a growing division within the office. Jane believed the project should be conducted one way, while her co-worker thought it should be done another way.
翻譯: 辦公室內的分歧不斷增長。Jane相信這項計畫應該以一種方式執行，而她同事認為應該以另一種方式執行。

例句: Experts worry that a war will break out between the two countries because of their growing political divide.
翻譯: 專家擔憂兩國可能會因他們日益擴大的政治分歧將來爆發戰爭。

例句: The researchers divided the participants into different age groups.
翻譯: 研究人員將參與者以不同年齡層劃分。

例句: The main character in the story is described as being tall and handsome.
翻譯: 這則故事的主角被描寫得高挑又英俊。

例句: Julie gave the police a detailed description of the robber so that they could find him more easily.
翻譯: Julie向警方提供了搶匪的詳細描述，以便他們更容易地找到他。

例句: Because of the typhoon, the ball game is delayed until next week.
翻譯: 由於颱風的關係，球賽延後到下週舉行。

例句: Someone has been hurt in the car crash. We have to call an ambulance without delay!
翻譯: 有人在車禍中受傷了。我們必須立刻叫救護車！

例句: Don’t make any judgments before you find more information about this matter.
翻譯: 在找到更多關於此事的資訊前，不要做出任何評價。

例句: Sometimes the quality of a book cannot be judged from its sales.
翻譯: 有時一本書的品質不能從它的銷量來判斷。

例句: There is still a lot of uncertainty about the exact date of the final exam next month.
翻譯: 下個月期末考的確切日期仍然存在很多不確定性。

例句: The European Union promotes economic cooperation and peace among its member countries.
翻譯: 歐洲聯盟促進其成員國之間的經濟合作與和平。

例句: The workers decided to form a union to protect their rights and improve working conditions.
翻譯: 工人們決定組成一個工會來保護他們的權利並改善工作條件。

例句: Brexit was a significant event that led to the United Kingdom leaving the European Union in 2020.
翻譯: 英國脫歐是一個重大事件，導致英國於2020年脫離歐洲聯盟。

例句: Many people enjoy watching British TV shows and movies because of their unique humor and storytelling.
翻譯: 許多人喜歡看英國電視節目和電影，因為它們獨特的幽默感和敘事方式。

例句: A breakdown in communication between the two teams caused a delay in completing the project.
翻譯: 兩個團隊之間的溝通中斷導致專案完成延遲。

例句: Practicing mindfulness can help students reduce stress and improve focus during exams.
翻譯: 練習正念認知可以幫助學生在考試期間減輕壓力並提高專注力。

例句: The two friends decided to sit down and resolve their misunderstanding peacefully.
翻譯: 這兩位朋友決定坐下來，和平地解決他們的誤會。

例句: A strong friendship is often built on mutual trust and understanding between people.
翻譯: 一段堅固的友誼通常建立在人與人之間的相互信任和理解之上。

例句: Students often thrive in a supportive learning environment where they feel comfortable asking questions.
翻譯: 學生們通常在一個支持性的學習環境中茁壯成長，在那裡他們可以自在地提問。
詞形變化: v.過去式：thrived；過去分詞：thriven；現在分詞：thriving

例句: There was a lot of tension in the classroom before the final exam results were announced.
翻譯: 在期末考成績公布之前，教室裡瀰漫著一股緊張氣氛。
詞形變化: v.過去式：tensioned；過去分詞：tensioned；現在分詞：tensioning | n.複數：tensions

例句: Growing economic inequality is tearing the country apart, yet the government still hasn’t come up with an effective solution to it.
翻譯: 日益嚴重的經濟不平等正在撕裂這個國家，然而政府仍未提出有效的解決方案。

例句: The YouTuber’s videos shed some light on life as a foreigner working and living in Taiwan.

翻譯: 她對學業的投入和優異的成績真正體現了什麼才是一個好學生。

例句: To avoid the winter blues, some people try to get more sunlight or engage in outdoor activities.
翻譯: 為了避免冬季憂鬱症，有些人會嘗試多曬太陽或參與戶外活動。

例句: Norway is famous for its beautiful fjords, stunning natural landscapes, and high quality of life.
翻譯: 挪威以其美麗的峽灣、壯麗的自然景觀和高品質的生活而聞名。

例句: During polar night in the Arctic, the sun does not rise above the horizon for several weeks or months.
翻譯: 在北極的極夜期間，太陽在數週或數月內不會升到地平線以上。

例句: The hikers had to endure extreme cold and strong winds to reach the summit of the snowy mountain.
翻譯: 登山者必須忍受極度嚴寒和強風才能到達雪山的頂峰。
詞形變化: v.過去式：endured；過去分詞：endured；現在分詞：enduring

例句: To make the recipe for two people, you need to halve all the ingredients listed in the cookbook.
翻譯: 要製作兩人份的食譜，你需要將食譜中列出的所有食材減半。

例句: Social interaction with friends and family is important for maintaining good mental health.
翻譯: 與朋友和家人的社交互動對於維持良好的心理健康很重要。

例句: Developing a growth mindset helps students believe they can improve their abilities through effort and learning.
翻譯: 培養成長心態有助於學生相信他們可以透過努力和學習來提升自己的能力。

例句: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential for healthy physical growth during teenage years.
翻譯: 規律運動和均衡飲食對於青少年時期的健康身體成長至關重要。

例句: Don't let one small setback discourage you; learn from it and keep working towards your goals.
翻譯: 不要讓一個小小的挫折讓你氣餒；從中學習並繼續努力實現你的目標。

例句: Although Olivia never got an offer from a modeling company, she stood tall and kept following her dreams.
翻譯: 儘管Olivia從未獲得模特兒公司錄用，她仍充滿自信並持續追逐她的夢想。

例句: Benjamin tried to play in the tennis match with an injured wrist, but the pain forced him to give up.
翻譯: Benjamin試著帶著手腕的傷出場網球比賽，但疼痛迫使他放棄。

例句: After overcoming difficulty, Hank will tune in to a positive attitude to face another challenge.
翻譯: 在克服困難後，Hank會調整自己抱持積極的態度，以面對下一個挑戰。

english_word: every cloud has a silver lining
例句: Yvonne broke both legs in a car accident and had to stay in hospital. However, every cloud has a silver lining—she discovered her talent for art during her time off school.
翻譯: Yvonne在一場車禍中弄斷了雙腿，必須待在醫院治療。然而，黑暗中總有一絲光明，她在不上學的這段期間發覺了自己的美術天賦。

例句: I trust Anna because she always tells the truth.
翻譯: 我信任Anna，因為她總是說實話。

例句: From the way Henry avoided eye contact, I knew that he was not being completely truthful with me.
翻譯: 從Henry避開眼神接觸的樣子來看，我知道他對我並不完全誠實。
詞形變化: adj.比較級：more truthful；最高級：most truthful

例句: The cookies look delicious, but they actually taste very strange.
翻譯: 這些餅乾看起來很好吃，但實際上嚐起來很奇怪。

例句: Betty wasn’t sure of her father’s actual shoe size, so she couldn’t buy a pair of shoes for him.
翻譯: Betty不確定她父親確切的鞋子尺碼，所以她沒辦法買鞋子給他。

例句: Troy spotted a strange man entering his neighbor’s house through the window.
翻譯: Troy發現一名陌生男子從窗戶進入他鄰居家。

例句: The balcony at Jeff’s house is a great spot for a tea party.
翻譯: Jeff家的陽臺是一個辦茶會的好地方。

例句: During their family meeting, the Wangs came to the conclusion that they would spend their Chinese New Year holiday abroad this year.
翻譯: 在家庭會議中，王家最後決定今年要到國外過中國新年。

例句: Olivia concluded from her research that most of her classmates were not aware of the problem of fake news.
翻譯: Olivia從她的研究中得出結論，她的大多數同學都沒有意識到假新聞的問題。

例句: The speech appealed to people’s sense of justice and encouraged them to stand up against the unfair treatment of black people.
翻譯: 這場演講喚起了人們的正義感，鼓勵他們挺身而出反對黑人所受的不公平待遇。

例句: The villagers appealed to the government for help after their homes had been seriously damaged by the typhoon.
翻譯: 因颱風造成家園嚴重受損，村民懇求政府施以援手。

例句: Mr. and Mrs. Chen made an urgent appeal for more information to help them find their missing daughter.
翻譯: 陳姓夫婦迫切懇求提供更多資訊，以幫助他們找到失蹤的女兒。

例句: The majority of my classmates are from the same city, while only two of them are from other cities.
翻譯: 我大多數的同學都來自同一個城市，只有兩個同學來自其他城市。

例句: One of the major social problems we need to face is the gap between the rich and the poor.
翻譯: 其中一個我們需要面對的重大社會問題是貧富差距。

例句: The man who had committed many crimes was finally caught by the police.
翻譯: 犯下眾多罪嫌的男子終於遭警方抓獲。

例句: George believed his excellent performance at work would guarantee him a pay raise.
翻譯: George相信他在工作上出色的表現將保證他能加薪。

例句: Ivy gave her teacher a guarantee that she would never cheat on any exam again.
翻譯: Ivy向她的老師保證她再也不會在任何考試中作弊。

例句: Our school basketball team will face their strongest opponent ever in the next game, so they are all practicing harder than before.
翻譯: 我們的籃球校隊將在下一場比賽迎戰有史以來最強的對手，所以他們都比以前更加努力地訓練。

例句: Many players are excited to hear that there will be a new version of this popular game.
翻譯: 許多玩家聽到這款熱門遊戲將有新版本時都很興奮。

例句: The author made a reference to the woman he deeply loved at the end of the story.
翻譯: 這位作者在故事的結尾提到了他深愛的女人。
詞形變化: v.過去式：referenced；過去分詞：referenced；現在分詞：referencing | n.複數：references

例句: The prize winner referred to her family several times in her acceptance speech.
翻譯: 該名得獎者在得獎感言中多次提及她的家人。

例句: Tracy gave a detailed account of the accident to help the police catch the suspect.
翻譯: Tracy詳細講述了事故經過，幫助警方抓獲嫌疑犯。

例句: Mike opened a bank account in France because he was about to go study there.
翻譯: 因為Mike即將到法國唸書，所以他在那裡開設了一個銀行帳戶。

例句: Matilda claims that her article focuses on workers’ rights, but it shifts the emphasis toward environmental problems after the first paragraph.
翻譯: Matilda聲稱她的文章著重於勞工權利，但在第一段之後，這篇文章就將重點轉向了環境問題。

例句: Ryan shifted uncomfortably on the hotel bed because it was too small for him.
翻譯: Ryan在飯店床上不舒服地變換姿勢，因為床對他來說太小了。

例句: Professor Kingsley has spent over 50 years studying the behavior of foxes and is regarded as an authority on this topic.
翻譯: Kingsley教授花了超過五十年的時間研究狐狸的行為，且被公認為該領域的權威。

例句:
Although the manager has the authority to make decisions herself,
she always asks her team members for their thoughts.
翻譯: 雖然這位經理有權自行決定，但她總會詢問組內成員的想法。

例句: The latest economic news was highly relevant to our company, so we spent a lot of time discussing it in today’s meeting.
翻譯: 最新的財經新聞與我們公司是高度相關的，因此我們在今天的會議中花了很多時間討論。

中譯: (用例子或圖片等) 闡述，說明
例句: The teacher gave several examples to illustrate the concept of democracy.
翻譯: 老師舉了幾個例子來說明民主的概念。

例句: With its full-color illustrations, this storybook is fun and easy to read.
翻譯: 附有全彩插圖，這本故事書既有趣又易於閱讀。

例句: Thanks to modern technology, we can enjoy a convenient and comfortable life.
翻譯: 歸功於現代科技，我們得以享受方便、舒適的生活。

例句: The Internet has brought a lot of technological advances to modern society.
翻譯: 網路已為現代社會帶來許多科技進步。

例句: Perry is an expert in fashion. I always ask for his advice to keep up with the latest styles.
翻譯: Perry是一位時尚專家。我總是徵求他的建議以跟上最新的潮流。

例句: A typhoon is coming. Therefore, we have to cancel the outdoor party.
翻譯: 颱風即將來臨。因此，我們必須取消戶外派對。

例句: Will thinks that Mrs. Jones is the killer, but he doesn’t have any proof to confirm his suspicion.
翻譯: Will認為Jones太太是兇手，但他沒有任何證據能證實他的猜疑。
詞形變化: v.過去式：proofed；過去分詞：proofed；現在分詞：proofing | n.複數：proofs

例句: Henry moved out to prove his ability to live on his own to his parents.
翻譯: Henry搬出家中以向他的父母證明他有能力獨立生活。
詞形變化: v.過去式：proved；過去分詞：proven；現在分詞：proving

例句: A traffic accident occurred when Jeff was on his way to school, so he was late for class.
翻譯: Jeff上學的路上發生了交通事故，所以他上課遲到了。

例句: The food critic tried his best to give an accurate description of every dish in the MICHELIN-starred restaurant.
翻譯: 這位美食評論家盡力對該米其林餐廳的每一道菜進行準確的描述。

例句: Kane has scored many goals thanks to his great kicking accuracy.
翻譯: Kane憑藉他出色的踢球精準度得到了很多分。

例句: Don't let advertisements mislead you into buying things you don't really need.
翻譯: 不要讓廣告誤導你購買你並不需要的東西。
詞形變化: v.過去式：misled；過去分詞：misled；現在分詞：misleading

例句: His argument contained a logical fallacy, which made his conclusion unreliable.
翻譯: 他的論點包含一個邏輯謬誤，這使得他的結論不可靠。

例句: The parking ticket was invalid because the time stamp on it was wrong.
翻譯: 這張停車罰單是無效的，因為上面的時間戳記是錯的。

例句: You need to provide valid reasons for your absence from school.
翻譯: 你需要為你缺席學校提供合理的理由。

例句: The teacher questioned the validity of the student's excuse for not doing his homework.
翻譯: 老師質疑學生不做功課的藉口的合理性。

例句: Many people are jumping on the bandwagon of using AI tools for their studies.
翻譯: 許多人正趕搭使用人工智慧工具學習的潮流。

例句: I have a tendency to procrastinate when I have a lot of assignments to finish.
翻譯: 當我有很多作業要完成時，我傾向於拖延。

例句: Students tend to perform better when they get enough sleep before important exams.
翻譯: 學生在重要考試前如果獲得充足睡眠，往往表現會更好。
詞形變化: v.過去式：tended；過去分詞：tended；現在分詞：tending

中譯: (用以駁倒或引起爭論的) 假想論點，假想主張
例句: He created a straw man argument to easily attack his opponent's position in the debate.
翻譯: 他創造了一個稻草人論點，以便在辯論中輕易攻擊對手的立場。

例句: Some news reports can distort the truth to make a story sound more dramatic.
翻譯: 有些新聞報導可能會扭曲事實，讓故事聽起來更戲劇化。

例句: The doctor's expertise in treating rare diseases saved many lives in the hospital.
翻譯: 這位醫生治療罕見疾病的專業知識在醫院裡拯救了許多生命。

例句: The internet has become an ever-present part of our daily lives and studies.
翻譯: 網路已成為我們日常生活和學習中始終存在的一部分。

例句: He continued to assert his innocence, even when faced with strong evidence against him.
翻譯: 即使面對強烈證據，他仍堅稱自己無罪。

例句: Cathy takes a bus instead of driving a car to work because it’s difficult to find a parking space near her company
翻譯: Cathy搭公車而不是開車去上班，因為在她公司附近很難找到停車位。

例句: When it comes to making big decisions in our family, my mother’s opinions carry more weight than my father’s.
翻譯: 我們家在做出重大決定時，我母親的意見比我父親的意見更有分量。

例句: Thank you for sharing the information about the new restaurant with me. I’ll keep it on my radar for my next visit to the city.
翻譯: 感謝你與我分享新餐廳的資訊。我會在下次造訪這座城市時特別留意。

中譯: 避開 (令人不快或危險的人事物)
例句: Teresa always warns her students to keep clear of drugs and violence.
翻譯: Teresa總是告誡她的學生遠離毒品和暴力。

例句: Young people these days usually send messages rather than make phone calls when they need to contact someone.
翻譯: 現在的年輕人在需要聯繫他人時通常會發送訊息而不是打電話。

例句: When Dave took his little kid outside, he was always on guard against any possible danger.
翻譯: Dave在帶他的小孩出門時，他總會警惕任何可能的危險。

例句: With terrible headaches and a serious sore back, the old woman has suffered from poor health for years.
翻譯: 因患有嚴重的頭痛和背痛，這位老婦人已經受健康狀況不佳所苦多年。

例句: While the police officer was defending herself against the attackers, she fell down stairs and broke several bones.
翻譯: 在這名警察防衛襲擊者時，她從樓梯上摔下來並摔斷了幾根骨頭。
詞形變化: v.過去式：boned；過去分詞：boned；現在分詞：boning | n.複數：bones

例句: It can mean a lot even if you make a small donation to help others.
翻譯: 即使你捐一小筆捐獻來幫助他人也可能意義重大。

例句: After the earthquake hit Japan, Taiwanese people donated a lot of money and goods to charity organizations in Japan to help those in need.
翻譯: 在日本發生地震後，臺灣民眾向日本的慈善機構捐贈了大量的款項和物資以幫助有需要的人。
詞形變化: v.過去式：donated；過去分詞：donated；現在分詞：donating

例句: The patient is signing up to be a donor because she wants to save lives after she is gone.
翻譯: 這名患者報名成為器官捐贈者，因為她想在離世後拯救生命。

例句: The man had strong feelings of guilt about leaving his family deep in debt.
翻譯: 該男子對於讓家人負債累累感到強烈的罪惡感。

例句: Felix felt guilty about shouting at his sister, so he told her that he was sorry the next morning.
翻譯: Felix為他對妹妹大吼大叫感到內疚，所以他隔天早上跟她道歉。

例句: This mature boy never expresses his worries to his parents because he doesn’t want to burden them with any of his problems.
翻譯: 這位成熟的小男孩從不向他的父母表達擔憂，因為他不想讓他的任何問題成為他們的負擔。

例句: To share the burden of his poor family, Patrick decided to drop out of school and find a job.
翻譯: 為了分擔他貧困家庭的負擔，Patrick決定輟學去找工作。

例句: Smoking increases the risk of getting heart and lung diseases.
翻譯: 吸菸會增加心肺疾病的風險。

例句: Nothing more can be done once a person’s kidneys start failing so quickly.
翻譯: 一旦人的腎臟開始急速衰竭，就無計可施了。

例句: A group of doctors spent hours performing life-saving surgery on the injured man.
翻譯: 一組醫生花了幾個小時的時間對這名受傷男子進行挽救生命的手術。

例句: Jeremy’s wallet was stolen the other day. Strangely, it appeared on his desk the following morning.
翻譯: 前幾天，Jeremy的錢包被偷了。奇怪的是，它隔天早晨竟出現在他桌上。

例句: Thousands of followers of the football team got together to celebrate the team’s victory.
翻譯: 該足球隊數以千計的球迷們齊聚一堂，歡慶球隊的勝利。

例句: The event is scheduled to be held next Friday. Make sure to dress up and be there on time.
翻譯: 這項活動排定於下週五舉行。請務必盛裝打扮並準時抵達。

例句: It’s the parents’ obligation to raise their children and keep them safe.
翻譯: 撫養小孩並確保他們安全是父母親的責任。

例句: Through our sense organs, such as eyes, noses, and tongues, we are able to see, smell, and taste.
翻譯: 透過我們的感官，如眼睛、鼻子和舌頭，我們能夠觀看、嗅聞和品嚐。

例句: Those street kids are willing to do whatever it takes to just stay alive, even if that means they have to break the law.
翻譯: 那些流浪街頭的孩子願意不惜一切代價活下去，即使那意味他們得違法。

例句: I have to admit that I disagree with your idea. I said nothing about it before just because I didn’t want to break your heart.
翻譯: 我得承認我不認同你的想法。我之前沒說什麼只是因為不想傷你的心。

例句: Jessica confessed to her boyfriend that she had not been listening to him complaining about his work.
翻譯: Jessica向男友坦承，她沒有認真在聽他抱怨工作的事。

例句: Nicholas confessed that he had something to do with the robbery after he was questioned by the police for hours.
翻譯: Nicholas在受警方拷問數小時後，招認自己與這起搶劫案有關。

例句: People who believe that they are the master of their own fate will never give up easily.
翻譯: 相信自己是自身命運主宰者的人永遠不會輕易放棄。

例句: The magician impressed everyone with various wonderful tricks. She really is a master of magic.
翻譯: 這位魔術師用各式精彩的戲法讓大家印象深刻。她真的是一位魔術大師。

例句: The priest managed to master the local language so that he could introduce his religion to the local people.
翻譯: 該牧師設法精通當地語言，以便向當地人介紹他的宗教。

例句: A serious traffic accident on the highway took the lives of many passengers on the bus.
翻譯: 公路上發生的一起嚴重交通事故奪走了那臺公車上多名乘客的性命。

中譯: 消化，處理 (艱難、悲傷的事情)
例句: The politician hasn’t said anything publicly yet since he is still processing the loss of the election.
翻譯: 這位政治人物尚未公開發表任何言論，因為他還在消化選舉的挫敗。

例句: The farmer processed the freshly harvested wheat into flour to sell to local bakeries.
翻譯: 農民將新鮮收穫的小麥加工成麵粉，出售給當地的烘焙坊。

例句: These pictures clearly show the readers the process of making grapes into wine.
翻譯: 這些圖片清楚地向讀者展示了葡萄釀造成葡萄酒的過程。

例句: The fact that Joseph refused to cheat with his classmates shows that he has morals.
翻譯: Joseph拒絕與同學一同作弊這件事表現出他品行端正。

例句: This private school aims to teach students about the highest moral standards.
翻譯: 這所私立學校旨在教導學生最高的道德標準。

例句: A friend's younger brother was diagnosed with leukemia last year and is now receiving treatment.
翻譯: 我朋友的弟弟去年被診斷出患有白血病，目前正在接受治療。

例句: Bone marrow transplants are often used to treat certain blood cancers like leukemia.
翻譯: 骨髓移植常被用於治療某些血癌，例如白血病。

例句: My parents are very supportive of my decision to study abroad next year.
翻譯: 我的父母非常支持我明年出國留學的決定。

例句: The patient is waiting for a kidney transplant that could save his life.
翻譯: 這位病人正在等待一次腎臟移植，這可能會挽救他的生命。

例句: Doctors successfully managed to transplant the donor's heart into the patient.
翻譯: 醫生們成功地將捐贈者的心臟移植到病人體內。

例句: A small stone thrown into the pond created a ripple that spread across the water.
翻譯: 一顆小石頭投入池塘，產生了一道漣漪，擴散開來。

例句: The firefighter was hailed as a savior after rescuing the child from the burning building.
翻譯: 這位消防員在從燃燒的建築中救出孩子後，被譽為救星。

例句: He began to fumble for his keys in his pocket, realizing he might be late for class.
翻譯: 他開始在口袋裡摸索鑰匙，意識到自己可能上課要遲到了。

例句: The company has strict ethics that guide how employees should behave towards customers and colleagues.
翻譯: 這家公司有嚴格的道德規範，指導員工應如何對待客戶和同事。

例句: A strong work ethic is essential for students who want to succeed in their studies and future careers.
翻譯: 對於想在學業和未來事業上取得成功的學生來說，強烈的職業道德是必不可少的。

例句: Patt always sees things in black and white. He believes things can only be either right or wrong.
翻譯: Patt總是以非黑即白的方式看待事物。他相信事情只能是對或是錯。

例句: Julia usually cooks for herself, but she also eats out every now and then to enjoy different kinds of food.
翻譯: Julia通常都自己做飯，但她偶爾也會外出用餐，以品嚐不同種類的食物。

例句: The city mayor stood by what he said earlier and refused to apologize.
翻譯: 這位市長堅持他先前的發言，並拒絕道歉。

例句: The audience were all in tears when the main character of the movie finally made her peace with her father after their fight years ago.
翻譯: 在電影主角終於和她父親於時隔多年的爭吵後和解時，觀眾全都熱淚盈眶。

例句: Sharon experienced a loss of speech because of brain damage. She had difficulty communicating with others.
翻譯: Sharon因為大腦受傷失去了說話能力。她和別人在溝通上有困難。

例句: Jack gave a really touching speech at his son’s wedding.
翻譯: Jack在他兒子的婚禮上發表了一段感人肺腑的演說。

例句: Lack of hard work is a major barrier to success.
翻譯: 缺乏努力是通往成功的一大障礙。

例句: The police put up barriers to keep the crowd from getting close to the scene of the crime.
翻譯: 警方設置了柵欄來避免人群接近犯罪現場。

例句: Jessica has good coding skills, which can help her land a great job at a technology company.
翻譯: Jessica擁有良好的編碼技能，這可以幫助她在一間科技公司找到好工作。

例句: Linda drank some water to help her swallow the pills more easily.
翻譯: Linda喝了一些水讓她更容易吞嚥那些藥丸。

例句: Every student in our class voted for Evelyn to be the class leader because of her warm and pleasant personality.
翻譯: 我們班上每個同學都投Evelyn當班長，因為她的個性溫順又友好。

例句: Air, water, and food are essential for human beings. No one can live without them.
翻譯: 空氣、水和食物對人類是不可或缺的。沒有人能不靠它們活下去。

中譯: 必需品，不可或缺的東西
例句: The cheap hostel provides its guests with only a few essentials, such as a bed and a bathroom. Things like televisions or microwave ovens are not included.
翻譯: 這間便宜的旅館只提供客人一些必需品，像是一張床和一間浴室。其他像是電視或是微波爐都不包含在內。

例句: Tina lay on her back with her mouth wide open to let the dentist examine her teeth.
翻譯: Tina往後躺並張大她的嘴巴，讓牙醫檢查她的牙齒。

例句: The doctor gave Iris a detailed examination to see what was wrong with her.
翻譯: 醫生對Iris做了仔細的檢查來看看她的身體有什麼問題。

例句: Lucy is studying hard for the entrance examination next January so that she can enter her dream college.
翻譯: Lucy正在為明年1月的入學考試認真唸書，這樣她才能進入自己夢想的大學。

例句: The teacher equipped his students with the necessary knowledge before they started working on their science project.
翻譯: 在學生開始著手他們的科學專題前，老師使他們對必要的知識有所準備。

例句: To ensure that experiments can be successfully carried out, the laboratory is equipped with the most advanced computers and instruments.
翻譯: 為了確保實驗能成功地進行，實驗室配備最先進的電腦和儀器。

例句: Every piece of equipment in this office, such as the copier and printer, is for everyone to share.
翻譯: 這間辦公室的每樣設備，像是影印機和印表機，都是大家共享的。

例句: I was sympathetic toward Jill when she said she had a bad headache because I suffered from the same pain myself.
翻譯: Jill說她頭很痛時我很同情她，因為我自己也曾遭受過一樣的痛苦。

例句: You can put your trust in Anita. She always keeps her word.
翻譯: 你可以信任Anita。她總是說到做到。

例句: I trust Joseph to complete this project, so I have decided to choose him as the leader of the team.
翻譯: 我相信Joseph可以完成這項計畫，所以我決定選他擔任這個團隊的領導人。

例句: The doctor told the patient that if he took the medicine regularly and got enough rest, he would feel better soon.
翻譯: 醫生告訴病人，如果他按時吃藥並好好休息，他很快就會好起來。

例句: Ms. Tyler is a popular teacher because she is always patient with her students.
翻譯: Tyler小姐是一位受歡迎的老師，因為她總是對自己的學生很有耐心。

例句: Albert has little patience with Lydia because she seldom gets her job done in time.
翻譯: Albert對Lydia沒有耐心，因為她很少按時把自己的工作做完。

例句: Tracy has a keen eye for fashion. Almost every piece of clothing in her store sells very well.
翻譯: Tracy對時尚很敏銳。在她店裡幾乎每件衣服都賣得很好。

例句: The children were keen to open their presents on Christmas Day.
翻譯: 小朋友們很渴望在聖誕節拆他們的禮物。

例句: There will be a written test and an interview to assess the interviewees’ ability to do this job.
翻譯: 為了評估面試者是否有能力做這份工作，將會有一場筆試和面試。

例句: The company made an environmental impact assessment before the factory was constructed.
翻譯: 該公司在建造工廠前做了一項環境影響的評估。

例句: This company was forced to lay off some of its employees because of financial concerns.
翻譯: 該公司因財政考量被迫資遣它的一些員工。

例句: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are both critical to a healthy life.
翻譯: 規律運動和均衡飲食對健康的生活都是至關重要的。

例句: Mr. Clooney was critical of my history report and asked me to rewrite it.
翻譯: Clooney先生對我的歷史報告百般挑剔，並要求我重寫。

例句: Jason is a very creative student. He often thinks of new and interesting ways to solve problems.
翻譯: Jason是位很有創意的學生。他時不時會想出新穎有趣的方法解決問題。
字尾: -ive (having the quality of; tending to (具有…特質的；傾向於…))

例句: The painter created an Instagram account to share her artwork.
翻譯: 這名畫家創了一個Instagram帳號來分享她的藝術作品。
詞形變化: v.過去式：created；過去分詞：created；現在分詞：creating

例句: The new study will advance our knowledge of this disease and hopefully help us find a more effective treatment.
翻譯: 這項新研究將促使我們提升對該疾病的知識，並且很可能幫助我們找到更有效的解藥。

例句: Advances in Internet technology have greatly changed our everyday lives.
翻譯: 網路科技的進步大幅改變了我們每天的生活。

例句: Jerry still doesn’t know how to separate egg whites from the yolks.
翻譯: Jerry還是不知道該如何將蛋黃與蛋白分開。

例句: My little brother is trying to keep the red beans separate from the green beans.
翻譯: 我弟弟正在想辦法把紅豆從綠豆堆中分開。

例句: People who work or study abroad alone have to bear long separations from their families.
翻譯: 孤身在國外工作和求學的人得忍受長期和他們的家人分離。

例句: Many rich people often hire professionals to help them with their finances and taxes.
翻譯: 許多有錢人經常雇用專業人士來幫他們處理財務和稅金。

例句: Doctors can give professional medical help to those with health problems.
翻譯: 醫生可以提供專業的醫療幫助給那些有健康狀況的人。

例句: Mr. Dillon’s two children entered different professions. One became a musician, while the other became a lawyer.
翻譯: Dillon先生的兩個孩子進入了不同的職業。一位成為音樂家，而另一位成為一名律師。

例句: You need to pass a driving test and get a driver’s license to drive on the roads.
翻譯: 你需要通過駕駛考試並拿到駕照才能開車上路。

例句: Taiwanese males are required to do military training.
翻譯: 臺灣男性需要受軍事訓練。

例句: Many people who applied for the position did not meet the requirements of the job, so they were not interviewed.
翻譯: 許多應徵這個職位的人不符合該工作的要求，所以他們沒有被受邀面試。

例句: Ryan’s baby daughter gave him a new sense of purpose, which pushed him to work harder to provide for his family.
翻譯: Ryan的小女兒給了他一個新的使命，促使他為了家庭更努力工作。

例句: The purpose of this meeting is to gather ideas and come up with new solutions to our current problems.
翻譯: 這項會議的目的是對於我們現有的問題收集意見和想出新的解決辦法。

例句: Lack of funding became a major roadblock for the students' innovative project, making it difficult to continue.
翻譯: 資金不足成為學生創新專案的一個主要障礙，使其難以繼續進行。

例句: A speech-language pathologist helps children and adults improve their communication skills and overcome speaking difficulties.
翻譯: 語言治療師幫助兒童和成人提高他們的溝通技巧並克服說話困難。

例句: The pathologist examined the tissue sample carefully to determine the exact cause of the patient's illness.
翻譯: 病理學家仔細檢查了組織樣本，以確定病人疾病的確切原因。

例句: Students interested in medicine often study pathology to understand how diseases affect the human body.
翻譯: 對醫學感興趣的學生通常會學習病理學，以了解疾病如何影響人體。

例句: Playing brain games can help improve your cognitive abilities, such as memory and problem-solving skills.
翻譯: 玩益智遊戲可以幫助提高你的認知能力，例如記憶力和解決問題的能力。

例句: Kindness is a positive personality trait that many people admire in their friends and family members.
翻譯: 善良是一種積極的性格特徵，許多人在他們的朋友和家人身上都很欣賞這一點。

例句: My English teacher recommended watching The King’s Speech to learn about a historical event and improve listening skills.
翻譯: 我的英文老師推薦觀看《王者之聲：宣戰時刻》，以了解歷史事件並提高聽力技巧。

例句: King George VI was the father of Queen Elizabeth II and became king after his brother abdicated the throne.
翻譯: 喬治六世是伊莉莎白二世女王的父親，在他的兄弟退位後成為國王。

例句: Many people overcome stuttering with the help of speech therapy, which teaches them techniques to speak more smoothly.
翻譯: 許多人在語言治療的幫助下克服口吃，語言治療教導他們更流暢說話的技巧。

例句: He tends to stutter when he gets nervous, especially when speaking in front of a large audience.
翻譯: 他緊張時容易口吃，尤其是在大眾面前說話的時候。

例句: About 10% of the world's population is left-handed, and they often find it challenging to use tools designed for right-handers.
翻譯: 全球約有10%的人口是左撇子，他們常覺得使用為右撇子設計的工具很有挑戰性。

例句: Most people are right-handed, so many everyday items like scissors and computer mice are designed for them.
翻譯: 大多數人是右撇子，所以許多日常用品如剪刀和電腦滑鼠都是為他們設計的。

例句: If you are interested in helping people with hearing problems, studying audiology could be a great career path for you.
翻譯: 如果你對幫助有聽力問題的人感興趣，學習聽力學對你來說可能是一個很棒的職業道路。

例句: She applied for an internship at a local tech company to gain practical experience before graduating from university.
翻譯: 她在大學畢業前申請了一家當地科技公司的實習，以獲得實務經驗。

例句: As an intern, he learned a lot about marketing by assisting with social media campaigns and creating content.
翻譯: 作為一名實習生，他透過協助社群媒體活動和內容創作，學到了很多關於行銷的知識。

例句: The science class offered a hands-on experiment where students could build their own small robots and program them.
翻譯: 這堂科學課提供了一個實務操作的實驗，學生可以建造自己的小型機器人並進行程式設計。

例句: The Ministry of Examination in Taiwan is responsible for organizing national examinations for civil servants and professionals.
翻譯: 台灣的考選部負責舉辦公務員和專業人員的國家考試。

例句: The company arranged a trip to break down the wall between the managers andemployees so that they could better understand each other in the future.
翻譯: 公司安排了一趟旅行來消除管理階層和職員階層的隔閡，讓他們以後更能了解彼此。

例句: At least 100 million tourists flock to the Mediterranean Sea every summer to enjoy the beaches and sunshine.
翻譯: 每年夏季至少有一億名旅客奔往地中海，享受那裡的沙灘和陽光。

例句: This business contest is a great opportunity for students to put the marketing theory they learned in class into action.
翻譯: 這項商業競賽是學生們將課堂所學的銷售理論付諸行動的一個絕佳機會。

例句: Niagara Falls, one of the most popular tourist attractions in the world, draws millions of visitors every year.
翻譯: 尼加拉瀑布是世界上最受歡迎的旅遊景點之一，每年吸引數百萬遊客。

例句: A lovely hat displayed in the window attracted Emily to the clothing store.
翻譯: 櫥窗中展示的一頂精美帽子吸引了Emily來到這間服飾店。

例句: Leslie is a good-looking man, and his pleasant personality makes him even more attractive.
翻譯: Leslie是個英俊的男人，且其開朗的個性讓他更具魅力。
字尾: -ive (having the quality of; tending to (具有…特質的；傾向於…))

例句: The hunter aimed his gun at a bird sitting on the top branch of a tree, but he missed it.
翻譯: 獵人用槍瞄準一隻棲息在樹枝上的鳥，但他沒有擊中。

例句: Two store clerks who had witnessed the robbery gave detailed descriptions to the police.
翻譯: 兩名目擊搶劫案的店員向警方提供了詳細的描述。

例句: Water resources are valuable in a desert area, where there is less than 250 millimeters of rain a year.
翻譯: 沙漠地區的水資源非常寶貴，那裡的年降雨量不足250毫米。

例句: Busy streets and rows of tall buildings are common sights in an urban landscape.
翻譯: 繁雜的街道和林立的高樓是城市景觀中常見的景象。

例句: After William paid for his living expenses, there was hardly any money left from his salary.
翻譯: William繳清了生活開支後，薪水所剩無幾。

例句: Never buy cracked eggs because bacteria can enter them through the damaged shells.
翻譯: 切勿購買有裂痕的雞蛋，因為細菌會透過受損的蛋殼進入其中。

例句: Sophia was so tired after work that she could barely keep her eyes open on her train ride home.
翻譯: Sophia下班後太累了，在搭回家的火車上她幾乎睜不開眼睛。

例句: Putting up an umbrella and wearing sunglasses are both effective ways to protect you from the sun’s harmful rays.
翻譯: 撐傘和戴墨鏡都是保護你遠離太陽有害射線的有效方法。

例句: This national park was founded to provide protection for a variety of rare animals.
翻譯: 這座國家公園的建立是為了保護各種稀有動物。

例句: For safety reasons, the workers in the chemical factory are required to wear protective clothing.
翻譯: 出於安全考慮，該化工廠的工人必須穿戴防護衣。

例句: These old pictures are precious to Beth because they always remind her of her happy childhood.
翻譯: 這些老照片對Beth來說很珍貴，因為它們總讓她想起快樂的童年。

例句: The six-bedroom house is large enough to satisfy the needs of a big family.
翻譯: 這間六房的房子夠大，可以滿足一個大家庭的需求。

例句: Michelle was very satisfied with the results of her college application.
翻譯: Michelle對她的大學申請結果非常滿意。

例句: The business plan was satisfactory to both companies, so they made it official.
翻譯: 兩家公司都對這項商業計畫感到滿意，因此他們將其正式公布。
詞形變化: adj.比較級：more satisfactory；最高級：most satisfactory

例句: Harry usually has a good appetite for breakfast after an early morning swim.
翻譯: 晨泳後，Harry早餐的胃口通常都很好。

例句: Getting some sunlight is good for your health because it is a great natural source of vitamin D.
翻譯: 曬太陽有益你的健康，因為陽光是維生素D很好的天然來源。
詞形變化: v.過去式：sourced；過去分詞：sourced；現在分詞：sourcing | n.複數：sources

例句: The Andersons plan to rent their vacation house out to tourists to increase their family income.
翻譯: Anderson一家計畫出租他們的度假屋給遊客，以增加家庭的收入。

例句: Cindy put a grape in her mouth, chewed it, and spat the seeds out.
翻譯: Cindy把一顆葡萄放進嘴裡，嚼了嚼，然後把籽吐了出來。

例句: Spreading fake news on social media may cause panic among the public.
翻譯: 在社群媒體上散播假新聞可能會引起大眾恐慌。

例句: Timmy knocked over his glass by accident, and milk quickly spread over the table.
翻譯: Timmy不小心打翻了玻璃杯，牛奶很快就灑滿了桌子。

例句: Cleaning your hands properly is a simple measure to prevent the spread of bacteria.
翻譯: 適當地清潔雙手是防止細菌傳播的簡易措施。

例句: The earthquake heavily affected many people living in this area and left them in need of help.
翻譯: 地震嚴重地影響了該地區的許多居民，使他們需要幫助。

例句: In a democratic country, citizens have the right to elect their government.
翻譯: 在一個民主國家，公民有權選出他們的政府。

例句: The mayor has governed the city for four years and is now running for re-election.
翻譯: 這位市長已經治理該市四年了，現在正在競選連任。

例句: Morocco is a beautiful country in North Africa, famous for its vibrant markets and delicious food.
翻譯: 摩洛哥是一個位於北非的美麗國家，以其充滿活力的市集和美味的食物聞名。

例句: My friend, who is a Moroccan, shared some interesting stories about his hometown and culture.
翻譯: 我的一位摩洛哥朋友分享了一些關於他家鄉和文化的有趣故事。

例句: We tried some delicious Moroccan mint tea and traditional pastries at the local cafe.
翻譯: 我們在當地咖啡館嘗試了一些美味的摩洛哥薄荷茶和傳統糕點。

例句: The two companies formed a strong partnership to develop new technology together.
翻譯: 這兩家公司建立了穩固的合作關係，共同開發新技術。

例句: The argan tree, found mainly in Morocco, is known for its nuts that produce a very valuable oil.
翻譯: 摩洛哥堅果樹主要生長在摩洛哥，以其能生產非常珍貴油的堅果而聞名。

例句: The herder carefully watched his flock of goats as they grazed on the hillside.
翻譯: 放牧人仔細地看著他的羊群在山坡上吃草。

例句: I like to drink orange juice that is fresh and a little bit pulpy, not too smooth.
翻譯: 我喜歡喝新鮮且帶點果肉狀的柳橙汁，不要太滑順的。

例句: Our bodies naturally excrete waste products through sweat and urine to stay healthy.
翻譯: 我們的身體透過汗水和尿液自然排泄廢物以保持健康。

例句: We carefully planted each tiny seedling in the garden, hoping they would grow into strong plants.

翻譯: 我們決定走一條輕鬆的路線穿過山脈，在那裡我們可以欣賞沿途令人驚嘆的景色。

例句: Cigarette companies are required to include information on their products that warns consumers about the risks of smoking.
翻譯: 香菸公司被要求在其產品上包含警示消費者吸菸風險的資訊。
詞形變化: v.過去式：warned；過去分詞：warned；現在分詞：warning

例句: I need to adjust the chair height to make it more comfortable for me.
翻譯: 我需要調整椅子的高度好讓我坐起來更舒適。

例句: Sherry made adjustments to the focus of her camera, so she could take clear pictures.
翻譯: Sherry調整了她相機的焦距，這樣才能拍出清晰的照片。

例句: Through play, children learn social skills and enhance their relationships with other children.
翻譯: 透過玩耍，孩子可以學習社交技能並增強與其他孩子的關係。

例句: Flora wanted to establish her own business, so she carefully planned and carried out her ideas to create a successful company.
翻譯: Flora想要建立自己的事業，因此她精心地策劃並執行自己的想法，創建了一家成功的公司。

例句: The new hospital is a necessary establishment in the city that provides the people with medical care and services.
翻譯: 這家新的醫院是該城市必備的機構，為人民提供醫療保健和服務。

例句: I wrote a brief summary to highlight the key points of the lengthy document.
翻譯: 我寫了一個簡短的摘要，以凸顯這份冗長文件中的要點。

例句: After reading the book, the students were asked to summarize the main events in a short and simple way.
翻譯: 讀完這本書後，學生被要求用簡短的方式總結主要事件。

例句: Getting a good night’s sleep before the exam is crucial to doing well.
翻譯: 考試前睡個好覺對於獲得好成績是很關鍵的。

例句: The Internet plays a vital role in modern society as people depend on it for almost everything.
翻譯: 網路在現代社會中扮演著極重要的角色，因為人們幾乎所有事情都依賴它。
搭配詞: play a vital role/part in something

中譯: 生命的，維持生命所必需的
例句: The kidney, which filters waste from the blood, is one of the vital organs in the human body.
翻譯: 腎臟負責過濾血液中的廢物，是人體重要的器官之一。

例句: The Red Cross provides aid to disaster victims by offering food, housing, and medical care.
翻譯: 紅十字會透過提供食物、住房和醫療服務來為災民提供援助。

例句: I aid my neighbor in carrying groceries into their house.
翻譯: 我幫助鄰居將雜貨搬進他們家。

例句: We shouldn't overestimate the impact of this small change on the overall project.
翻譯: 我們不應該高估這個小變化對整個專案的影響。

例句: The Harry Potter books are estimated to have sold more than 500 million copies around the world.
翻譯: 《哈利波特》系列書籍據估計在全球已經銷售超過5億本。

例句: It is hard for us to make an estimate on the timing, but we will finish the project as soon as possible.
翻譯: 我們難以估算時間，但我們會盡快完成這個專案。

例句: The general made a strategic decision to move his troops to higher ground, which gave them an advantage.
翻譯: 將軍做了一個策略性的決定，將部隊移到高地，這讓他們佔了優勢。

中譯: 茁壯成長;繁榮，蓬勃發展
例句: With hard work and dedication, a small business can flourish and become very successful in the market.
翻譯: 只要努力和奉獻，一家小企業就能蓬勃發展，在市場上取得巨大成功。

例句: It's important to prioritize your tasks to manage your time effectively and ensure you meet all deadlines.
翻譯: 重要的是要按優先順序處理你的任務，才能有效管理時間並確保完成所有截止日期。

例句: Please spread the butter evenly on the toast so that every part is covered and tastes good.
翻譯: 請將奶油均勻地塗抹在吐司上，讓每個部分都覆蓋到且味道好。

例句: The company decided to streamline its production process to reduce costs and increase overall efficiency.
翻譯: 這家公司決定簡化其生產流程，以降低成本並提高整體效率。

例句: The new software has a streamlined interface, which makes it much easier for users to navigate and understand.
翻譯: 這款新軟體具有簡化的介面，讓使用者更容易操作和理解。

例句: The city roads become very congested during rush hour, causing significant delays for commuters every day.
翻譯: 這座城市的道路在尖峰時段變得非常擁擠，每天都導致通勤者嚴重延誤。

例句: To reduce traffic congestion, the government encourages people to use public transport instead of driving.
翻譯: 為了減少交通壅塞，政府鼓勵人們搭乘大眾運輸工具而非開車。

例句: Each component of the machine must work perfectly for the whole system to function correctly and efficiently.
翻譯: 機器中的每個組成部分都必須完美運作，整個系統才能正確且有效率地運作。

例句: The new rules for the game are in line with what we agreed on earlier.
翻譯: 這些新遊戲規則與我們之前達成的共識相符。

例句: In terms of transportation, we need to consider the most efficient and cost-effective options for the project.
翻譯: 在交通方面，我們需要考慮對該項目最有效和最具成本效益的選擇。

例句: Read as many books as you can, and, in turn, they will bring you happiness and knowledge.
翻譯: 盡可能地多閱讀，相應地，它們會帶給你快樂和知識。

例句: Tessa used to be a sales clerk in the shop, and now she has progressed to managing the shop.
翻譯: Tessa曾經是店裡的銷售員，現在她已經晉升到管理店面。

例句: Steve has made great progress in learning English, which has helped him achieve high scores on the TOEFL test.
翻譯: Steve在學習英語有很大的進步，這幫助他在托福考試中得了高分。

例句: Even though Michael knows that smoking is a danger to his health, he finds it hard to quit.
翻譯: 儘管Michael知道吸菸危害健康，他發現它很難戒除。

例句: After three hours in surgery, the patient is no longer in danger of dying.
翻譯: 手術三小時後，這名患者不再有死亡的危險性。

例句: The term “global warming” refers to the increase in Earth's average temperature.
翻譯: 「全球暖化」一詞指的是地球平均溫度的上升。

例句: High-tech weapons provide a nation with the capability to protect itself against attack from other countries.
翻譯: 高科技武器提供一個國家保護自己免受其他國家攻擊的能力。

例句: The board members believe that the new CEO is capable of leading the company to a new peak.
翻譯: 董事會成員相信新任的CEO有能力帶領公司走向新的高峰。

例句: After a lot of hard work, the water quality of the formerly polluted river has been significantly improved, and the banks have been transformed into a popular tourist spot.
翻譯: 經過一番努力後，原本被汙染的河川水質明顯地改善，河岸也轉變為熱門的旅遊景點。

例句: The old scholar believes in conventional methods of studying, such as memorization and taking notes.
翻譯: 這名老學者相信傳統的學習方法，像是背誦和做筆記。

例句: By convention, a bride will wear a white wedding gown in Western countries.
翻譯: 按照慣例，西方國家的新娘會穿白色婚紗。

例句: With three projects going on, Professor Baker has so much work to do that he desperately needs an assistant to help him.
翻譯: 由於三個計畫正在進行，Baker教授有大量工作要做，他迫切需要一名助手來幫助他。

例句: The new policy aims to assist low-income families in accessing child care, particularly those with parents who need to work late.
翻譯: 新政策旨在幫助低收入家庭獲得托兒服務，特別是那些父母需要工作到很晚的家庭。
詞形變化: v.過去式：assisted；過去分詞：assisted；現在分詞：assisting | n.複數：assists

例句: Linda was able to start her business with the financial assistance of her family and friends.
翻譯: Linda在家人和朋友的財務支援下得以開始經營她的生意。

例句: Through the training program, the workers acquired the skills they needed to operate the new machines.
翻譯: 透過培訓計畫，工人們習得操作新機器所需的技能。

例句: Grace wrote an email of complaint to the department store and got an instant response.
翻譯: Grace寫了一封投訴電子郵件到百貨公司，並得到了即時的回覆。

例句: The restaurant owner always invites the customers to provide feedback on food and service so that he can better meet their needs.
翻譯: 餐廳老闆總是邀請顧客提供有關食物和服務的意見回饋，以便他能好好滿足他們的需求。

例句: When you close a file, a prompt may ask whether you want to save changes.
翻譯: 當你關閉文件時，可能會出現提示，詢問你是否儲存變更。

例句: The deadline prompts Miranda to finish the project quickly.
翻譯: 截止日期促使Miranda迅速完成了專案。

例句: The firefighters took prompt action and successfully saved the boy trapped in the burning house.
翻譯: 消防隊員採取立即的行動，成功救出被困在燃燒房屋中的男孩。

例句: The novel shows the journey of a little girl’s growth, from being childish and immature to becoming independent and responsible.
翻譯: 這本小說講述一個小女孩的成長歷程，從她稚氣未成熟到變得獨立和負責任。

例句: The couple went on a journey to a foreign country during their vacation to relieve stress from their work.
翻譯: 這對夫妻利用他們的假期到國外旅行，以緩解工作壓力。

例句: The country’s banking sector did not do well last year. Many banks earned low profits or faced a debt crisis.
翻譯: 這個國家的銀行領域去年表現不佳。許多銀行利潤微薄，或面臨債務危機。

例句: Using robots in the factory is one of the company’s methods to increase productivity.
翻譯: 在工廠使用機器人是該公司提高生產率的方法之一。

例句: After a thirty-minute  discussion, several important decisions were made in the highly productive meeting.
翻譯: 經過三十分鐘的討論，這場高度富有成效的會議做出了許多重要決定。

例句: The soldiers sacrificed their lives for their country at the end of the story, and their deaths were a great tragedy.
翻譯: 故事的結尾，士兵們為國捐軀，他們的死亡是一場大悲劇。

例句: It is impossible to achieve your goals without making any sacrifices. Success takes time and effort.
翻譯: 不做出任何犧牲就不可能實現你的目標。 成功需要時間和努力。

例句: The bicycle lock, which can’t be cut off easily, provides security against thieves.
翻譯: 自行車鎖不易被切斷，可防止小偷竊取。

例句: Jason spent lots of money on an alarm system in order to keep his shop secure from burglars.
翻譯: Jason花了很多錢購買警報系統，以確保他的商店免受竊賊侵害。

例句: Ben managed to secure a place for his child in the best elementary school of the city.
翻譯: Ben成功為他的孩子在這座城市最好的小學獲得了一個名額。

例句: Water samples from various regions were analyzed for harmful chemicals.
翻譯: 來自不同地區的水樣本被分析以檢測有害的化學物質。

例句: To make sure that the medicine was effective, the expert conducted a chemical analysis of some blood samples.
翻譯: 為了確保藥物有效，專家對一些血液樣本進行了化學分析。

例句: Sean always wears his helmet while riding a bicycle to reduce the risk of getting injured.
翻譯: Sean騎自行車時總是會戴安全帽，以減少受傷的風險。

例句: Mosquitoes that carry diseases pose a risk to human health. People may suffer from a fever, headaches, or muscle pain.
翻譯: 攜帶疾病的蚊子對人類健康構成威脅。人們可能會發燒、頭痛或肌肉疼痛。

例句: During my time in the position, I have learned the techniques for solving mechanical problems.
翻譯: 在擔任該職位期間，我學會了解決機械問題的技能。

例句: The city that had been nearly destroyed in the storm was rapidly rebuilt, and it began to prosper again in just one year.
翻譯: 這座在風暴中幾乎被摧毀的城市迅速地重建，僅僅一年的時間就再次開始繁榮。

例句: In the summer, there is always a rapid growth in sales of ice cream and cold drinks.
翻譯: 在夏季，冰淇淋和冷飲的銷售量總是快速成長。

例句: After a full examination, the doctor was finally able to identify the actual cause of Ashley’s sudden memory loss.
翻譯: 經過全面檢查，醫生終於找出Ashley突然失憶的真正原因。

例句: The painting, which has been identified as an Andy Warhol original, is of great cultural value.
翻譯: 這幅畫被鑑定為安迪‧沃荷的原創作品，具有極高的文化價值。

例句: Since the airplane was completely destroyed, identification of the crash victims proved a difficult job.
翻譯: 由於飛機被完全摧毀，墜機罹難者的身分辨識成為一項艱鉅的工作。

例句: Tony ignored the “Quiet Please” sign in the library and talked loudly on his phone. As a result, he was scolded by the librarian.
翻譯: Tony無視圖書館裡「請安靜」的告示並大聲地講電話。結果，他被圖書館員訓話了一頓。
詞形變化: v.過去式：ignored；過去分詞：ignored；現在分詞：ignoring

例句: Over the past ten years, the tech company’s products have gotten poorer in quality and no longer meet customers’ expectations.
翻譯: 在過去的十年裡，這家科技公司的產品品質越來越差，不再滿足客戶的期待。

例句: We should embrace new technologies and innovative ideas to stay competitive in this rapidly changing world.
翻譯: 我們應該欣然接受新技術和創新想法，以在這個快速變化的世界中保持競爭力。

例句: A warm embrace from a friend can make you feel much better and comforted when you are feeling sad.
翻譯: 當你感到悲傷時，朋友的一個溫暖擁抱能讓你感覺好很多，得到安慰。

例句: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming many industries, from healthcare and finance to entertainment.
翻譯: 人工智慧正在快速改變許多產業，從醫療保健和金融到娛樂業。

例句: Many people prefer natural light over artificial light when studying or working for long hours.
翻譯: 許多人在長時間學習或工作時，會偏好自然光而非人造光。

例句: Scientists are still trying to fully understand the complexity of human intelligence and how it works.
翻譯: 科學家仍在努力完全理解人類智慧的複雜性及其運作方式。

例句: An intelligent student can usually understand new concepts quickly and solve problems effectively in class.
翻譯: 一個聰明的學生通常能快速理解新概念，並在課堂上有效地解決問題。

例句: Many students join after-school clubs like basketball or art to relax and learn new skills.
翻譯: 許多學生參加籃球或美術等課後社團，以放鬆身心並學習新技能。

例句: The hospital's emergency room is open 24/7 to provide medical care whenever it's needed.
翻譯: 醫院的急診室全天候開放，隨時提供醫療服務。

例句: As a doctor, she has to be on-call during weekends, ready to go to the hospital at any moment.
翻譯: 作為一名醫生，她週末必須隨時待命，隨時準備前往醫院。

例句: The museum has many interactive exhibits where visitors can touch and play to learn more about science.
翻譯: 這座博物館有許多互動式展品，遊客可以觸摸和玩耍以學習更多科學知識。

例句: Some factory jobs involve performing repetitive movements, which can be tiring after a long shift.
翻譯: 有些工廠工作涉及重複性動作，長時間輪班後可能會感到疲憊。

例句: Learning new vocabulary often requires a lot of repetition to make sure you remember the words well.
翻譯: 學習新詞彙通常需要大量的重複，以確保你牢記這些單字。

例句: Many modern factories use automated robots to assemble products, which increases efficiency and speed.
翻譯: 許多現代工廠使用自動化機器人組裝產品，這提高了效率和速度。

例句: Good cybersecurity practices are essential to protect personal data and prevent online attacks from hackers.
翻譯: 良好的網路安全措施對於保護個人資料和防止駭客的網路攻擊至關重要。

例句: Many modern smartphones offer dual SIM card slots, allowing users to have two different phone numbers.
翻譯: 許多現代智慧型手機提供雙SIM卡插槽，讓使用者可以擁有兩個不同的電話號碼。

例句: When the fire alarm suddenly went off, everyone quickly and calmly evacuated the building.
翻譯: 當火警警報器突然響起時，所有人迅速而鎮定地疏散了建築物。

例句: The car alarm started blaring loudly in the middle of the night, waking up the whole neighborhood.
翻譯: 汽車警報器在半夜大聲鳴響，吵醒了整個社區。

例句: Ever since John was 10, he has been exercising to maintain a healthy body.
翻譯: 自從John十歲起，他就一直堅持運動以保持健康的身體。

例句: Walt really wants to become a professional dancer, so he practices his dance moves around the clock.
翻譯: Walt真的很想成為職業舞者，所以他晝夜不停地練習他的舞蹈動作。

例句: Fastening seat belts can guard against serious injuries in car accidents.
翻譯: 繫好安全帶可以防止車禍中的嚴重傷害。

例句: Since farmers changed their planting methods, the quality of grapes has leveled up.
翻譯: 自從農民改變他們的種植方式後，葡萄的品質提升了。

例句: The camping trip had some unexpected challenges, but all in all, it was a memorable experience.
翻譯: 這次露營旅行遇到一些預期外的挑戰，但總而言之，這是一段難忘的經歷。

例句: After Angela became involved in the family business, she didn’t have much time to spend with her children.
翻譯: Angela開始涉足家族事業後，她沒有太多時間陪伴孩子。

例句: Learning a new language involves practicing speaking, listening, reading, and writing.
翻譯: 學習一個新的語言包含練習說、聽、讀、寫。

例句: The police are looking into the suspect’s possible involvement in other murder cases.
翻譯: 警方正在調查該嫌疑人涉入其他謀殺案件的可能。

例句: The restaurant takes pride in serving its customers with the best steak in town.
翻譯: 這間餐廳以提供顧客鎮上最好的牛排為傲。
詞形變化: v.過去式：served；過去分詞：served；現在分詞：serving

例句: Derek practiced giving his speech in front of his family over and over in order to overcome his fear of public speaking.
翻譯: Derek一遍又一遍地在家人面前練習他的演講，以克服他對公開演說的恐懼。

例句: With her talent for painting, Laura has great potential to become a professional artist if she receives formal training.
翻譯: 憑藉著她的繪畫天賦，Laura如果接受正規培訓，她很有潛力成為職業藝術家。

例句: A successful commercial can help a product stand out and attract as many potential buyers as possible.
翻譯: 一則成功的廣告能讓產品脫穎而出，並盡可能吸引更多潛在的買家。

例句: Growing up in a religious family, Melissa developed a firm belief in God.
翻譯: 在一個虔誠家庭長大，Melissa對上帝產生了堅定的信仰。

例句: Jack prefers sleeping on a firm bed because soft beds give him back pain.
翻譯: Jack偏好睡硬床，因為軟床會讓他背痛。

例句: With years of hard work, the small marketing firm expanded and has gained reputation within the industry.
翻譯: 經過多年的努力，這家小型行銷公司擴大規模，並在業界贏得了聲譽。

例句: To enhance productivity, the company established limitations on the use of social media during working hours.
翻譯: 為了提高生產力，公司在上班時間對社群媒體的使用設立了限制。

例句: Nuclear limitation agreements have been signed to restrict the development and use of nuclear weapons.
翻譯: 簽署核能限制協議是為了限制核能武器的開發和使用。

例句: The new tax policy requires people to pay higher taxes, imposing a heavy burden on middle-class families.
翻譯: 新的賦稅政策要求人民繳納更高的稅款，為中產階級家庭強加了沉重的負擔。
詞形變化: v.過去式：imposed；過去分詞：imposed；現在分詞：imposing

例句: To prevent the disease from spreading, several governments have decided to impose travel bans.
翻譯: 為了防止疾病散播，數個國家決定實施旅遊禁令。
詞形變化: v.過去式：imposed；過去分詞：imposed；現在分詞：imposing

例句: In the United States, a person can be elected to the Office of the President twice, and each term lasts four years.
翻譯: 在美國，一個人可以被推選為總統兩次，每次任期四年。

例句: In some countries, the party that wins the presidential election will form the new government.
翻譯: 在一些國家，贏得總統選舉的政黨將組成新政府。

例句: The debate over lowering the voting age to 18 has sparked discussions across the country.
翻譯: 關於將投票年齡降低至十八歲的爭論在全國引發了討論。

例句: Amy decided to vote for the new environmental regulations, believing they can help protect our planet.
翻譯: Amy決定投票支持新的環境法規，她相信它們有助於保護我們的星球。

例句: The polling station will be open until 4 o’clock in the afternoon for citizens to cast their votes.
翻譯: 投票站將開放至下午四點供市民投票。

例句: The school swim team is permitted to use the pool after school to practice for the National High School Games.
翻譯: 游泳校隊被允許在放學後使用游泳池，為全國高中運動會練習。

例句: The kindergarten teacher reminded the girl that she needed to raise her hand and ask permission to speak in class.
翻譯: 幼兒園老師提醒女孩，上課發言需要舉手尋求同意。

例句: The photographer was criticized for taking pictures of the people who had been badly injured in the fire instead of first helping them.
翻譯: 這名攝影師因拍攝在火災中受重傷的人而不是先幫助他們而受到批評。

例句: The company has received a great deal of criticism from animal protection organizations because it carried out experiments on animals.
翻譯: 這間公司因對動物進行實驗而受到動物保護組織的嚴厲批評。

例句: The teacher praised the students for their excellent presentations during the science fair.
翻譯: 老師讚揚學生們在科學博覽會上精彩的演講。

例句: When COVID-19 broke out in 2020, Taiwan received praise for the government’s prompt responses.
翻譯: 當新冠肺炎在2020年爆發時，臺灣政府的迅速應對獲得讚揚。

例句: In the story of The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe, the wardrobe is the entrance to a magical world.
翻譯: 在《獅子‧女巫‧魔衣櫥》的故事中，魔衣櫥是通往魔法世界的入口。

例句: After the war broke out, Khowla’s family became refugees, and they were forced to flee from their home country.
翻譯: 戰爭爆發後，Khowla一家成為難民，並被迫逃離祖國。

例句: To meet the growing need for the products, the factory decided to employ additional staff.
翻譯: 為了滿足日益增長的產品需求，該工廠決定雇用更多員工。

例句: After graduating from the information technology department, Sally hoped to find employment in a related field.
翻譯: 從資訊工程學系畢業後，Sally希望在相關領域找到工作。

例句: Jack works as a part-time employee at the local bookstore while attending college.
翻譯: Jack在上大學期間在當地的書店擔任兼職員工。

例句: Employers must pay labor insurance and health insurance, or they will face a heavy fine.
翻譯: 雇主必須繳納勞動保險和健康保險，否則他們將面臨鉅額罰款。

例句: Eric’s sudden decision to resign from his position came as a shock to his co-workers because he had always shown great enthusiasm for his job.
翻譯: Eric突然從他的職位辭職的決定讓他的同事們感到震驚，因為他一直對他的工作展現極大的熱情。

例句: The senior staff member announced her resignation, saying that she needed to take a long rest.
翻譯: 這位資深職員宣布辭職，表示她需要休息一段時間。

例句: There is a growing trend for people living in the city to relocate to the suburbs in order to reduce their housing costs.
翻譯: 居住在城市的人搬遷到郊區以降低他們住房成本的趨勢日益上升。

例句: The firefighter made a great effort to locate the little child who was trapped inside the burning house.
翻譯: 消防隊員費盡全力才找到受困燃燒屋子中孩子的位置。
詞形變化: v.過去式：located；過去分詞：located；現在分詞：locating

例句: Helen Keller’s story has inspired many of us to work harder and to face life’s challenges with determination.
翻譯: 海倫‧凱勒的故事激勵我們許多人更加努力工作，堅定地面對生活上的挑戰。

例句: Bill Gates’s charity work is an inspiration to me. It is the reason I regularly make donations to those in need.
翻譯: 比爾‧蓋茲的慈善工作對我來說是很大的啟發。這就是我定期向有需要的人捐款的原因。

例句: Vincent van Gogh was a great artist who liked to draw inspiration from nature. His famous painting, The Starry Night, is one such example.
翻譯: 文森‧梵谷是一位偉大的藝術家，他喜歡從大自然汲取靈感。他的知名畫作《星空》就是這樣的一個例子。

例句: The club only accepts female members, so men are not allowed to join it.
翻譯: 這間俱樂部只接受女性會員，因此男性不允許加入。

例句: According to the research, females seem to live longer than males do.
翻譯: 根據研究，女性似乎活得比男性更久。

例句: A high percentage of the people who live in this city take the MRT to work, so the subway is always crowded during rush hour.
翻譯: 住在這個城市的人之中有很高的比例搭乘捷運上班，因此捷運在尖峰時段總是很擁擠。

例句: Ninety percent of the five hundred students in the grade level passed the exam. In other words, fifty students failed.
翻譯: 該年級五百名學生中有百分之九十通過了考試。換句話說，有五十名學生不及格。

例句: All of Robert’s hard work ultimately paid off when he achieved his goal of becoming a pilot.
翻譯: 當Robert實現成為飛行員的目標時，他所有的努力最終都得到了回報。

例句: Currently, Lillian has to share an apartment with two roommates, but her ultimate aim is to buy a house of her own.
翻譯: 目前，Lillian必須與兩位室友合住一間公寓，但她最終的目標是買一棟屬於自己的房子。

例句: There is an ongoing discussion among experts about the benefits and risks of AI technology in classrooms.
翻譯: 專家們對於人工智慧技術在課堂中的好處和風險有著持續性的討論。

例句: The possibility that he may fail math has motivated Luke to study harder.
翻譯: 數學不及格的可能性促使Luke更加努力學習。

例句: Losing the match did not frustrate the tennis player. Instead, it strengthened her motivation to improve.
翻譯: 輸掉比賽並沒有讓這位網球選手感到沮喪。反而，增強了她改進的動力。

例句: Thanks to the support of his wife, Ang Lee could leave behind the economic burdens of his family and pursue a career as a movie director.
翻譯: 多虧了他妻子的支持，李安得以拋開家庭的經濟負擔，追求電影導演的事業。
詞形變化: v.過去式：pursued；過去分詞：pursued；現在分詞：pursuing

例句: The body builder follows a strict diet and spends hours every day working out in pursuit of physical perfection.
翻譯: 這位健美選手遵循嚴格的飲食並每天花好幾個小時鍛鍊，以追求完美的身材。

例句: Hanna Sahlfeld-Singer is a notable figure known for her contributions to social justice and human rights.
翻譯: 漢娜‧薩爾費爾德-辛格是一位以其對社會正義和人權的貢獻而聞名的傑出人物。

例句: The young activist organized a protest to raise awareness about climate change and environmental protection.
翻譯: 這位年輕的行動主義者組織了一場抗議活動，以提高人們對氣候變遷和環境保護的意識。

例句: The country's parliament debated the new education bill for hours before finally voting to approve it.
翻譯: 該國議會就新的教育法案辯論了數小時，最終投票通過了它。

例句: Many tourists visit Switzerland every year to enjoy its beautiful Alps, delicious chocolate, and precise watches.
翻譯: 每年都有許多遊客造訪瑞士，欣賞其美麗的阿爾卑斯山、美味的巧克力和精密的鐘錶。

例句: The Swiss Alps are a popular destination for skiing and hiking, attracting visitors from all over the world.
翻譯: 瑞士阿爾卑斯山是滑雪和健行的熱門目的地，吸引著來自世界各地的遊客。

例句: A Swiss person is often proud of their country's neutrality, stunning landscapes, and high quality of life.
翻譯: 瑞士人通常以其國家的中立性、壯麗的風景和高品質的生活為榮。

例句: The pastor gave an inspiring sermon about kindness and helping others in need.
翻譯: 牧師發表了一場關於善良和幫助有需要的人的鼓舞人心的佈道。

例句: We learn valuable lessons and grow stronger when we face adversity in our lives.
翻譯: 當我們在生活中面對逆境時，我們會學到寶貴的教訓並變得更堅強。

例句: Our school club will advocate for more recycling programs to protect the environment.
翻譯: 我們學校社團將提倡更多的回收計畫來保護環境。

例句: The local Member of Parliament promised to address the community's concerns about public transportation.
翻譯: 當地議員承諾會解決社區對大眾運輸的擔憂。

例句: Tourists often visit the impressive Federal Palace of Switzerland in Bern to see its architecture.
翻譯: 遊客經常參觀伯恩令人印象深刻的瑞士聯邦議會大廈，欣賞其建築。

例句: Our volunteer group often helps to provide food and shelter for homeless people in the city.
翻譯: 我們志工團經常幫助為城市裡的無家可歸者提供食物和住所。

例句: My friend dreams of traveling to South Africa to see its diverse wildlife and beautiful landscapes.
翻譯: 我的朋友夢想去南非旅行，看看那裡多樣的野生動物和美麗的風景。

例句: Many people visit Germany to experience its rich history, delicious food, and famous festivals.
翻譯: 許多人去德國體驗其豐富的歷史、美味的食物和著名的節慶。

例句: Our team is committed to winning the championship through hard work and dedication.
翻譯: 我們團隊致力於透過努力和奉獻贏得冠軍。

例句: Tom stood up for his little sister and argued with several kids when she was being teased at the playground.
翻譯: 當他的妹妹在操場上被嘲笑，Tom為他的妹妹挺身而出，並與幾個孩子發生爭執。

中譯: 將 (時間、精力等) 致力、奉獻於…
例句: Antoine Pierrot was a Catholic priest from the Netherlands. He devoted himself to helping the old and the poor in remote areas of Taiwan.
翻譯: Antoine Pierrot是一位來自荷蘭的天主教神父。他致力於幫助臺灣偏鄉地區的老年和窮困人口。

例句: The first email was sent in 1971 by Ray Tomlinson, but he had no idea he was making history.
翻譯: Ray Tomlinson在1971年寄出第一封電子郵件，但他完全不知道自己正在創造歷史。

例句: The thick fur of polar bears enables them to survive in the face of cold weather.
翻譯: 北極熊厚重的皮毛使牠們能夠在寒冷的氣候中生存。

例句: After hours of discussion, the company finally gave in to the demands of the striking workers.
翻譯: 經過幾個小時的討論，該公司終於屈服於罷工員工的要求。

例句: Cathy decided to become a lawyer for people accused of crimes because she believes they have rights and need someone to speak up for them.
翻譯: Cathy決定成為一名為被指控犯罪者辯護的律師，因為她相信他們有權利，且需要有人為他們發聲。

例句: The movie aims to give voice to the untold stories of survivors of war.
翻譯: 這部電影旨在講述戰爭倖存者不為人知的故事。

例句: The new clerk wasn’t yet able to work independently, so she asked for guidance from her co-workers on how to deal with customers.
翻譯: 新來的店員還不能獨立作業，所以她向同事請教如何應對顧客。

例句: The first print run of the book sold out within a week of being published.
翻譯: 這本書的首刷在出版一週內就被搶購一空。

例句: The publisher released a new children’s book that quickly became a bestseller.
翻譯: 這間出版商出版了一本新的兒童讀物，很快地就成為暢銷書。

例句: Although Olivia begged for Tom’s forgiveness, he was still mad at her.
翻譯: 儘管Olivia請求Tom的原諒，他仍在生她的氣。

例句: Kevin said sorry to Ashley and hoped that she would forgive him for being late.
翻譯: Kevin向Ashley表示抱歉，並希望她能原諒他遲到。

例句: The main theme of the movie was unclear. Many in the audience couldn’t understand what it tried to convey.
翻譯: 這部電影的主題不明確。許多觀眾無法理解它試圖傳達什麼。
詞形變化: v.過去式：themed；過去分詞：themed；現在分詞：theming | n.複數：themes

例句: A fairy tale often has two leading characters from totally different backgrounds who end up falling in love. “Cinderella” is a perfect example of such a story.
翻譯: 童話故事經常有兩個來自完全不同背景的主角，最終墜入愛河。《灰姑娘》就是一個完美的例子。
詞形變化: v.過去式：charactered；過去分詞：charactered；現在分詞：charactering | n.複數：characters

例句: Most people see John as outgoing and energetic, but there is a side of his character that is quiet and shy.
翻譯: 大多數人認為John外向、精力充沛，但他性格中也有安靜、害羞的一面。
詞形變化: v.過去式：charactered；過去分詞：charactered；現在分詞：charactering | n.複數：characters

例句: These colorful houses are characteristic of Burano, an island of Venice. You will see them everywhere during your visit there.
翻譯: 這些色彩繽紛的房屋是威尼斯布拉諾島特有的。當你造訪那裡，你隨處都能看到它們。

例句: A long nose and large ears are the main characteristics of an elephant.
翻譯: 長鼻子和大耳朵是大象的主要特徵。

例句: The robber was sentenced to five years in jail for the crime he committed.
翻譯: 這名搶劫犯因其犯下的罪行被判處五年徒刑。

例句: Thanks to the efforts of the police department, there has been a steady decrease in the crime rate this year.
翻譯: 多虧了警察部門的努力，今年犯罪率穩定下降。

例句: Those who have a criminal record often have difficulty getting a job because employers worry they will commit an offense again.
翻譯: 那些有犯罪紀錄的人往往難以找到工作，因為雇主擔心他們會再次犯罪。

例句: The police caught the dangerous criminals who bombed the gas station last week.
翻譯: 警方抓獲了上週炸毀加油站的危險罪犯。

例句: It was hard for Shirley to regain her coworkers’ trust after she messed up a large project.
翻譯: 在Shirley搞砸一個大專案後，她很難重新獲得同事的信任。

例句: The experienced teacher quickly gained control of the noisy class.
翻譯: 這位經驗豐富的老師很快就控制了喧鬧的班級。

例句: Thanks to the new marketing strategy, the company enjoyed a huge gain in sales.
翻譯: 多虧新的行銷策略，該公司的銷售額大幅增加。

例句: The thief was caught red-handed when trying to steal a purse from a woman in the department store.
翻譯: 小偷在百貨公司試圖竊取一名婦女的皮包時被當場抓獲。
詞形變化: v.過去式：stole；過去分詞：stolen；現在分詞：stealing | n.複數：steals

例句: Beginning his career as a child actor, Robin adopted his stage name from the first role he played.
翻譯: Robin從童星開始他的演藝生涯，並從他扮演的第一個角色採用了他的藝名。
詞形變化: v.過去式：adopted；過去分詞：adopted；現在分詞：adopting

例句: Donna decided to adopt her nephew Adam, whose parents died in a tragic accident, as her own child.
翻譯: Donna決定收養她的侄子Adam作為自己的孩子，他的父母在一場悲慘的事故中喪生。
詞形變化: v.過去式：adopted；過去分詞：adopted；現在分詞：adopting

例句: A passport is the most commonly accepted way to confirm one’s identity when a person travels internationally.
翻譯: 護照是一個人出國旅行時最常用來確認身分的方式。

例句: The slave went down on his knees in front of the king and begged for mercy.
翻譯: 那名奴隸在國王面前跪下，乞求寬恕。

例句: You don’t need to find a partner, since both individuals and teams are allowed to take part in this game.
翻譯: 你不需要尋找夥伴，因為個人和團體都可以參加這個遊戲。

例句: The team’s performance improved when the individual members of the team communicated effectively with one another.
翻譯: 當團隊個別的成員之間有效溝通時，團隊的表現就會改善。

例句: The surgery left a small scar on Rita's arm. If she didn’t tell you about it, you might not even notice it.
翻譯: 手術在Rita的手臂上留下了一個小傷疤。如果她不說，你可能根本不會注意到。

例句: Troy's legs were badly scarred in a fire, which is why he always wears long pants, even in summer.
翻譯: Troy的腿在火災中留下了嚴重的傷疤，這就是為什麼他總是穿長褲，即使在夏天也是如此。

例句: The bruises on Melissa’s legs are from falling down the stairs.
翻譯: Melissa腿上的瘀青是從樓梯上摔下來造成的。

例句: Eugene bruised his shoulder because he bumped into a steel door.
翻譯: Eugene因為撞到了一扇鋼門而瘀傷了肩膀。

例句: The uncertainty about the future disturbed Frank, leading to sleepless nights and increased stress.
翻譯: 對未來的不確定性困擾著Frank，導致他徹夜難眠，壓力也越來越大。

例句: If you finish the test early, please remain seated so that you don’t disturb the other students.
翻譯: 如果你提早完成考試，請留在座位上以免打擾其他同學。

例句: The treatment caused the patient such intense pain that she could hardly bear it.
翻譯: 治療為患者帶來劇烈的疼痛，讓她難以忍受。

例句: The intensity of the heat in the summer made staying outside very difficult.
翻譯: 夏天天氣炎熱的程度讓待在戶外變得非常困難。

例句: After taking a two-month intensive language course, John greatly improved his speaking ability and can now chat fluently with native speakers.
翻譯: 經過兩個月密集的語言課程後，John的口說能力大幅地提升，現在可以與母語人士流利地對談。

例句: The public hoped that the murderer would spend his whole life in jail, so justice would be done.
翻譯: 大眾希望這名兇手能被終身監禁，這樣正義才得以伸張。

例句: Ms. Pfeiffer rewarded her employees with free movie tickets for securing a major business contract.
翻譯: Pfeiffer女士為了慶祝員工成功拿下一個重要的商業合約，獎賞他們免費的電影票。

例句: All the medical staff were treated to a nice trip as a reward for their hard work in the past year.
翻譯: 全體醫護人員都獲得一次愉快的旅行，作為對過去一年辛苦工作的回報。

例句: It is a good idea to seek legal advice when you draft or review contracts in order to protect and ensure your rights.
翻譯: 要起草或審查合約時，最好尋求法律建議，以保護和確保你的權利。

例句: Although the problem was difficult, we had to confront it directly.
翻譯: 儘管這個問題很困難，我們必須直接面對它。

中譯: 使面對 (難處理的人或狀況)
例句: My parents confronted me with a choice between college and work in my last year of high school.
翻譯: 在我高中的最後一年，我的父母向我提出了在大學和工作之間做出選擇的問題。

例句: The meeting ended with a confrontation between the CEO and the board members over the company’s direction.
翻譯: 會議以公司CEO和董事會成員就公司方向的分歧爭執而結束。

例句: With only two bedrooms, this small apartment is recommended for a household of two to three persons.
翻譯: 這間小公寓只有兩間臥室，建議兩到三人的家庭入住。

例句: The United Nations made a recommendation to tax meat in order to reduce its consumption and slow down the rate of global warming.
翻譯: 聯合國建議對肉類徵稅，以減少其消費量並減緩全球暖化的速度。
搭配詞: make a recommendation to do something

例句: Sara wept for joy when her boyfriend proposed to her.
翻譯: 當Sara的男友向她求婚時，她高興得哭泣。
詞形變化: v.過去式：wept；過去分詞：wept；現在分詞：weeping | n.複數：weeps

例句: My poor study habits are an obstacle to getting good grades.
翻譯: 我不良的學習習慣是取得好成績的阻礙。

例句: The main character's journey in the novel is a powerful story of personal redemption and forgiveness.
翻譯: 小說中主角的旅程是一個關於個人救贖和寬恕的強大故事。

例句: I hope to visit France someday to see the Eiffel Tower and taste authentic French cuisine.
翻譯: 我希望有一天能去法國，看看艾菲爾鐵塔並品嚐正宗的法國美食。

例句: My favorite restaurant serves delicious French pastries and coffee, which I enjoy every weekend.
翻譯: 我最喜歡的餐廳提供美味的法式糕點和咖啡，我每個週末都會去享用。

例句: Learning French can open up many opportunities to travel and understand a new culture.
翻譯: 學習法語可以開啟許多旅行和了解新文化的機會。

例句: Many people consider "Les Misérables" to be a classic novel with a powerful message about justice.
翻譯: 許多人認為《悲慘世界》是一部經典小說，傳達了關於正義的強大訊息。

例句: Victor Hugo, a famous French writer, created many influential works, including "Les Misérables."
翻譯: 著名的法國作家維克多‧雨果創作了許多有影響力的作品，包括《悲慘世界》。

例句: Studying abroad can be a truly transformative experience, changing your perspective on the world.
翻譯: 出國留學可能是一次真正具有徹底改觀作用的經歷，它會改變你對世界的看法。

例句: Jean Valjean, the protagonist of "Les Misérables," struggles with his past and seeks redemption.
翻譯: 尚萬強，《悲慘世界》的主角，與他的過去搏鬥並尋求救贖。

例句: My grandmother keeps her beautiful antique silverware polished and ready for special family dinners.
翻譯: 我祖母把她美麗的古董銀器擦得閃閃發亮，準備用於特別的家庭晚餐。

例句: The kind bishop offered Jean Valjean a chance at a new life after his release from prison.
翻譯: 仁慈的主教在尚萬強出獄後給了他一個重新開始生活的機會。

例句: Inspector Javert is a determined police officer who relentlessly pursues Jean Valjean throughout the story.
翻譯: 警探賈維是一位堅定的警官，在整個故事中不懈地追捕尚萬強。

例句: It's interesting to observe how human nature can be both kind and selfish at different times.
翻譯: 觀察人性如何在不同時刻既善良又自私是很有趣的。

例句: The documentary about climate change was very thought-provoking and made me consider my own actions.
翻譯: 這部關於氣候變遷的紀錄片非常發人深省，讓我思考自己的行為。

例句: His strong opinions often provoke lively discussions among his classmates during debates.
翻譯: 他強烈的觀點經常在辯論中激起同學間熱烈的討論。

例句: The old lighthouse stood as a beacon of hope for sailors lost at sea during the storm.
翻譯: 那座老燈塔在暴風雨中，是海上迷失水手的希望燈塔。

例句: After spending ten years behind bars, Simon was released from jail, and he was determined to become a good person.
翻譯: 坐牢了十年後，Simon從監獄被釋放，決心要做個好人。

中譯: 改善，好轉；惡化，每況愈下
例句: Loretta’s New Year’s resolution is to do daily exercise for an hour a day. It is tiring, but she believes it will be a change for the better.
翻譯: Loretta的新年新計畫是每天運動一小時。雖然很累，但她相信這會是一個更好的改變。

例句: When analyzing historical events, historians often seek to examine the fundamental questions of why certain events occurred and their impact on society.
翻譯: 分析歷史事件時，歷史學家常試圖探討某些事件發生的根本問題以及其對社會的影響。

例句: The instructor raised his voice to emphasize the value of time management.
翻譯: 教師提高音量，強調了時間管理的價值。

例句: The political leader fought for a noble purpose—he demanded basic rights for all native communities.
翻譯: 那位政治領袖為一個崇尚的目的而戰—他要求為所有原住民族爭取基本權利。

例句: When we learn a new language, it is essential to understand the basic principles of grammar.
翻譯: 當我們學習一種新語言，了解基本的語法原則至關重要。

例句: Copying other people’s ideas is against my principles. I can assure you that all of my works are original.
翻譯: 抄襲他人的想法違反了我的原則。我向你保證，我所有的作品都是原創的。

例句: Candice wanted to build bridges that are both functional and beautiful, so she decided to major in engineering at university.
翻譯: Candice想建造既實用又美麗的橋樑，因此她決定在大學主修工程學。

例句: Part of the new policy on education for disadvantaged children guaranteed free lunch to students who needed it.
翻譯: 新教育政策針對弱勢兒童的一部分保證了需要的學生可以獲得免費午餐。

例句: In modern times, not being familiar with digital technology may put job hunters at a big disadvantage.
翻譯: 當今，不熟悉數位科技可能會讓求職者處於極大的劣勢。

例句: If you encounter any difficulties, please let me know so that I can help you out.
翻譯: 如果你遇到任何困難，請告訴我，我可以幫助您解決。

例句: Rita had an unpleasant encounter with a stranger who tried to follow her back home.
翻譯: Rita和一個試圖跟蹤她回家的陌生人有不愉快的相遇。

例句: We all like Andy. He is very popular indeed in our class.
翻譯: 我們都喜歡Andy。他在我們班上的確非常受歡迎。

例句: The CEO used a graph to visually compare the company’s sales increase this quarter to those of the same period last year.
翻譯: CEO使用圖表將本季公司的銷售增長與去年同期進行視覺上比較。

例句: In comparison with his brother, Benjamin is a bit taller and stronger.
翻譯: 與他的兄弟相比，Benjamin更高更壯一些。

例句: Studies indicate that poor sleep can lead to certain mental problems, such as getting angry easily.
翻譯: 研究指出，睡眠不足可能導致某些心理問題，比如容易發怒。

例句: The color red is an indication of passion, whereas blue represents calmness.
翻譯: 紅色象徵熱情，而藍色代表平靜。

例句: The percentage of Black, Asian, and Hispanic students has more than doubled, increasing my school’s racial diversity.
翻譯: 黑人、亞洲人和西班牙裔學生的比例成長一倍，增加我們學校的種族多樣性。

例句: Pyramids are evidence showing that ancient civilizations once existed in Egypt.
翻譯: 金字塔是古代文明曾經存在於埃及的證據。
詞形變化: v.過去式：existed；過去分詞：existed；現在分詞：existing

例句: Some people doubt the existence of life on other planets, while others strongly believe in it.
翻譯: 有些人懷疑其他行星上是否存在生命，而另一些人則堅信其存在。

例句: After Mike transferred to the school, his acceptance into the class brought him a sense of relief.
翻譯: Mike轉學到這所學校後，他被班上接納讓他有一種如釋重負的感覺。

例句: The acceptance of the terms and conditions is required before you proceed with the online registration.
翻譯: 線上註冊之前，需要接受條款和條件。

例句: This research article highlights the benefits of exercising every day, and it encourages daily workouts.
翻譯: 這篇研究文章強調了每天鍛煉的好處，並鼓勵天天運動。

例句: Whale watching was the highlight of the boat trip. It was the most amazing thing to see these huge animals up close.
翻譯: 賞鯨是這次船遊的亮點。近距離觀看這些巨大的動物是最令人驚奇的事情。

例句: The economist warned of an imbalance in the trade relationship between the two countries, with one exporting significantly more than importing.
翻譯: 經濟學家告誡兩國貿易關係不平衡，其中一國的出口遠遠超過進口。

例句: It is essential for an employee to keep a balance between work and personal well-being.
翻譯: 員工保持工作與個人幸福間的平衡是至關重要的。

例句: It is important for athletes to balance training and relaxation in order not to risk physical and mental injuries.
翻譯: 對於運動員來說，平衡訓練和放鬆是非常重要的，以免冒身心受傷的風險。

例句: The managers avoided any gender bias when choosing new employees for the company.
翻譯: 經理們在選擇公司新員工時避免任何性別偏見。

例句: This newspaper biases its readers against the ruling party. Many headlines about the government consist of complaints.
翻譯: 這家報紙對執政黨持有偏見，許多關於政府的標題都充滿抱怨。

例句: Prejudice in the workplace can affect hiring practices and career advancement.
翻譯: 工作場所的偏見可能會影響招聘和升職。

例句: Anna is determined to tackle this math problem on her own. She believes that she can solve it in five minutes.
翻譯: Anna下定決心要自己解決這個數學問題。她相信她可以在五分鐘內解決它。
詞形變化: v.過去式：tackled；過去分詞：tackled；現在分詞：tackling | n.複數：tackles

例句: Both Academic Writing and The Plays of Shakespeare are in the English curriculum, but only the former is a required subject.
翻譯: 英文課程中包含《學術寫作》和《莎士比亞的劇作》，但只有前者是必修科目。

中譯: (教學或活動所需的) 材料，用具
例句: Gary is busy preparing reading materials for the Read-Aloud Competition, including stories, poems, and essays.
翻譯: Gary忙於為朗讀比賽準備閱讀資料，包括故事、詩歌和文章。

例句: Wood is a popular building material in the US, and most houses are built with it.
翻譯: 木材是美國常用的建築材料，大多數房屋都是用它建造的。

例句: Mr. and Mrs. Tenet want to expose their child to art, so they encourage their son to visit galleries and learn painting.
翻譯: Tenet夫婦希望讓他們的孩子接觸藝術，所以他們鼓勵兒子參觀畫廊並學習繪畫。
詞形變化: v.過去式：exposed；過去分詞：exposed；現在分詞：exposing
