例句: The plumber dug up the floor to expose the water pipes under it.
翻譯: 水管工人挖開地板，使地板下的水管露出。
詞形變化: v.過去式：exposed；過去分詞：exposed；現在分詞：exposing

例句: Early exposure to educational programs can positively influence a child’s cognitive development.
翻譯: 早期接觸教育性節目可以正面影響兒童的認知發展。

例句: When a designer works on a new product, they have to remember to look at it from the consumers’ viewpoints.
翻譯: 當設計師致力於新產品時，他們必須記住從消費者的角度來看待此產品。

例句: This movie was written to overthrow the stereotype that being a writer is an easy career.
翻譯: 這部電影的創作目的在於推翻一個刻板印象，即作家是一個輕鬆的職業。

例句: The report recommended that the government take more measures to encourage sustainable development.
翻譯: 報告建議政府採取更多措施促進永續發展。

例句: Each student must be measured for the new uniform to fit properly.
翻譯: 每個學生都必須測量新校服的尺寸，以確保其合身。
詞形變化: v.過去式：measured；過去分詞：measured；現在分詞：measuring | n.複數：measures

例句: Good communication helps prevent the gap between generations from widening.
翻譯: 良好的溝通有助於防止世代差距擴大。
詞形變化: v.過去式：widened；過去分詞：widened；現在分詞：widening

例句: The mayor planned to widen the main roads so as to solve traffic problems occurring in the city center.
翻譯: 市長計畫加寬主幹道，以解決市中心出現的交通問題。
詞形變化: v.過去式：widened；過去分詞：widened；現在分詞：widening

例句: Many students are choosing to study STEM subjects because they offer great career opportunities in the future.
翻譯: 許多學生選擇學習 STEM 科目，因為它們在未來提供很好的職業機會。

例句: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights outlines the basic rights and freedoms everyone should have.
翻譯: 《世界人權宣言》闡明了每個人都應享有的基本權利和自由。

例句: Music is often considered a universal language because it can be understood and enjoyed by people everywhere.
翻譯: 音樂常被視為一種普世語言，因為它能被各地的人們理解和欣賞。

例句: Astronomers use powerful telescopes to study the vastness of the universe and discover new planets.
翻譯: 天文學家使用強大的望遠鏡來研究浩瀚的宇宙並發現新行星。

例句: The country made a public declaration of its commitment to protecting the environment at the summit.
翻譯: 該國在峰會上公開聲明其保護環境的承諾。

例句: The principal will declare the winner of the school's talent show at the assembly tomorrow morning.
翻譯: 校長將在明天早上的集會上宣布學校才藝表演的獲勝者。

例句: The United Nations works to promote peace and cooperation among countries around the world.
翻譯: 聯合國致力於促進世界各國之間的和平與合作。

例句: The students presented a united front to the principal, asking for more extracurricular activities.
翻譯: 學生們向校長展現了團結一致的立場，要求增加課外活動。

例句: The community decided to unite and work together to clean up the local park next weekend.
翻譯: 社區決定團結起來，下週末一起清理當地公園。
詞形變化: v.過去式：united；過去分詞：united；現在分詞：uniting

例句: Every nation has its own unique culture, traditions, and history that make it special.
翻譯: 每個國家都有其獨特的文化、傳統和歷史，使其與眾不同。

例句: Joining extracurricular activities like sports clubs or debate teams can enhance your school life.
翻譯: 參加體育社團或辯論隊等課外活動可以豐富你的學校生活。

中譯: 西班牙的；(尤指拉丁美洲) 西班牙語國家的
例句: Many Hispanic countries celebrate Día de los Muertos, a vibrant holiday honoring deceased loved ones.
翻譯: 許多西班牙語系國家慶祝亡靈節，這是一個紀念逝去親人的熱鬧節日。

例句: UNESCO works to protect world heritage sites and promote education, science, and culture globally.
翻譯: 聯合國教科文組織致力於保護世界遺產，並在全球推廣教育、科學和文化。

例句: Climate change is a serious worldwide issue that requires cooperation from all countries to solve.
翻譯: 氣候變遷是一個嚴重的全球性問題，需要所有國家合作才能解決。

例句: The new smartphone model was launched worldwide and quickly became popular among young people.
翻譯: 這款新型智慧型手機在全球發布後，迅速受到年輕人的歡迎。

例句: Many tourists visit Australia to see its unique wildlife, like kangaroos and koalas, and beautiful beaches.
翻譯: 許多遊客造訪澳洲是為了觀賞其獨特的野生動物，如袋鼠和無尾熊，以及美麗的海灘。

例句: My friend is planning a trip to see the beautiful Australian beaches next summer.
翻譯: 我的朋友計畫明年夏天去看看美麗的澳洲海灘。

例句: I met an Australian who was traveling around Taiwan and really enjoyed the local food.
翻譯: 我遇到一位正在台灣旅行的澳洲人，他非常喜歡當地的食物。

例句: We should incorporate more group activities into our study plan to make learning more fun.
翻譯: 我們應該在學習計畫中加入更多的小組活動，讓學習更有趣。

例句: The museum has a special exhibition about the history and culture of the indigenous people of Taiwan.
翻譯: 博物館有一個關於台灣原住民歷史和文化的特別展覽。

例句: Many young athletes look up to their coaches as important role models in their lives.
翻譯: 許多年輕運動員視他們的教練為生命中重要的榜樣。

例句: Our school tries to create an inclusive environment where every student feels welcome and respected.
翻譯: 我們學校努力創造一個廣納多元的環境，讓每個學生都感到受歡迎和被尊重。

例句: The puzzle pieces fit together perfectly to make up a complete picture of a beautiful landscape.
翻譯: 拼圖塊完美地拼合在一起，組成了一幅美麗的風景畫。

例句: When I was struggling to choose my major in college, reading Robert Frost’s poem, The Road Not Taken, gave me inspiration and food for thought.
翻譯: 當我在掙扎要選什麼為大學主修時，羅伯特‧弗羅斯特的詩集中，《未選之路》令我深思。

例句: Emily takes the weather into consideration when deciding on a date to go to the beach because she wants to enjoy a sunny day.
翻譯: Emily會考量天氣狀況決定去海灘的日子，因為她想要享受陽光明媚的一天。

中譯: 阻礙…的發展，妨礙…的進展；阻擋，阻攔
例句: The publisher held back information about the new book before it was put on the market.
翻譯: 在新書上市之前，出版商對該書的相關資訊進行了保留。

中譯: 阻礙…的發展，妨礙…的進展；阻擋，阻攔
例句: The old man couldn’t hold back his tears after reading this sad story.
翻譯: 這位老人讀完這個悲傷的故事後忍不住流下了眼淚。

例句: Because of his love for art, Jason worked as a volunteer at the art museum on weekends.
翻譯: 由於對藝術的熱愛，Jason在週末擔任藝術博物館的志工。

例句: Even though nobody had asked Rachel to clean up the trash on the beach, she volunteered to do so.
翻譯: 即使沒有人要求Rachel清理海灘上的垃圾，她自願這麼做。

例句: My whole weekend was occupied with this novel. It was so exciting that I just couldn’t put it down.
翻譯: 我整個週末都被這本小說占據了。它太令人興奮了，我根本停不下來。

例句: During World War II, the Netherlands was swiftly occupied by the German army.
翻譯: 在二戰期間，荷蘭迅速被德國軍隊占領。

例句: John explored various career opportunities before finally choosing an occupation as a computer engineer.
翻譯: John在最後選擇成為一名電腦工程師之前，探索了各種不同的職業機會。

例句: I used to walk to school because it was less than one kilometer from my house.
翻譯: 我過去經常走路去上學，因為學校距離我家不到一公里。

例句: The types of food products sold at that supermarket are too numerous to be listed. Canned food, vegetables, and seafood are just three examples.
翻譯: 那家超市出售的食品種類繁多，無法一一列舉。罐頭食品、蔬菜和海鮮只是其中的三個例子。

例句: It amazed me that this girl was able to become a high school student at the age of six.
翻譯: 這個女孩六歲就能成為高中生，這讓我感到非常驚訝。
詞形變化: v.過去式：amazed；過去分詞：amazed；現在分詞：amazing

例句: The children watched the fireworks in amazement, and their eyes were wide with wonder and excitement.
翻譯: 孩子們驚奇地觀看煙火，他們的眼睛洋溢著驚訝和興奮。

例句: Mr. James is a resourceful manager who always knows how to handle tough situations and satisfy every customer.
翻譯: James先生是一位足智多謀的經理，他總是知道如何處理棘手的情況，並滿足每一位客戶。

例句: That country is rich in natural resources. It has a lot of oil and natural gas.
翻譯: 那個國家擁有豐富的自然資源。它有大量的石油和天然氣。

例句: Unlike traditional houses which are made of wood, modern apartment buildings are usually constructed with concrete.
翻譯: 不同於傳統的木造房屋，現代公寓大樓通常用混凝土建造。

例句: The clear fingerprints served as concrete evidence and helped the police solve the crime.
翻譯: 那些清晰的指紋是具體證據，幫助警方偵破案件。

例句: The brick wall protected the house from the strong winds of the storm.
翻譯: 磚牆保護房子免受暴風雨的強風。
詞形變化: v.過去式：bricked；過去分詞：bricked；現在分詞：bricking | n.複數：bricks

例句: The noise of the car alarm suddenly broke the silence of the night, waking up everyone in the quiet neighborhood.
翻譯: 汽車警報器的聲音突然打破了夜晚的寧靜，喚醒了寧靜社區中的每個人。
字尾: -hood (state/condition of being (處於某種身分或狀態))

例句: My neighbor is a friendly person who always waves when we pass each other in the morning.
翻譯: 我的鄰居是一個友善的人。每天早晨當我們相遇時，他總是會揮手致意。
詞形變化: v.過去式：neighbored；過去分詞：neighbored；現在分詞：neighboring | n.複數：neighbors

例句: Most of the freshmen in this high school imagined their school principal to be very serious, but she is actually quite humorous.
翻譯: 這所高中大多數的新生都想像他們的校長會非常嚴肅，但她其實相當幽默。

例句: The author used her vivid imagination to create a magical world in her new book.
翻譯: 這位作者運用她豐富的想像力在她的新書中創造了一個魔幻的世界。

例句: A dragon is an imaginary creature. It can’t be found in the real world.
翻譯: 龍是一種虛構的生物，在現實世界中無法找到。

例句: The teacher is very imaginative. He can make up hundreds of fairy tales to tell his students.
翻譯: 這位老師非常富有想像力，他能編造數百個童話故事來給學生們講述。

例句: The charity aims to supply families in need with essential food items during the holiday season.
翻譯: 這個慈善機構的目標是在假日期間，向有需要的家庭提供必要的食品。

例句: Because of a reliable partnership with a local farm, the store has a steady supply of fresh fruit and vegetables.
翻譯: 由於與當地農場可信賴的合作關係，這家商店擁有穩定鮮果和鮮蔬的供應。

例句: There aren’t any hospitals nearby. If we need to see a doctor, we have to drive for an hour.
翻譯: 附近沒有任何醫院。如果我們需要看醫生，就必須開車一小時。

例句: Instead of going to the nearby supermarket, my mother likes to do her grocery shopping at a hypermarket far away because the products there are usually cheaper.
翻譯: 我母親喜歡到遠處的大賣場購物，而不是去附近的超市，因為那裡的商品通常比較便宜。

例句: After a ten-minute search for a parking spot, I finally found one, but I had to squeeze into it between two large trucks.
翻譯: 在尋找停車位十分鐘後，我終於找到了一個，但我必須擠進兩輛大卡車的中間。

例句: Before the cook served the steamed fish, he squeezed some lemon juice onto it.
翻譯: 在廚師上清蒸魚之前，他在上面擠了些檸檬汁。

例句: Seeing me nervous about giving the presentation in front of the class, my team member gave me a comforting squeeze on the arm.
翻譯: 看到我在全班面前緊張地進行演講，我的隊友給了我一個安慰的擁抱。

例句: The new library fulfills a need for a welcoming space to study and relax.
翻譯: 新圖書館滿足了對於學習和放鬆的友好環境的需求。

例句: The little house in the country was the fulfillment of David’s dream.
翻譯: 那鄉間的小房子是David夢想的實現。

例句: People living in this area are scared of the increase in violent crime, such as robbery and murder.
翻譯: 這個地區的居民對於暴力犯罪，如搶劫和謀殺的增加，感到恐懼。

例句: Many people in the United States took to the streets to protest police violence against black people.
翻譯: 許多美國人走上街頭抗議警察針對黑人的暴力行為。

例句: Talking about political events can occasionally cause arguments because of the different opinions people hold.
翻譯: 談論政治事件可能偶爾會引起爭議，因為人們持有不同的意見。

例句: Holly made occasional visits to Taichung during her long stay in Changhua. She went there a few times over two years.
翻譯: Holly在彰化久留的期間偶爾會造訪臺中。在這兩年中，她去了好幾次。

例句: My grandmother only uses these plates on special occasions such as birthdays and festivals.
翻譯: 我的奶奶只在特殊場合，如生日和節慶時，才會使用這些碟子。
詞形變化: v.過去式：occasioned；過去分詞：occasioned；現在分詞：occasioning | n.複數：occasions

例句: The narrow path through the forest was barely wide enough for one person to pass at a time.
翻譯: 森林中狹窄的小徑一次幾乎只夠一個人通過。

例句: Trying to read the tiny print, the old man narrowed his eyes in concentration.
翻譯: 老人瞇起眼睛，專注地閱讀細小的字體。

例句: After Claire transferred to a new school, she gave her teacher some homemade cookies as a friendly gesture.
翻譯: Claire轉到新學校後，她送給老師一些自製的餅乾，作為一種友好的表示。

例句: A good speaker is skilled in using body language like gestures and facial expressions to attract the audience’s attention.
翻譯: 一位優秀的演講者擅長運用身體語言，如手勢和面部表情，來吸引觀眾的注意力。

例句: Inflation results in an increase in the general price level of goods and services, leading to rising living expenses.
翻譯: 通貨膨脹導致商品和服務的價格上升，從而導致生活開銷上漲。

例句: These rooftop solar panels help people in this apartment complex generate clean energy.
翻譯: 這些屋頂的太陽能板幫助這棟公寓的居民產生乾淨的能源。

例句: Covered in clouds, the top of the skyscraper couldn’t be seen clearly from the ground.
翻譯: 由於被雲層遮蔽，從地面看不太清楚摩天大樓的頂部。

例句: The contrast between the bustling city streets and the peaceful countryside is obvious.
翻譯: 熙攘的城市街道和寧靜的鄉村間的對比顯而易見。

例句: The report contrasts the company’s current performance with its performance from five years ago, showing significant improvements in market share.
翻譯: 這份報告將公司當前的表現與五年前的表現進行對比，顯示市占率有顯著改善。

例句: Selling oil has brought great wealth to some Middle Eastern countries, such as Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and the United Arab Emirates.
翻譯: 對於一些中東國家，如沙烏地阿拉伯、伊拉克和阿拉伯聯合大公國來說，販賣石油為他們帶來了巨大的財富。

例句: Although Stacey comes from a wealthy family, she never wastes her money on anything that she doesn’t need.
翻譯: 儘管Stacey家庭富裕，但她從不將錢浪費在她不需要的東西上。

例句: Ruby has always been generous to her friends. For her best friend’s birthday, Ruby treated her to a surprise dinner.
翻譯: Ruby對待她的朋友一直都慷慨大方。在她最好的朋友生日時，Ruby請她吃了一頓驚喜晚餐。

例句: Mother Teresa showed generosity to people in need, making her a role model for teenagers around the world.
翻譯: 德蕾莎修女對有需要的人表現出慷慨，使她成為世界各地青少年的榜樣。

例句: Many residents of the favela work hard every day to improve their living conditions and build a better future.
翻譯: 許多貧民窟的居民每天努力工作，以改善他們的生活條件並創造更美好的未來。

例句: Rocinha is one of the largest favelas in Rio de Janeiro, known for its vibrant community spirit.
翻譯: 羅西尼亞是里約熱內盧最大的貧民窟之一，以其充滿活力的社區精神而聞名。

例句: Brazil is famous for its beautiful rainforests, lively carnivals, and passionate football culture.
翻譯: 巴西以其美麗的雨林、熱鬧的嘉年華和熱情的足球文化而聞名。

例句: Health officials are working to prevent the spread of dengue fever by educating people about mosquito control.
翻譯: 衛生官員正努力透過教育民眾蚊蟲防治來預防登革熱的傳播。

例句: It can be challenging for an outsider to understand all the local customs and traditions immediately.
翻譯: 對於一個外來者來說，要立即理解所有當地習俗和傳統可能很有挑戰性。

例句: The police are trying to reduce crime rates and prevent young people from joining a gang.
翻譯: 警方正努力降低犯罪率，並防止年輕人加入幫派。

例句: In some parts of Brazil, a kombi is a common and affordable way for people to travel short distances.
翻譯: 在巴西某些地區，小型公共公車是一種常見且經濟實惠的短途旅行方式。

例句: Rio de Janeiro is famous for its stunning beaches, vibrant carnival, and iconic Christ the Redeemer statue.
翻譯: 里約熱內盧以其令人驚嘆的海灘、充滿活力的嘉年華和標誌性的基督救世主雕像而聞名。

例句: We took a scenic route through the mountains to enjoy the breathtaking views of the countryside.
翻譯: 我們走了一條風景優美的山路，欣賞了令人驚嘆的鄉村景色。
詞形變化: adj.比較級：more scenic；最高級：most scenic

中譯: (建築物在天空映襯下的) 空中輪廓
例句: From the top of Taipei 101, you can see the impressive skyline of the entire city.
翻譯: 從台北101的頂端，你可以看到整個城市令人印象深刻的空中輪廓。

例句: The child held onto his mother’s hand tightly as if he feared he would get lost in the crowded mall.
翻譯: 孩子緊緊抓住母親的手，彷彿害怕在擁擠的商場走失。

例句: Hearing the sound of the MRT train coming, Jessica ran down the stairs two steps at a time.
翻譯: 聽到捷運到站的聲音，Jessica一次下了兩階樓梯。

中譯: 作為 (對某事的) 回報
例句: Sue helped me with my project, and, in return, I offered to assist her with her essay which was due the following week.
翻譯: Sue幫助我完成專案，作為回報，我主動提出協助她下週截止的論文。

例句: The benefits of doing sports go beyond improved physical health. Regular exercise also has positive effects on mental well-being.
翻譯: 運動的好處不只侷限於改善身體健康。定期鍛鍊還對心理健康產生正面影響。

例句: The recent economic crisis and rising food prices have caused many restaurants in town to go out of business.
翻譯: 最近的經濟危機和食品價格上漲導致該城鎮許多餐廳倒閉。

例句: When Luke feels blue, he always takes comfort from his friends’ words.
翻譯: 當Luke感到沮喪時，他總是從朋友的話語中得到安慰。

例句: Alan finds it interesting to study historical events, such as the Industrial Revolution.
翻譯: Alan發現研究歷史事件，如工業革命，很有趣。

例句: The president’s visit to our small town was a historic day that will be remembered by the community.
翻譯: 總統拜訪我們小鎮的那一天是一個歷史性的日子，將被社區銘記在心。
詞形變化: adj.比較級：more historic；最高級：most historic

例句: The historian is carefully examining the sword to find out whether it belonged to a noble person.
翻譯: 歷史學家正在仔細檢查這把劍，以確認它是否屬於一位貴族。

例句: A sudden clap of thunder terrified the baby, causing him to cry.
翻譯: 一聲突然的雷鳴嚇到了嬰兒，使他哭了起來。

中譯: 非常害怕的，飽受驚嚇的
例句: Crime rates in this town have risen so alarmingly fast that people are now terrified of walking alone outside after dark.
翻譯: 這個鎮的犯罪率上升非常快速，導致人們對夜晚獨自在外行走感到恐懼。

例句: This manual isn’t helpful. It contains too many challenging words and unclear instructions that confuse lots of people.
翻譯: 這個手冊並不實用。它含有太多困難的詞彙和不清晰的指示，困惑了許多人。

例句: The news article created confusion about the murder. It reported different information from what the police reported.
翻譯: 這篇新聞文章讓人對謀殺案感到困惑。它報導的資訊與警方報導的不同。

例句: Regularly bathing your dog and constantly washing its bedding are good ways to prevent flea bites.
翻譯: 定期給狗洗澡並且經常洗牠的寢具是防止跳蚤叮咬的好方法。

例句: By coughing, people can transmit a virus to people nearby.
翻譯: 人們藉由咳嗽將病毒傳播給附近的人。

例句: The Wi-Fi signal doesn’t transmit through brick walls well, so the internet connection in my bedroom is weak.
翻譯: Wi-Fi 訊號在穿透磚牆時效果不佳，因此我房間的網路連接很弱。

例句: Lightning storms often interrupt the transmission of television and radio shows.
翻譯: 雷陣雨通常會中斷電視和收音機節目的播送。

例句: People with the flu should wear a mask and stay away from crowds to prevent themselves from infecting others with the disease.
翻譯: 患有流感的人應該戴口罩並遠離人群，以防止將疾病傳染給其他人。

例句: The nurse emphasized the importance of hand washing to reduce the risk of infection in the hospital.
翻譯: 護士強調洗手的重要性，以減少醫院感染的風險。

例句: The flu is highly infectious, and it is spread through close contact with someone carrying the virus.
翻譯: 流感具有高度的傳染性，通常透過與攜帶病毒的人密切接觸而傳播。

例句: Because of its peculiar smell, many foreign visitors are unwilling to try stinky tofu, even though it’s a popular snack in Taiwan.
翻譯: 因為臭豆腐特有的氣味，許多外國遊客不願嘗試，即便它在臺灣是受歡迎的小吃。

例句: Throughout history, art has been an important reflection of the diverse cultures that make up humanity.
翻譯: 在歷史上，藝術一直是構成人類多樣文化的重要反映。

例句: The bombing not only frightened the people but also caused severe harm and even death to some of them.
翻譯: 這次爆炸不僅使人們感到恐懼，還造成一些嚴重的傷亡。

例句: The lack of a life jacket proved to be fatal for the inexperienced swimmer.
翻譯: 對於缺乏經驗的游泳者來說，沒有救生衣是致命的。

例句: After conducting hundreds of tests, the scientists finally developed a new method to control the illness.
翻譯: 在進行了數百次試驗後，科學家們終於開發出了一種新方法來控制這種疾病。

例句: Rebecca ate some undercooked seafood and became ill with a stomachache.
翻譯: Rebecca吃了一些未煮熟的海鮮後，感到胃痛。

例句: To prevent sharp objects or dangerous chemicals from being taken aboard, every passenger’s bag must be checked at the airport.
翻譯: 為了防止銳利物品或危險化學物品被攜帶上飛機，每位乘客的行李都必須在機場進行檢查。

例句: Patricia’s parents have confidence in her. They believe she can take good care of herself when they are away.
翻譯: Patricia的父母對她充滿信心。他們相信當他們不在身邊時，她能夠照顧好自己。

例句: The teacher always encourages his students to be confident about themselves when they answer questions.
翻譯: 老師總是鼓勵學生在回答問題時對自己有信心。
詞形變化: adj.比較級：more confident；最高級：most confident

例句: John’s company collapsed when he lost all of his money, leaving him homeless.
翻譯: John的公司倒閉後，他破產了，使他無家可歸。

例句: The old building collapsed under the weight of the heavy snow.
翻譯: 在大雪的重壓下，這棟老舊的建築崩塌了。

例句: The war caused the collapse of many small businesses in the community.
翻譯: 戰爭導致了社區中許多小企業倒閉。

例句: While food can meet the needs of your body, art and knowledge can satisfy your spiritual needs.
翻譯: 食物可以滿足身體的需求，而藝術和知識可以滿足你精神上的需求。

例句: In the spirit of cooperation, Alfred would always help us with our work.
翻譯: 在合作的精神下，Alfred總是會幫助我們完成工作。
詞形變化: v.過去式：spirited；過去分詞：spirited；現在分詞：spiriting | n.複數：spirits

例句: It’s crucial for companies to retain employees by offering attractive benefits.
翻譯: 公司提供有吸引力的福利來留住員工是至關重要的。

例句: Every faith has unique beliefs and customs, giving a sense of community to its followers.
翻譯: 每個宗教都有其獨特的信念和習俗，為其追隨者帶來社群歸屬感。

例句: Despite all the failures she has experienced, Naomi refuses to give up and never loses faith in herself.
翻譯: 儘管經歷了許多失敗，Naomi拒絕放棄且永遠不失去對自己的信念。

例句: At their wedding ceremony, the bride and the groom exchanged rings and promised to be faithful to each other forever.
翻譯: 在他們的婚禮上，新娘和新郎交換了戒指，並承諾永遠忠誠於彼此。

中譯: 相似之處，可互相比擬的事物
例句: There are so many parallels between the two robberies that the police suspect they were committed by the same gang.
翻譯: 兩起搶劫案之間存在著如此多的相似之處，警方懷疑它們是同一個幫派所為。

例句: Maple Street is parallel to Walnut Street. Therefore, you need to turn left at the next traffic light to get there.
翻譯: 楓樹街與核桃街平行。因此，你需要在下一個紅綠燈左轉才能到達。

例句: The new phenomenon of working from home, which blurs the line between work and personal life, has sparked complaints from both workers and their bosses.
翻譯: 在家工作的新現象模糊了工作與個人生活之間的界限，這引發了勞工和老闆們的抱怨。

例句: Global warming has caused sea levels to rise worldwide, posing a significant threat to low-lying countries like Tuvalu.
翻譯: 全球暖化導致全球海平面上升，對國土低窪的國家，如吐瓦魯，造成了重大威脅。

例句: Seventy percent of the globe’s surface is covered with water.
翻譯: 地球表面的70%被水覆蓋著。

中譯: 瘟疫，大規模流行的疾病
例句: The recent pandemic affected people all over the world, changing many aspects of daily life.
翻譯: 最近的瘟疫影響了全世界的人們，改變了日常生活的許多方面。

例句: During the COVID-19 pandemic, wearing masks and washing hands frequently became very important.
翻譯: 在新型冠狀病毒肺炎疫情期間，戴口罩和勤洗手變得非常重要。

例句: After playing in the rain, the child felt feverish and had to stay home from school the next day.
翻譯: 在雨中玩耍後，孩子感到發燒，第二天不得不請假在家。

中譯: 黑死病 (十四世紀造成歐亞區域死亡慘重的鼠疫)
例句: Historians study the Black Death to understand how past pandemics impacted societies and led to major changes.
翻譯: 歷史學家研究黑死病，以了解過去的瘟疫如何影響社會並導致重大變革。

例句: We learned about knights and castles during the Middle Ages in our history class today.
翻譯: 我們今天的歷史課學到了中世紀的騎士和城堡。

例句: The old town still has some beautiful medieval buildings that attract many tourists.
翻譯: 這座古鎮仍然有一些美麗的中世紀建築，吸引了許多遊客。

例句: The parrot used its strong beak to crack open the hard nuts.
翻譯: 這隻鸚鵡用牠堅硬的喙來敲開堅果。

例句: The old, abandoned house had a sinister atmosphere that made us feel uneasy.
翻譯: 那棟老舊的廢棄房屋散發著不祥的氣氛，讓我們感到不安。

例句: The government is trying to combat the spread of misinformation on social media.
翻譯: 政府正試圖打擊社群媒體上不實資訊的傳播。

例句: We need to take drastic measures to reduce our plastic waste and protect the environment.
翻譯: 我們需要採取激烈的措施來減少塑膠垃圾並保護環境。

中譯: 給予 (某人)做…的權力，使能夠
例句: Education can empower young people to make informed decisions about their future.
翻譯: 教育能賦予年輕人權力，讓他們對未來做出明智的決定。

例句: Barry fought off his cold by drinking plenty of warm water and getting sufficient rest, and he is now feeling better.
翻譯: Barry藉由多喝溫水和充足休息來擊退感冒，現在他感覺好多了。

例句: I need to catch up on what happened while I was away.
翻譯: 我需要更新我離開間發生的事情。

例句: Lionel Messi, one of the leading members of the Argentina national team, is a world-famous athlete.
翻譯: 萊納爾‧梅西，阿根廷國家代表隊的主要成員之一，是一位世界著名的運動員。

例句: Having played football for many years, Randy looks tall, strong, and athletic.
翻譯: 由於踢了足球那麼多年，Randy看起來又高又壯，並有運動員的體格。
詞形變化: adj.比較級：more athletic；最高級：most athletic

例句: It is advisable that one eat a high protein diet after lifting weights to build muscle.
翻譯: 建議在舉重後食用高蛋白以增強肌肉。
詞形變化: v.過去式：muscled；過去分詞：muscled；現在分詞：muscling | n.複數：muscles

例句: To help me lose weight, my fitness trainer made a daily workout plan.
翻譯: 為了幫助我減重，我的健身教練制定了一份每日的運動計畫。

例句: Getting into a routine of daily activities helps prevent me from forgetting to do things and panicking.
翻譯: 執行每日的例行公事有助於防止我忘記做事情而感到驚慌。

例句: When the singer is on a concert tour, he avoids eating spicy food to keep his throat in peak condition.
翻譯: 這位歌手進行巡迴演唱會時，他避免食用辛辣食物，以保持喉嚨處於最佳狀態。

例句: The writer won three Pulitzer Prizes in a row. She is at the peak of her career.
翻譯: 這位作家連續三次贏得普立茲獎。她正處於事業的巔峰。

例句: Since people tend to take vacations during the summer, prices of airline tickets always peak in July.
翻譯: 由於人們傾向於夏季度假，航空公司機票價格總是在七月達到最高峰。

例句: The basketball player is on the road to recovery and can soon return for the next season.
翻譯: 這位籃球運動員正在復原的路上，很快就能在下一個賽季回歸。

例句: After two weeks of coughing and having a runny nose, Rick has finally fully recovered from the flu.
翻譯: 經過兩個星期的咳嗽和流鼻水，Rick終於從流感中完全康復了。

例句: Thankfully, both drivers in the car accident only received minor injuries and didn’t need to stay in the hospital for long.
翻譯: 幸運的是，車禍中的兩位駕駛只受到輕傷，並且不需要在醫院待很長時間。

例句: The typhoon caused trees to fall and injured many people.
翻譯: 颱風導致樹木倒塌，傷及許多人。
詞形變化: v.過去式：injured；過去分詞：injured；現在分詞：injuring

例句: Louis has stiff legs because he just ran a marathon yesterday. He needs to rest for a few days.
翻譯: Louis因為昨天剛跑完馬拉松，所以腿僵硬了。他需要休息幾天。
詞形變化: v.過去式：stiffed；過去分詞：stiffed；現在分詞：stiffing | n.複數：stiffs | adj.比較級：stiffer；最高級：stiffest

例句: The farmer’s pants became stiff because they were covered in dirt and mud.
翻譯: 農夫的褲子因沾滿了泥土和泥漿而變得硬梆梆的。
詞形變化: v.過去式：stiffed；過去分詞：stiffed；現在分詞：stiffing | n.複數：stiffs | adj.比較級：stiffer；最高級：stiffest

例句: Many people in Taiwan like to eat Western food like hamburgers and spaghetti.
翻譯: 許多臺灣人喜歡吃西式食物，如漢堡和義大利麵。

例句: Countries in the western part of Europe include France, Germany, and the United Kingdom.
翻譯: 歐洲西部的國家包括法國、德國和英國。

例句: The nurse carefully wrapped a bandage around the student’s elbow to keep the broken bone stable.
翻譯: 護士小心地將繃帶繞在學生的肘部，以保持斷裂的骨頭穩定。

中譯: 用繃帶包紮 (傷口或身體部位)
例句: Mike accidentally cut his finger when using the scissors, so he carefully bandaged his wound to prevent infection.
翻譯: Mike在使用剪刀時不小心割傷了手指，因此他小心地給傷口裹上繃帶，以防止感染。

例句: The doctor said this cream could reduce the swelling caused by hitting the wall yesterday.
翻譯: 醫生說這種藥膏能減輕昨天撞牆造成的腫脹。

例句: Being bitten by fire ants has caused my arm to start swelling up.
翻譯: 被火蟻咬了後，我的手臂開始腫脹。

例句: Insert a coin into the video game machine, and you will be able to play the game.
翻譯: 將硬幣投入遊戲機，你就可以玩遊戲了。

例句: The doctor carefully stuck the needle into the patient’s arm to draw a blood sample for testing.
翻譯: 醫生小心地將針插入病人的手臂，以提取血樣進行檢測。
詞形變化: v.過去式：needled；過去分詞：needled；現在分詞：needling | n.複數：needles

例句: Jay used a needle and thread to sew the button back on his shirt.
翻譯: Jay使用針和線將鈕扣縫回他的襯衫上。
詞形變化: v.過去式：needled；過去分詞：needled；現在分詞：needling | n.複數：needles

例句: Open the door and turn the fan on to suck the cigarette smoke out, or the smell will fill the room.
翻譯: 打開門和風扇吸出煙霧，否則味道會充滿整個房間。

例句: The baby sucked on the teat, drinking the milk happily.
翻譯: 嬰兒吸著奶嘴，開心地喝牛奶。

例句: The project manager’s careful planning and attention to detail played a key role in the smooth completion of the project.
翻譯: 能順利完成專案，專案經理仔細的計畫和對細節的關注扮演了關鍵角色。

例句: The stone steps of the temple have been worn smooth by the many visitors’ footsteps over the years.
翻譯: 多年來，寺廟的石階被這些眾多遊客的腳步踩得光滑。

例句: The speaker smoothed his hair back before going on stage to make sure that his hair wouldn’t get into his eyes.
翻譯: 演講者在上臺之前將頭髮向後梳理，以確保頭髮不會掉進眼睛裡。

例句: Jessica’s parents had doubt about her passing the challenging exam because they had never seen her study for it.
翻譯: Jessica的父母對她能通過這次有難度的考試感到懷疑，因為他們從未見過她為此努力學習。

例句: Although the salesperson guaranteed that the face cream could fight against signs of aging, I still doubted its effectiveness.
翻譯: 儘管銷售人員保證這款面霜可以抗衰老，但我仍然懷疑其有效性。

例句: I was doubtful about Matthew’s story since he kept avoiding eye contact with me.
翻譯: 我對Matthew的故事感到懷疑，因為他一直避開我的目光。

例句: Older people tend to have bad circulation, which causes their fingers and toes to be cold in winter.
翻譯: 老年人往往循環不佳，導致他們手指和腳趾在冬天變得冰冷。

例句: The cooling system, which makes cold air circulate efficiently, keeps the inside of the car at a comfortable temperature.
翻譯: 冷卻系統使冷空氣有效循環，保持車內溫度舒適。

例句: It’s part of Chinese culture to share dishes rather than have an individual meal, so it is common to see circular dining tables in Chinese restaurants.
翻譯: 中國文化中，人們更傾向於共享菜餚，而不是單獨用餐，因此在中國餐館常見圓形餐桌。

例句: The magician surprised the audience with a simple wave of his hand, which revealed a hidden card from the deck.
翻譯: 這位魔術師僅僅一揮手就讓觀眾大為驚訝，從牌堆中露出了一張隱藏的牌。
詞形變化: v.過去式：revealed；過去分詞：revealed；現在分詞：revealing | n.複數：reveals

例句: The two close friends made a promise never to reveal their secrets to anyone, no matter what happens.
翻譯: 這兩位密友許下承諾，無論發生什麼事，永遠不向任何人透露彼此的秘密。
詞形變化: v.過去式：revealed；過去分詞：revealed；現在分詞：revealing | n.複數：reveals

例句: A computer performs various tasks at the same time, such as running programs, handling tasks in the background, and doing calculations.
翻譯: 電腦同時執行各種任務，如運行程序、處理後臺任務和進行計算。

例句: Connie sang out of tune on purpose when performing the song to make her parents laugh.
翻譯: Connie演唱這首歌時故意唱走音，讓她的父母笑起來。

例句: With all the actors and costumes well-prepared, my class will give a performance of Hamlet for the whole school.
翻譯: 所有演員和服裝都萬事俱備，我們班將為學校演出《哈姆雷特》。

例句: As the country’s tourist industry has been greatly affected by the pandemic, the government is looking for ways to stimulate the economy.
翻譯: 由於疫情對該國的旅遊業產生了很大的影響，政府正在尋找促進經濟的方式。

例句: After Delia took some medicine to relieve the pain in her knees, she felt much better and fell asleep on the sofa.
翻譯: Delia吃了一些藥物來緩解膝蓋的疼痛後，她感覺好多了，然後就在沙發上睡著了。

例句: To my relief, the doctor told me that my sister was fine and would get well soon.
翻譯: 讓我感到欣慰的是，醫生告訴我，我妹妹沒事，很快就會康復。

例句: There is strong competition among hotels in the city center to attract guests.
翻譯: 市中心的酒店為了吸引客人存在激烈的競爭。

例句: This small local business tries to compete with big companies through creative marketing strategies and personalized services.
翻譯: 這家當地小型企業試圖透過創意的行銷策略和客製化服務來與大公司競爭。

例句: Basketball, soccer, and baseball are examples of competitive sports. They usually end with one team winning and the other losing.
翻譯: 籃球、足球和棒球是競技運動的例子。它們通常以一隊獲勝，另一隊失敗而告終。

例句: Because there wasn’t enough time, the organizers had to shorten the meeting and only covered the essential topics.
翻譯: 因為時間不夠，主辦單位必須縮短會議，且只討論了必要的話題。

例句: After my first intense workout, I experienced severe delayed onset muscle soreness for days.
翻譯: 第一次劇烈運動後，我經歷了數天的嚴重延遲性肌肉痠痛。

例句: He felt some discomfort in his knee after running the marathon.
翻譯: 跑完馬拉松後，他感到膝蓋有些不適。

例句: Applying compression to a sprained ankle can help reduce swelling and pain.
翻譯: 對於扭傷的腳踝施加壓力可以幫助減少腫脹和疼痛。

例句: You should compress the wound with a clean cloth to stop the bleeding.
翻譯: 你應該用乾淨的布壓緊傷口以止血。

例句: Doctors recommend elevation of the injured leg to reduce swelling.
翻譯: 醫生建議抬高受傷的腿以減少腫脹。

例句: Please elevate your feet above your heart to help improve circulation.
翻譯: 請將你的腳抬高過心臟，以幫助改善血液循環。

例句: Many people try acupuncture to relieve chronic pain when other treatments don't work.
翻譯: 當其他治療無效時，許多人會嘗試針灸來緩解慢性疼痛。

例句: After intense training, some athletes use cupping therapy to help their muscles recover faster.
翻譯: 經過高強度訓練後，一些運動員會使用拔罐療法來幫助肌肉更快恢復。

例句: Michael Phelps is widely regarded as the greatest swimmer of all time, with many Olympic medals.
翻譯: 麥可．菲爾普斯被廣泛認為是有史以來最偉大的游泳運動員，擁有許多奧運獎牌。

中譯: 奧林匹克運動會，奧運會
例句: Every four years, athletes from all over the world compete in the Olympics.
翻譯: 每四年，來自世界各地的運動員都會在奧運會上競爭。

例句: She dreams of becoming an Olympic athlete and winning a gold medal for her country.
翻譯: 她夢想成為一名奧運選手，並為她的國家贏得一枚金牌。

例句: Taipei hosted the Universiade in 2017, welcoming student athletes from around the globe.
翻譯: 台北於2017年主辦了世界大學生運動會，歡迎來自全球的學生運動員。

例句: Jogging, swimming, and biking can all speed up your heart rate and reduce the chance of heart problems.
翻譯: 慢跑、游泳和騎自行車都能加快心率，減少心臟問題發生的機會。

例句: Many environmental problems we face today stem from unsustainable practices and the overuse of natural resources.
翻譯: 我們今天面臨的許多環境問題源於不可永續的做法和對自然資源的過度使用。

例句: Poor communication often results in misunderstandings and arguments.
翻譯: 糟糕的溝通常導致誤解和爭執。

例句: The teacher encouraged her students to engage in lively discussions to promote critical thinking.
翻譯: 老師鼓勵她的學生參與熱烈的討論，以促進批判性思維。

例句: Daniel didn’t know how to complete the assignment, so he turned to his classmates for guidance.
翻譯: Daniel不知道如何完成作業，所以他向同學尋求指導。

例句: Rita loves spending weekends at home, catching up on her reading and enjoying some quiet time.
翻譯: Rita喜歡在家度過週末，趕上她閱讀的進度，並享受一些寧靜的時光。

例句: The discovery of a gold mine under the castle made the headlines around the country. People nearby were very excited about the news.
翻譯: 在城堡下發現金礦的消息登上了全國的頭條新聞。附近的人們對這個消息非常興奮。

例句: Keep your seat belt on when the bus is in motion so you don’t get badly injured in an accident.
翻譯: 當公車行駛時，請繫好安全帶，這樣在事故中就不會受重傷。
詞形變化: v.過去式：motioned；過去分詞：motioned；現在分詞：motioning | n.複數：motions

例句: The restaurant had a friendly atmosphere, so we felt very relaxed when we ate there.
翻譯: 這家餐廳氣氛愉快，所以我們在那裡用餐時感到非常放鬆。

例句: These factories are releasing dangerous gas into the atmosphere.
翻譯: 這些工廠正在排放危險氣體至大氣層。

例句: The beauty pageant contestants walked on the stage with graceful moves.
翻譯: 選美比賽的參賽者以優雅的動作走上舞臺。

例句: As a member of the royal family, the prince is expected to speak and act with grace.
翻譯: 身為皇室成員，王子被期望以優雅的言行示人。

例句: For the evening event, Ella curled her hair with hot rollers to make it look more attractive.
翻譯: 為了晚宴，Ella使用電棒捲捲曲頭髮，使其看起來更吸引人。

例句: Pop songs usually have catchy melodies that stick in listeners’ minds.
翻譯: 流行歌曲通常有朗朗上口的旋律，會深深留在聽眾的腦海中。

例句: The steady rhythm of the soft song caused the baby to fall asleep.
翻譯: 輕音樂穩定的節奏讓嬰兒入睡。

例句: Lydia drew a cat with smooth strokes of her pencil, making it come alive on the paper.
翻譯: Lydia用鉛筆輕柔的筆觸畫了一隻貓，在紙上栩栩如生。

例句: Last year, my grandfather had a stroke. With treatment, he’s slowly getting stronger and more active again.
翻譯: 去年，我爺爺中風了。經過治療，他慢慢地又變得更強壯、更活躍了。

例句: The director, who has won many awards, makes movies that usually become huge hits.
翻譯: 這位曾獲得許多獎項的導演拍攝的電影通常都大獲成功。

例句: Kelly directs all the activities that take place at the dance club.
翻譯: Kelly負責指導舞蹈社的所有活動。

例句: The detective noticed fresh footprints leading in the direction of the empty building, indicating recent activity in the area.
翻譯: 警探注意到新腳印指向空蕩蕩的建築物，表明該地區最近有活動。

例句: The disease can develop owing to a combination of several factors, including age, gender, and diet.
翻譯: 這種疾病可能是由幾個因素的組合引起的，包括年齡、性別和飲食。

例句: To make a cake, you need to combine some eggs, flour, and milk with baking powder in a big bowl.
翻譯: 要做蛋糕，你需要在一個大碗裡將一些雞蛋、麵粉和牛奶與泡打粉混合在一起。
詞形變化: v.過去式：combined；過去分詞：combined；現在分詞：combining | n.複數：combines

例句: The company’s well-designed website leaves a good impression on its own customers.
翻譯: 公司設計良好的網站給它的客戶留下好印象。

例句: The singer’s excellent performance impressed the audience and gave them a wonderful experience.
翻譯: 歌手出色的表演使觀眾印象深刻，並給他們帶來美妙的體驗。

例句: It has been a real privilege to spend my last three years at this school.
翻譯: 我很榮幸前三年能在這間學校度過。

例句: Priority of service is a privilege given to the elderly at this hospital.
翻譯: 這家醫院給予老年人服務優先權的特權。

例句: The famous writer was invited to attend the opening of the new bookstore and give a short speech there.
翻譯: 那位著名作家受邀參加新書店的開幕典禮並在那裡發表簡短的演講。

例句: With  many tall buildings and ancient temples spread throughout, the city is a perfect blend of the modern and the traditional.
翻譯: 這座城市遍布許多高樓大廈和古老的寺廟，是現代與傳統完美的融合。

例句: Blend the chicken with some garlic and white wine to give it extra flavor.
翻譯: 將雞肉與一些大蒜和白葡萄酒混合在一起，使其味道更加豐富。

例句: Regular practice is a key element in the player’s success in games.
翻譯: 在比賽中，定期練習是球員成功的關鍵要素。

例句: A children’s book must have plenty of drawings in order to be visually appealing to them.
翻譯: 童書必須有大量的插畫，才能在視覺上吸引他們。

例句: Computer technology has helped create the amazing visual effects in movies such as the Marvel series.
翻譯: 電腦技術有助於製作像漫威系列電影中驚人的視覺效果。

例句: The colorful underwater world is fascinating, attracting people who love exploring its beauty.
翻譯: 這個色彩繽紛的水下世界令人著迷，吸引著熱愛探索其美麗的人們。

例句: The bright and colorful illustrations in the book caught the attention of young readers and fascinated them.
翻譯: 書中明亮多彩的插圖吸引了年輕讀者的注意，並使他們著迷。

例句: The tourist didn’t pack a change of clothes because she didn’t intend to spend the night in this town.
翻譯: 這位遊客沒有準備更換的衣服，因為她沒有打算在這個小鎮過夜。

例句: Barton appeared to believe that I was trying to make trouble, which was never my intention.
翻譯: Barton似乎認為我在故意製造麻煩，這從來不是我的意圖。

例句: The team has worked together for ten years, so the members have formed a strong bond.
翻譯: 這個團隊已經共事十年了，所以成員之間形成一種堅定的關係。

例句: I need to fill out a form at the doctor’s office with my personal information and medical history.
翻譯: 我需要在醫生辦公室填寫一份表格，上面包含我的個人資料和病歷。

例句: The teacher explained the formation of a rainbow in today’s physics class.
翻譯: 老師在今天的物理課上解釋了彩虹的結構。

例句: The queen gave elegant waves from her carriage to the people who lined the streets.
翻譯: 女王從她的馬車上向沿街站立的人們優雅地揮手。

例句: After years of research, the scientist won a major award for his important discovery about the human brain.
翻譯: 經過多年的研究，這位科學家因他對人腦的重要發現獲得了一個重要獎項。

例句: These medals will be awarded to those who have made significant contributions to our company over the past years.
翻譯: 這些獎章將授予那些在過去幾年中對我們公司付出重大貢獻的人。

例句: Though studies have demonstrated the health risks of smoking to people, many still can’t kick the bad habit.
翻譯: 儘管研究已經證明吸煙對人們的健康有風險，但許多人仍然無法戒掉這個壞習慣。

例句: Mozart showed exceptional talent for music from his early childhood.
翻譯: 莫札特自幼展現出對音樂的非凡天賦。

例句: The trade agreement allows imports of agricultural products, but pineapples are exceptions.
翻譯: 這項貿易協議允許進口農產品，但鳳梨例外。

例句: My grandmother practices Chinese calligraphy every morning, and her handwriting is truly beautiful.
翻譯: 我的奶奶每天早上練習中國書法，她的字寫得非常漂亮。

例句: My grandfather is a talented calligrapher who can write beautiful Chinese characters with a brush.
翻譯: 我的爺爺是一位才華洋溢的書法家，他能用毛筆寫出漂亮的漢字。

例句: The little girl loved to twirl around in her new dress, feeling like a princess.
翻譯: 小女孩喜歡穿著她的新裙子轉圈，感覺自己像個公主。

例句: The dancers began to whirl across the stage, creating a beautiful and dynamic performance.
翻譯: 舞者們開始在舞台上迴旋，創造出一個美麗而充滿活力的表演。

例句: Everyone in our class tries to live in harmony, respecting each other's opinions and differences.
翻譯: 我們班上的每個人都努力和睦相處，尊重彼此的意見和差異。

例句: The colors in the painting are so harmonious that they create a very pleasant feeling for the viewer.
翻譯: 這幅畫的顏色非常和諧，為觀者帶來一種非常愉悅的感覺。

例句: Cloud Gate Dance Theatre's "Wild Cursive" is a renowned performance that combines traditional calligraphy with modern dance.
翻譯: 雲門舞集的《狂草》是一場結合傳統書法與現代舞的著名表演。

例句: In elementary school, we learned how to write in cursive, connecting all the letters in a word.
翻譯: 在小學時，我們學會了寫草書，將一個單字裡的所有字母連起來。

例句: Cloud Gate Dance Theatre is famous for its unique blend of traditional Asian aesthetics and contemporary dance.
翻譯: 雲門舞集以其獨特的傳統亞洲美學與當代舞蹈融合而聞名。

例句: "The Lord of the Rings" is a famous fantasy trilogy that many people enjoy reading or watching.
翻譯: 《魔戒》是一部著名的奇幻三部曲，許多人都喜歡閱讀或觀看。

例句: You can clearly see each brushstroke in Van Gogh's paintings, which gives them a unique texture.
翻譯: 你可以在梵谷的畫作中清楚地看到每一筆筆觸，這賦予了它們獨特的質感。

例句: The beautiful mountain scenery served as a perfect backdrop for the outdoor concert.
翻譯: 美麗的山景成為戶外音樂會的完美背景布幕。

例句: The singer felt nervous before going onstage, but once the music started, she felt confident.
翻譯: 這位歌手在上台表演前感到緊張，但音樂一開始，她就充滿了自信。

例句: Everyone was amazed by the brilliance of the young scientist who discovered a new way to solve the problem.
翻譯: 這位年輕科學家發現了解決問題的新方法，他的才華讓所有人驚嘆不已。

例句: My physics teacher is brilliant; he can explain complex concepts in a way that everyone understands.
翻譯: 我的物理老師非常聰穎；他能用大家都能理解的方式解釋複雜的概念。
詞形變化: n.複數：brilliants | adj.比較級：more brilliant；最高級：most brilliant

例句: Nancy’s unique and interesting scientific ideas set her apart from the other students at this school.
翻譯: Nancy獨特且有趣的科學思維使她在這所學校與眾不同。

例句: At times, Sheila sings softly, bringing joy to the room with her beautiful melodies.
翻譯: 有時，Sheila會輕聲唱歌，用她美麗的旋律為房間帶來喜悅。

例句: The salesman provides more services for his clients because he is willing to go the extra mile for them.
翻譯: 這位銷售員為他的客戶提供更多服務，因為他願意為他們多做一點。

例句: As the population ages, there will be a growing demand for a younger workforce.
翻譯: 隨著人口老化，對年輕勞動力的需求將會日益增加。

例句: The company is investing in training programs to improve the skills of its workforce.
翻譯: 公司正在投資培訓計畫，以提升員工的技能。

例句: Environmental concerns have grown as more industrialized countries contribute to global pollution.
翻譯: 隨著更多工業化國家對全球汙染的影響增加，環境問題日益嚴峻。

例句: The small town has industrialized very quickly over the last decade. Many large factories have been set up during this period.
翻譯: 這個小鎮在過去十年間迅速工業化，期間設立了許多大型工廠。

例句: The dramatic shift in technology over the years has changed how students learn and communicate in class.
翻譯: 這些年來，技術的劇變改變了學生在課堂上的學習和交流方式。

例句: With full sun and rich soil, the plants in the garden are able to  flourish.
翻譯: 因為有充足的陽光和肥沃的土壤，花園裡的植物得以茁壯成長。

例句: Over the years, the once-popular fashion trend started to fade from the runways and street styles.
翻譯: 這幾年來，曾經流行的時尚趨勢逐漸從伸展臺和街頭風格中消退。
詞形變化: v.過去式：faded；過去分詞：faded；現在分詞：fading

例句: The bright red curtains began to fade after months of sunlight streaming through the windows.
翻譯: 經過幾個月的陽光透過窗戶照射，鮮紅色的窗簾開始褪色。
詞形變化: v.過去式：faded；過去分詞：faded；現在分詞：fading

例句: The local environmental group gained prominence after their successful campaign to clean up the river.
翻譯: 當地的環保團體在成功發起清理河川的活動後，聲譽日漸提升。

例句: Bach, the father of Western music, is widely recognized as one of the most prominent musicians in history.
翻譯: 巴哈，西方音樂之父，被公認為歷史上最具代表性的音樂家之一。

例句: The invention of the Internet has shaped a generation of students who enjoy online learning.
翻譯: 網際網路的發明塑造了一代喜愛線上學習的學生。

例句: Wayne hasn’t heard from his aunt for a decade. The last time he got a call from her was ten years ago.
翻譯: Wayne 已經有十年沒收到他姑姑的消息了。他最後一次接到姑姑的電話是在十年前。

例句: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential for maintaining  good physical health.
翻譯: 規律運動和均衡飲食對保持良好的身體健康至關重要。

例句: The dove has long been used to symbolize peace and harmony across cultures.
翻譯: 長久以來鴿子被用來象徵和平與和諧，跨越了不同文化界限。

例句: The ringing of bells at midnight is symbolic of the start of a new year.
翻譯: 午夜鐘聲象徵著新年開始。

例句: Life in rural areas is usually slower and quieter than that in big cities.
翻譯: 鄉村生活通常比大城市生活更為緩慢且寧靜。

例句: The university offers programs for students who want to specialize in AI.
翻譯: 這所大學為想要專攻人工智慧的學生提供相關課程。

例句: Sam’s specialty in the IT field is network security, which refers to protecting businesses from cyber threats.
翻譯: Sam 在資訊科技領域的專長是網路安全，這指的是保護企業免受網路威脅。

例句: After reviewing my essay, my teacher suggested I modify a few sentences to make them clearer.
翻譯: 在檢閱我的文章後，老師建議我修改幾個句子，使其更清晰。

例句: There was a sudden boom in online shopping during the holiday season.
翻譯: 在假期季節，線上購物突然間大幅增長。

例句: Online learning platforms boomed during the pandemic as schools shifted to remote education.
翻譯: 在疫情期間，隨著學校轉為遠距教學，線上學習平臺迅速崛起。

例句: After the invention of new technology, manufacturing processes became faster and more efficient.
翻譯: 在新技術發明後，製造過程變得更快速且更有效率。

例句: The company manufactures high-quality sneakers that are popular among athletes.
翻譯: 這家公司製造高品質的運動鞋，深受運動員喜愛。
字根: fac/fact (to do, to make (做、製造)); manu ((to make by) hand (手工))

例句: The manufacture of advanced electronic products requires precise engineering and high-quality materials.
翻譯: 先進電子產品的製造需要精確的工程技術和高品質的材料。
字根: fac/fact (to do, to make (做、製造)); manu ((to make by) hand (手工))

例句: As a leading manufacturer in the fashion industry, the company is known for its attractive and durable clothing.
翻譯: 作為時尚產業的領頭羊，該公司以其吸引人且耐穿的服飾聞名。

例句: The invention of the Internet marked the beginning of an era of rapid technological progress.
翻譯: 網際網路的發明標誌著快速科技進步時代的開始。

例句: The decrease in the number of patients is of great significance; it means that the spread of the flu is now under control.
翻譯: 病患人數的減少具有重要意義；這意味著流感的蔓延已經得到控制。

例句: The peace talks were very significant in improving the relationship between the two countries, leading them to stop fighting over their borders.
翻譯: 和平談判對改善兩國關係具有重大意義，使兩國停止邊界爭端。
詞形變化: n.複數：significants | adj.比較級：more significant；最高級：most significant

例句: During the summer break, Karen worked as an apprentice at a local bike repair shop to improve her mechanical skills.
翻譯: 在暑假期間，Karen 在當地的一家自行車修理店擔任學徒，藉此提升她的機械技能。

例句: Dissatisfied with her small eyes, Ms. Carter decided to undergo  double eyelid surgery to alter the appearance of her eyes.
翻譯: 對於自己小眼睛不滿意，Carter 女士決定接受雙眼皮手術，以改變眼睛的外觀。
詞形變化: v.過去式：altered；過去分詞：altered；現在分詞：altering

例句: The feedback from the survey will reflect customer satisfaction.
翻譯: 調查回饋將反映顧客的滿意度。

例句: The tall skyscrapers were magnificently reflected in the shiny glass windows of the nearby buildings.
翻譯: 高聳的摩天大樓在附近建築物光亮的玻璃窗中壯麗地倒映出來。

例句: The baker didn’t notice the flour on his cheek until he saw his reflection in the window.
翻譯: 烘焙師直到看見自己在窗戶中的倒影才注意到臉頰上的麵粉。

例句: Philip was in a reflective mood on New Year’s Eve, thinking about what he had gained and lost over the past year.
翻譯: 在除夕夜，Philip陷入沉思當中，回想過去一年自己獲得和失去的事物。

例句: The transition from high school to college is an important change in a student’s life.
翻譯: 從高中到大學的過渡是學生人生中重要的轉變。

例句: Please track the status of your order, as it is currently in transit.
翻譯: 請追蹤你的訂單狀態，因為訂單目前正在運送中。

例句: The travelers will transit through several stations before reaching their accommodations.
翻譯: 旅客們在抵達住宿地點之前，會經過數個車站。

例句: During the debate, we discussed which category each topic belonged to: social issues, environment, or technology.
翻譯: 在辯論期間，我們討論了每個議題屬於哪個類別：社會議題、環境或科技。

例句: For the science project, students had to categorize the different types of rocks they collected from the field trip.
翻譯: 針對此次的科學專題，學生們必須將從實地考察中蒐集到的不同種類的岩石進行分類。

例句: New trends arise in fashion every season, reflecting changes in style and culture.
翻譯: 每個季節，時尚中會出現新的趨勢，反映出風格和文化的變化。
詞形變化: v.過去式：arose；過去分詞：arisen；現在分詞：arising

例句: We are prepared to give up all the work we’ve done so far and start all over again, if the need arises.
翻譯: 如果有需要，我們已經準備好放棄迄今為止所做的所有工作，並重新開始。
詞形變化: v.過去式：arose；過去分詞：arisen；現在分詞：arising

例句: The old carpenter likes to craft beautiful wooden furniture by hand using traditional tools.
翻譯: 這位老木匠喜歡用傳統工具手工製作漂亮的木製家具。

例句: Learning the craft of pottery takes many years of practice and patience to master.
翻譯: 學習陶藝這項工藝需要多年的練習和耐心才能精通。
詞形變化: v.過去式：crafted；過去分詞：crafted；現在分詞：crafting | n.複數：crafts

例句: The film "Being a Craftsman" tells a touching story about a father and his son's relationship.
翻譯: 電影《我的黑手父親》講述了一個關於父親與兒子關係的感人故事。

例句: We rented a small trailer to carry our camping gear on our road trip last summer.
翻譯: 去年夏天我們租了一輛小拖車，用來在公路旅行中載運露營裝備。

例句: Many students hope to get a white-collar job in an office after they graduate from university.
翻譯: 許多學生希望大學畢業後能在辦公室找到一份白領工作。

例句: Blue-collar workers often perform manual labor, such as construction or factory work, which is essential for society.
翻譯: 藍領工人通常從事體力勞動，例如建築或工廠工作，這對社會至關重要。

例句: Many cities in developed countries are now considered post-industrial, focusing on services rather than manufacturing.
翻譯: 許多已開發國家的城市現在被視為後工業化的，專注於服務業而非製造業。

例句: Our science class offers a lot of hands-on experiments, which makes learning more fun and effective.
翻譯: 我們的自然科學課提供了許多實務操作的實驗，這讓學習更有趣、更有效。

例句: Addressing climate change requires not only technological solutions but also significant societal changes in our daily habits.
翻譯: 應對氣候變遷不僅需要科技解決方案，還需要我們日常習慣上重大的社會性改變。

例句: Please remember to update the software on your computer regularly to ensure it has the latest security features.
翻譯: 請記得定期更新你電腦上的軟體，以確保它擁有最新的安全功能。

例句: As a result of Eartha’s excellent performance in the competition, she was invited to join the national team.
翻譯: 由於Eartha在比賽中的優異表現，她獲邀加入國家隊。

例句: The online course took off when people realized it was an easy way to learn new skills from home.
翻譯: 當人們意識到這是一種在家輕鬆學習新技能的方式時，這門線上課程迅速受到歡迎。

例句: When you start out learning a new language, it’s helpful to practice basic phrases and vocabulary daily.
翻譯: 當你開始學習一門新語言時，每天練習基本的片語和詞彙會很有幫助。

例句: Since the pandemic, online learning tools and platforms have been in high demand among students and teachers.
翻譯: 自從疫情以來，學生和老師對線上學習工具和平臺的需求大增。

例句: Jeremy became a journalist to give a voice to those who are often unheard.
翻譯: Jeremy 成為一名記者，目的是為那些常被忽視的群體發聲。

例句: The doctor often shares her findings in medical journals to help people have a better understanding of the side effects of certain medicines.
翻譯: 這位醫生經常在醫學期刊上分享她的研究結果，以幫助人們更好地了解某些藥物的副作用。

例句: I have a couple of genuine friends who always support and encourage me whenever I get into trouble.
翻譯: 我有幾位真誠的朋友，每當我遇到困難時，他們總是支持和鼓勵我。
詞形變化: adj.比較級：more genuine；最高級：most genuine

例句: These bags are expensive because they are made of genuine leather.
翻譯: 這些包包很昂貴，因為它們是用真皮製成的。
詞形變化: adj.比較級：more genuine；最高級：most genuine

例句: The old and neglected library is filled with dusty shelves and torn books.
翻譯: 這座老舊且被忽視的圖書館裡，滿是布滿灰塵的書架和破爛的書本。

例句: Parents should never neglect spending quality time with their children to maintain healthy relationships.
翻譯: 父母絕不應忽視與孩子共度美好時光，以維持健康的親子關係。

例句: The neglect of the old car caused it to break down while being driven on the highway.
翻譯: 那輛舊車疏於保養，導致它在公路上行駛時拋錨。

例句: The misunderstood genius struggled to find acceptance in a world that failed to appreciate his intelligence.
翻譯: 這位被誤解的天才在一個無法欣賞他才華的世界中掙扎著尋找認同。

例句: Sometimes, written messages can be easily misunderstood because one can’t see the writer’s facial expressions.
翻譯: 有時候，書面訊息容易被誤解，因為無法看到寫信者的面部表情。

例句: The volunteers organize events to promote healthy eating at schools.
翻譯: 義工們在學校舉辦活動推廣健康飲食。

例句: The school organized a promotion for the upcoming dance to encourage more students to attend.
翻譯: 學校為即將舉行的舞會舉辦了宣傳活動，以鼓勵更多學生參加。

例句: Esther made an assumption about the test material, but it turned out to be different.
翻譯: Esther 對測驗內容做出了假設，但結果卻不一樣。

例句: Mr. Bush assumed that more than fifty people would attend his housewarming party, but only ten guests showed up.
翻譯: Bush 先生假設會有超過五十人參加他的喬遷派對，但實際上只有十位賓客出席。
詞形變化: v.過去式：assumed；過去分詞：assumed；現在分詞：assuming

例句: It's important to learn about age discrimination to understand how it affects people.
翻譯: 了解年齡歧視很重要，這有助於理解它如何影響人們。

例句: Donald learned to discriminate healthy foods from unhealthy snacks during his health education class at school.
翻譯: Donald 在學校的健康教育課程中學會了區分健康食品和不健康的零食。

例句: The transformation from a shy freshman to a confident senior is a common experience as students grow.
翻譯: 從一個害羞的大一新生到自信的大四生的轉變，是學生成長過程中常見的經歷。

例句: Sophia is known for her compassionate nature and willingness to help others.
翻譯: Sophia 以她富有同情心的個性和樂於助人的態度而聞名。

例句: Understanding someone's struggles with compassion can strengthen friendships.
翻譯: 理解他人的掙扎並以同情心對待，可以增進友誼。

例句: If you don't want to cook dinner, alternatively, you could order takeout from your favorite restaurant.
翻譯: 如果你不想做晚餐，你也可以選擇從你最喜歡的餐廳訂外賣。

例句: Some students prefer using alternative methods of studying, like group discussions, instead of reading alone.
翻譯: 有些學生偏好使用替代的學習方法，例如小組討論，而不是獨自閱讀。

例句: Remote work has become a popular alternative for employees seeking more freedom in their schedules.
翻譯: 遠端工作已成為尋求更多時間彈性的員工的熱門選擇。

例句: Wendy and her family decided to flee the crowded city for a weekend camping trip in the mountains.
翻譯: Wendy和她的家人決定逃離擁擠的城市，到山區露營度過週末。
詞形變化: v.過去式：fled；過去分詞：fled；現在分詞：fleeing

例句: The actress was given an award for her extraordinary contribution to the movie industry. She has starred in over 50 movies throughout her lifetime.
翻譯: 這位女演員因為對電影產業的卓越貢獻而獲得獎項。她一生中主演了超過 50 部電影。

例句: The scientist's remarkable discovery could change the way we understand the life sciences.
翻譯: 這位科學家的非凡發現可能改變我們對生命科學的理解方式。

例句: During the class discussion, Warner remarked on the significance of historical events.
翻譯: 在課堂討論中，Warner 評論了歷史事件的重要性。

例句: Students are taught to think before they speak, as making a casual remark might unintentionally hurt others.
翻譯: 學生被教導在發言前先思考，因為隨意的評論可能無意中傷害他人。

例句: The artist’s drawing gave us a glimpse of what the finished painting would look like.
翻譯: 這位藝術家的素描讓我們窺見了完成畫作的樣子。

例句: Reading regularly will undoubtedly expand your vocabulary and knowledge.
翻譯: 經常閱讀無疑會擴展你的詞彙量和知識。

例句: The confusion over the math problem dissolved once the teacher explained the concept in a different way.
翻譯: 當老師以不同的方式解釋概念後，數學問題的困惑便消除了。
詞形變化: v.過去式：dissolved；過去分詞：dissolved；現在分詞：dissolving | n.複數：dissolves

例句: The sugar cube dissolved quickly in the hot coffee.
翻譯: 方糖在熱咖啡中迅速溶解。
詞形變化: v.過去式：dissolved；過去分詞：dissolved；現在分詞：dissolving | n.複數：dissolves

例句: The coach plans to replace the injured player with someone else for the upcoming game.
翻譯: 教練計畫在即將到來的比賽中用其他人取代受傷的球員。

例句: The store offered a replacement skateboard for free when the one Kevin bought had a crack in it.
翻譯: 當Kevin購買的滑板出現裂縫時，商店提供了免費更換的滑板。

例句: The farmer started to sweat heavily when working in the hot sun.
翻譯: 農夫在烈日下工作時開始大汗淋漓。

例句: After a five-mile jog, Tim’s shirt was wet with sweat from the exercise.
翻譯: 經過五英里的慢跑後，Tim 的襯衫因運動而汗水淋漓。

例句: We were lucky to have such nice weather during the camping trip that we were able to lie beneath the stars and enjoy the beautiful night sky.
翻譯: 在露營旅行期間，我們很幸運有如此美好的天氣，得以躺在星空下，享受美麗的夜空。

例句: The club organized events to raise awareness about the challenges faced by people with physical disabilities.
翻譯: 這個俱樂部舉辦活動，提升人們對身心障礙者所面臨挑戰的認識。

例句: Learning about the experiences of immigrants broadens our understanding of different cultures.
翻譯: 了解移民的經歷能夠擴展我們對不同文化的理解。

例句: George’s family decided to immigrate to the United States for better job opportunities.
翻譯: George 的家人決定移民到美國，以尋找更好的工作機會。

例句: Candice decided to retire from professional basketball after playing for 15 years.
翻譯: Candice 在打了 15 年的職業籃球後，決定退休。
詞形變化: v.過去式：retired；過去分詞：retired；現在分詞：retiring

例句: After working for 30 years, Philip took early retirement and plans to travel around the world.
翻譯: Philip 工作了 30 年後，選擇了提前退休，並計畫環遊世界。

例句: My new smartphone worked well initially, but a week later it failed to ring when people called.
翻譯: 我的新智慧型手機一開始運作正常，但一週後，當人家打來時它竟然不會響。

例句: In the initial stages of this disease, patients lose the ability to control their movements as their muscles begin to weaken.
翻譯: 在這種疾病的初期階段，患者會失去控制動作的能力，因為肌肉開始變弱。

例句: Understanding social norms can prevent misunderstandings in friendships and interactions.
翻譯: 理解社會規範可以避免在友誼和互動中產生誤解。

例句: Ronni Abergel is known for his work in creating the "Human Library" concept, which promotes dialogue and understanding.
翻譯: 羅尼‧艾柏格以其創立「人類圖書館」概念而聞名，該概念旨在促進對話與理解。

例句: Developing empathy helps us understand other people's feelings and perspectives, which is important for building strong relationships.
翻譯: 培養同理心有助於我們理解他人的感受和觀點，這對於建立良好關係很重要。

例句: A good friend is often empathetic and tries to understand your feelings and experiences.
翻譯: 一個好朋友通常很有同感，並試圖理解你的感受和經歷。

例句: Anders Fransen is a researcher who studies how people learn and develop new skills in different environments.
翻譯: 安德斯‧弗蘭森是一位研究人們如何在不同環境中學習和發展新技能的研究員。

例句: Bryan Stevenson is a lawyer and social justice activist who works to help those unfairly treated by the legal system.
翻譯: 布萊恩‧史蒂文森是一位律師和社會正義活動家，致力於幫助那些受到法律體系不公平對待的人。

例句: Mister Rogers taught generations of children about kindness and understanding through his beloved television show.
翻譯: 羅傑斯先生透過他深受喜愛的電視節目，教導了幾代孩子關於善良和理解的道理。

例句: Learning about different careers helps us understand the various walks of life people choose.
翻譯: 了解不同的職業有助於我們理解人們選擇的各種人生道路。

例句: Nathan’s speech on environmental issues aims to awaken people to the importance of conservation.
翻譯: Nathan 關於環境議題的演講旨在使人們意識到保護環境的重要性。

例句: Good grades and active participation in clubs can help you stand out when applying to college.
翻譯: 優異的成績和積極參與社團活動有助於你在申請大學時脫穎而出。

例句: “Bang! Bang! Bang!”The sound of gunshots in the night made Donald feel terrified.
翻譯: 「砰！砰！砰！」夜裡的槍聲讓Donald感到害怕。

例句: Someone banged loudly on Lisa’s door last night, but she was too afraid to answer it because she lived alone.
翻譯: 昨晚有人重重地敲了Lisa的門，但她因為獨自一人，太害怕而沒有開門。

例句: “Carrot” is Anne’s nickname at school because of her red hair, and she takes it as an insult.
翻譯: 「Carrot」是Anne在學校的綽號，因為她有紅色頭髮，而她把這個綽號當作侮辱。

例句: Jack got drunk at the party and started insulting people. He made some very mean remarks to his co-workers.
翻譯: Jack在派對上喝醉後開始侮辱人。他對同事說了些非常刻薄的話。

例句: Emily’s parents grew concerned when they discovered their daughter staying up all night playing online games. They worried that she had become a video game addict.
翻譯: 當Emily的父母發現她整晚熬夜玩線上遊戲時，他們開始感到憂慮。他們擔心她已經變成了遊戲成癮者。

例句: Sophia drinks at least five cups of strong coffee every day. She seems to be addicted to caffeine.
翻譯: Sophia每天至少喝五杯濃咖啡，她似乎對咖啡因上癮了。

例句: Sherry often sits quietly, staring into space, lost in her own thoughts.
翻譯: Sherry經常靜靜地坐著，發呆陷入自己的思緒中。

例句: As the actor walked onto the stage, he was met with an intense stare from the audience.
翻譯: 當這位演員走上舞臺時，觀眾投以熱烈的注視。

例句: Emma strode confidently onto the stage with her head held high and her shoulders back.
翻譯: Emma 自信地走上舞臺，抬頭挺胸，步伐穩健。

例句: Michael Jordan was not only a superstar in the NBA but a mentor to many young basketball players worldwide.
翻譯: Michael Jordan不僅是NBA的超級巨星，還是全球許多年輕籃球員的心靈導師。
詞形變化: v.過去式：mentored；過去分詞：mentored；現在分詞：mentoring | n.複數：mentors

例句: Bombs were dropped over the war zone day after day, causing thousands of deaths and widespread damage.
翻譯: 一天又一天，炸彈在戰區上空投下，造成數千人死亡和大規模的破壞。

例句: The local residents were happy to know that this piece of land had been zoned for a new community park.
翻譯: 當地居民得知這塊土地被規劃為新社區公園時，感到非常高興。

例句: Isaac put his backpack and clothes in a locker before going swimming in the pool.
翻譯: Isaac在去游泳池游泳之前，將背包和衣物放進了置物櫃。

例句: Many tourists toss a coin into the water and make a wish when they visit the world-famous Trevi Fountain.
翻譯: 許多觀光客在參觀世界知名的特雷維噴泉時，會往水中投下一枚硬幣並許願。

例句: Since neither of the brothers wanted to do the dishes, their mom suggested they decide on a toss of a coin.
翻譯: 由於兩兄弟都不想洗碗，他們的媽媽建議用擲硬幣來決定。

例句: The coach took Toby aside and privately warned him not to be late for practice again.
翻譯: 教練把Toby叫到一旁，私下警告他不要再遲到練習。

例句: Yvonne sat under a tree reading a book, with her hair blowing lightly in the breeze.
翻譯: Yvonne 坐在樹下看書，微風輕輕吹拂著她的頭髮。

例句: As soon as the bell rang, our English teacher dismissed the class and breezed out of the classroom.
翻譯: 鐘聲一響，我們的英文老師便讓大家下課，輕鬆地走出教室。

例句: Vera’s parents have absolute confidence in her. They know she can take good care of herself when they are away.
翻譯: Vera 的父母對她有絕對的信心。他們知道她在他們不在時可以好好照顧自己。

例句: Because an accident involving many cars occurred during rush hour, the highway was in complete chaos.
翻譯: 因為在尖峰時刻發生了一起多車事故，公路陷入一片混亂。

例句: In the Olympic Games, athletes compete with outstanding rivals from around the world for medals.
翻譯: 在奧林匹克運動會中，運動員與來自世界各地的傑出對手爭奪獎牌。

例句: Despite fierce competition from a rival company, we have managed to increase our market share this year.
翻譯: 儘管面對來自競爭對手公司的激烈競爭，我們今年仍成功提高市場占有率。

例句: Having traveled to more than thirty countries around the world, Andrew thinks nothing rivals the Grand Canyon for the beauty of scenery.
翻譯: Andrew曾經走訪世界上三十多個國家，他認為沒有任何地方能比得上大峽谷的美麗景色。

例句: The teacher assigned each student to research a different topic for their presentation.
翻譯: 老師指派每位學生研究不同的主題來做報告。

中譯: (學業、工作方面的) 功課，任務
例句: The student received a low grade on her assignment because she didn’t follow the instructions.
翻譯: 這位學生因為沒有遵照指示完成作業，得到了低分。

例句: Instead of shouting calls, let’s take a moment to translate words into action.
翻譯: 與其大聲呼喊，不如花點時間將言語轉化為行動。

例句: The novel was written in English; now it has been translated into many languages.
翻譯: 這本小說是用英語寫的，現在已經被翻譯成多種語言。

例句: Nick is an American who is fascinated with Chinese literature. He has read the English translation of Journey to the West three times.
翻譯: Nick是一位對中國文學著迷的美國人。他已經讀過三次《西遊記》的英譯本。

例句: The trauma of the kitchen fire made Aunt Cathie afraid of cooking for years.
翻譯: 廚房火災的創傷讓Cathie阿姨多年來都不敢再煮飯。

例句: The sound of the mighty waterfall could be heard from miles away.
翻譯: 那道雄偉的瀑布聲音從數英里外就能聽見。

例句: According to legend, Arthur became king by pulling the magic sword from the stone.
翻譯: 根據傳說，亞瑟王是透過拔出石中的魔法劍成為國王的。

例句: After the doctors were sure that the patient had fully recovered from her illness, she was released from the hospital.
翻譯: 在醫生確定病人已經完全康復後，她被准許出院。

例句: The man has turned over a new leaf since his release from prison last year.
翻譯: 這名男子自從去年出獄以來，已經洗心革面。

例句: Seeing the news about the war, Emily couldn’t help but feel hatred for the country that had attacked innocent citizens.
翻譯: 看到有關戰爭的新聞，Emily不禁對那個攻擊無辜市民的國家感到憤恨。

例句: Bill’s dog is very aggressive and will bite strangers who come close to it.
翻譯: Bill的狗非常具有攻擊性，會咬靠近牠的陌生人。

例句: After years of personal growth and self-discovery, Ella has blossomed into a very attractive woman.
翻譯: 經過多年來的自我成長和發現，Ella已成長為一位非常有魅力的女性。

例句: With proper care and attention, the garden began to blossom in the spring.
翻譯: 在適當的照料和關注下，花園在春天開始綻放。

例句: The scent of cherry blossoms filled the air, signaling the arrival of spring.
翻譯: 櫻花的香氣瀰漫在空氣中，預示著春天的到來。

例句: Mr. Gibbon is a very strict teacher, so his students don’t dare to doze off during class.
翻譯: Gibbon老師是一位非常嚴厲的教師，因此他的學生在上課時不敢打瞌睡。

例句: The sudden sound of a gunshot in the distance made everyone in the quiet neighborhood feel very nervous.
翻譯: 遠處突然傳來的槍聲讓這個安靜社區裡的每個人都感到非常緊張。

例句: The school encouraged voluntary integration by organizing activities where students from different backgrounds could interact.
翻譯: 學校透過組織讓不同背景學生互動的活動，鼓勵自願融合。

例句: Participating in the school's environmental cleanup project is completely voluntary, but many students still choose to join.
翻譯: 參與學校的環境清潔計畫是完全自願的，但許多學生仍然選擇加入。

例句: If you study hard and prepare well for the exam, you will surely ace it and get a great score.
翻譯: 如果你努力學習並為考試做好充分準備，你一定會表現出色並取得好成績。

例句: Many high school students find it challenging but rewarding to read and analyze Shakespeare's plays in English class.
翻譯: 許多高中生覺得在英文課閱讀和分析莎士比亞的戲劇既具挑戰性又很有收穫。

例句: We learned about the Pythagorean theorem in math class today, which helps us calculate the sides of a right triangle.
翻譯: 我們今天在數學課上學了畢氏定理，它幫助我們計算直角三角形的邊長。

例句: It's important to empathize with people who are going through difficult times.
翻譯: 感同身受那些正在經歷困難時期的人是很重要的。

例句: Learning about the Holocaust in history class helps us understand the importance of tolerance and human rights.
翻譯: 在歷史課上學習猶太人大屠殺有助於我們理解寬容和人權的重要性。

例句: Anne Frank's diary provides a powerful and moving personal account of life during World War II.
翻譯: 安妮‧法蘭克的日記提供了二戰期間生活一個強大而感人的個人記述。

中譯: 毫無價值的，一無是處的
例句: Don't let anyone make you feel like you are good-for-nothing; everyone has unique talents and strengths.
翻譯: 不要讓任何人讓你覺得自己一無是處；每個人都有獨特的才能和優點。

例句: My younger brother is often a troublemaker in class, always talking when the teacher is speaking.
翻譯: 我弟弟在班上常常是個愛惹事生非的人，老師講話時他總是在說話。

例句: The firefighters sized up every inch of the scene in order to understand how the fire broke out.
翻譯: 消防員仔細檢查現場的每一個細節，以了解火災是如何發生的。

例句: Although Valentine’s Day is still a week away, Susanna already feels that love is in the air.
翻譯: 雖然情人節還有一週的時間，Susanna已經感覺到愛的氛圍在空氣中瀰漫。

例句: Since my sister got married and moved out, her piano has been collecting dust in our living room.
翻譯: 自從我妹妹結婚搬走後，她的鋼琴就一直在我們家的客廳裡積灰塵。

例句: The concept of the survival of the fittest applies not only to wild animals but also to the competitive world of professional sports, where only the top athletes succeed.
翻譯: 適者生存的概念不僅適用於野生動物，也適用於競爭激烈的職業運動世界，只有頂尖的運動員才能成功。

例句: We wanted to surprise Mom with a homemade cake, but it ended up being a disaster, and the kitchen was a total mess.
翻譯: 我們想自製蛋糕給媽媽一個驚喜，但結果卻是一場災難，廚房也變得一團亂。

例句: The online community provided a virtual space for people with similar interests to connect.
翻譯: 網路社群為擁有相似興趣的人提供了一個虛擬空間來互相連結。

例句: The theme park hired a diverse group of entertainers, including street performers, character actors, and magicians.
翻譯: 主題樂園聘請了一群多元化的表演者，包括街頭藝人、角色演員和魔術師。

例句: The museum exhibit entertained the children with interactive displays about dinosaurs.
翻譯: 博物館的展覽透過互動式的恐龍展吸引了孩子們。

例句: Amy organized a variety of entertainment activities for the party, including games and music.
翻譯: Amy為派對策劃了各種娛樂活動，包括遊戲和音樂。

例句: Social media influencers often utilize hashtags to increase the visibility of their content.
翻譯: 社群媒體影響者常常使用標籤來提高他們內容的曝光度。

例句: The content of the graduation speech deeply moved the students, encouraging them to take positive action in their future.
翻譯: 畢業演講的內容深深感動了學生，鼓勵他們在未來採取積極的行動。

例句: Tony carefully examined the contents of the box before packing it and sending it off to his client.
翻譯: Tony 在打包並寄送給客戶之前，仔細檢查箱子裡的內容物。

例句: The director thanked the viewers for their continued support over the years.
翻譯: 導演感謝觀眾多年來的持續支持。

例句: The historical event marked a notable turning point in the country’s development.
翻譯: 這個歷史事件標誌著該國發展中的一個關鍵時刻。

例句: Social media influencers often use hashtags to help their posts grow in popularity.
翻譯: 社交媒體網紅經常使用標籤來幫助他們的貼文增加人氣。

例句: The children excitedly gathered food and water for a little adventure in the forest behind the village where they lived.
翻譯: 孩子們興奮地收集食物和水，準備去他們所居住的村莊後面的森林展開一場小冒險。
詞形變化: v.過去式：adventured；過去分詞：adventured；現在分詞：adventuring | n.複數：adventures

例句: The travel guide contains many frequently used English expressions, which can be helpful when you travel abroad.
翻譯: 這本旅遊指南包含了許多常用的英語表達，對於出國旅行時非常有幫助。

例句: Wilbert is a frequent visitor to the museum. He goes there at least twice a month.
翻譯: Wilbert是博物館的常客，他每個月至少去那裡兩次。

例句: The doctor inquired about the frequency of my headaches to determine the cause.
翻譯: 醫生詢問了我頭痛的頻率，以便確定病因。

中譯: 持續不斷的，經常發生的
例句: Whenever I go on a business trip overseas, I keep in constant contact with my family.
翻譯: 每次出國出差時，我都會與家人保持密切聯繫。

例句: I am a subscriber to a monthly book club that sends me new reads every month.
翻譯: 我訂閱了一個每月書籍俱樂部，每個月會寄給我新的書籍。

例句: John decided to subscribe to an online fitness program to help him stay motivated and active.
翻譯: John決定訂閱一個線上健身計畫，以幫助他保持動力和活力。

例句: The brand debuted a new marketing campaign, aiming to capture the attention of their target audience.
翻譯: 這個品牌推出全新的行銷活動，目的是吸引目標觀眾的注意。

例句: The talented singer made her debut on the popular talent show and became a superstar overnight.
翻譯: 這位才華橫溢的歌手在熱門的選秀節目中首度亮相，並一夜成為超級巨星。

中譯: 不斷變化的，不斷發展的
例句: The dynamic nature of technology requires us to adapt to rapid development.
翻譯: 科技的動態特性要求我們適應快速發展。

例句: Sally is always dynamic and full of brilliant ideas, which makes her an ideal leader.
翻譯: Sally 總是充滿活力且擁有絕妙的點子，這使她成為理想的領袖。

例句: Victor and Samuel have been close friends since they were in kindergarten. There is a solid bond between them.
翻譯: Victor和Samuel從幼稚園開始就成為摯友，彼此間有著深厚的友誼。

例句: By using glue, Paul bonded the broken piece back to the plate.
翻譯: Paul用膠水將破碎的部分黏回盤子上。

例句: In this online learning program, viewers can leave comments below to share their thoughts with others.
翻譯: 在這個線上學習平臺上，觀眾可以在下面留言與他人分享自己的想法。

例句: Yesterday, Penny’s parents kept commenting on her clothes, thinking they weren’t suitable for a job interview.
翻譯: 昨天，Penny的父母不停評論她的衣服，認為這些衣服不適合面試。

例句: Tom and Sheldon haven’t seen each other for a year, so they have planned to meet at a restaurant on the weekend to have a long chat.
翻譯: Tom 和 Sheldon 已經一年沒見面了，所以他們計畫週末在餐廳見面，聊聊近況。

例句: Every evening, Andrew enjoys chatting with his sister to share his stories of the day.
翻譯: 每晚 Andrew 都喜歡和他的妹妹聊天，分享他一天的故事。

例句: Studying in the UK by myself, I missed the companionship of my friends in my hometown.
翻譯: 在英國獨自讀書時，我很想念家鄉朋友的陪伴。

例句: A good traveling companion makes long journeys more enjoyable and memorable.
翻譯: 一位好的旅伴能讓長途旅行變得更加愉快且難忘。

例句: Allie has been a loyal worker. She has been in this company for almost 30 years.
翻譯: Allie 是一位忠誠的員工，她在這家公司工作已經將近 30 年了。

例句: The knights swore their loyalty to the king.
翻譯: 騎士們向國王宣誓效忠。

例句: Online education provides greater accessibility to learning resources for students around the world.
翻譯: 線上教育為全球學生提供了更多學習資源的可及性。

例句: The public transportation system should be accessible to commuters with disabilities.
翻譯: 公共交通系統應該為身有殘疾的通勤者提供無障礙服務。

例句: To study abroad next year, Penny has been applying for a student visa.
翻譯: 為了明年出國留學，Penny 一直在申請學生簽證。
詞形變化: v.過去式：visaed；過去分詞：visaed；現在分詞：visaing | n.複數：visas

例句: Once James received the notification from the shopping website, he ran to the convenience store to pick up his package.
翻譯: 一收到購物網站的通知，James 馬上跑到便利商店領取包裹。

例句: Before any major events, this elementary school will send notifications to both students and their parents.
翻譯: 在任何重大活動之前，這所小學會發送通知給學生和家長。

例句: When Kent was notified that he got the job at the company, he danced around happily and then told all his friends.
翻譯: 當 Kent 收到通知說他獲得公司的工作後，他高興地手舞足蹈，然後告訴所有的朋友。

例句: The traffic policeman stood at the busy intersection, raising his arm to signal drivers to stop.
翻譯: 交通警察站在繁忙的路口，舉起手臂示意駕駛人停車。

例句: The student’s presentation was too long, so the professor gave a signal hinting that he should finish it quickly.
翻譯: 學生的報告時間太長，因此教授給個暗示，示意他應盡快結束。

例句: In the debate course today, two parties had a lively debate about whether students should wear uniforms or not.
翻譯: 今天的辯論課上，雙方就學生是否應該穿制服進行激烈的辯論。

例句: The lively boys kept running around in the playground without ever stopping to take a rest.
翻譯: 那群活潑的男孩在操場上不停地跑來跑去，從不停下來休息。

例句: The Great Wall of China spans various landscapes, including mountains and deserts.
翻譯: 長城跨越各種地形，包括山脈和沙漠。

例句: The Chinese New Year Holidays span a week. Many people go back home to reunite with family members they haven’t seen all year.
翻譯: 農曆新年假期長達一週，許多人會回家與一年來未見的家人團聚。

例句: Over the span of two decades, Jessica grew from a little girl to a beautiful lady.
翻譯: 在二十年的時間裡，Jessica 從小女孩成長為美麗的女子。

例句: There are many creatures and plants living healthily in this pond. Human beings should not break this ecosystem.
翻譯: 這個池塘裡有許多生物和植物健康地生長。人類不應破壞這個生態系統。

例句: The amusement park felt like a true wonderland with all its colorful rides and exciting shows.
翻譯: 這座遊樂園有著繽紛的遊樂設施和精彩的表演，感覺就像一個真正的仙境。

例句: Many teenagers enjoy watching a Vtuber who uses an animated avatar to interact with their audience online.
翻譯: 許多青少年喜歡觀看虛擬YouTuber，他們使用動畫虛擬形象在線上與觀眾互動。

例句: My dream is to become a successful YouTuber and share my travel experiences with people around the world.
翻譯: 我的夢想是成為一名成功的YouTuber，並與世界各地的人分享我的旅行經驗。

例句: In many online games, players can customize their avatar to look exactly how they want it to be.
翻譯: 在許多線上遊戲中，玩家可以自訂他們的虛擬形象，讓它看起來完全符合他們想要的樣子。

例句: Kizuna AI is considered one of the pioneers in the world of virtual YouTubers, gaining massive popularity worldwide.
翻譯: 絆愛被認為是虛擬YouTuber世界的先驅之一，在全球範圍內獲得了巨大的人氣。

例句: The magician's performance was so captivating that the audience couldn't take their eyes off the stage.
翻譯: 魔術師的表演如此引人入勝，讓觀眾的目光無法從舞台上移開。

例句: Many students enjoy watching anime series after school because of their unique art style and interesting stories.
翻譯: 許多學生放學後喜歡看動漫系列，因為它們獨特的藝術風格和有趣的故事。

例句: Vox Akuma is a popular male Vtuber known for his deep voice and engaging personality during live streams.
翻譯: Vox Akuma 是一位受歡迎的男性虛擬YouTuber，以其低沉的嗓音和在直播中引人入勝的個性而聞名。

例句: In many ancient legends, a powerful demon often tries to trick humans into doing bad things.
翻譯: 在許多古老的傳說中，強大的惡魔經常試圖誘騙人類去做壞事。

例句: My favorite gamer hosts a live stream every Friday night where he plays new video games and chats with fans.
翻譯: 我最喜歡的遊戲玩家每週五晚上都會進行直播，玩新的電玩遊戲並與粉絲聊天。

例句: After working a whole day, Zack likes to hang out with his friends to relax for a while.
翻譯: 工作一整天後，Zack 喜歡和朋友們出去放鬆一下。

例句: Since Elsa was informed that she had won the chance to meet her favorite author in person, she has been looking forward to it every day.
翻譯: 自從 Elsa 得知她贏得與最喜愛的作家見面的機會後，她每天都在期待著這個時刻。

例句: Nuclear weapons are so powerful that they could even lead to the end of civilization.
翻譯: 核子武器的威力是如此強大，它甚至可能導致文明的終結。

例句: While nuclear energy is one of the sources of electricity, other sources like solar and wind power are preferred because they are more environmentally friendly.
翻譯: 雖然核能是電力來源之一，太陽能和風能等其他能源更受青睞，因為它們更加環境友善。

例句: The child established a reputation as a musical genius after playing the piano perfectly at a concert.
翻譯: 這個孩子在音樂會上完美演奏鋼琴後，建立了音樂天才的名聲。

例句: Mozart started showing unusual musical talent at a very young age, and many of his compositions were seen as works of genius.
翻譯: 莫札特在年幼時就展現出非凡的音樂天賦，許多他的作品被視為天才之作。

例句: In terms of efficiency, an atomic power plant is better than other sources of electricity generation.
翻譯: 就效率而言，原子能發電廠比其他發電方式更好。

例句: In this science project, the teacher asked students to study the behavior of an oxygen atom in different chemical reactions.
翻譯: 在這個科學專題中，老師要求學生研究氧原子在不同化學反應中的行為。

例句: While filming this movie, the director demanded that safety experts be on set to make sure the actors didn’t get hurt when the bomb went off.
翻譯: 在拍攝這部電影時，導演要求安全專家到場，以確保爆破時演員不會受傷。

例句: According to the news report, a suspect was arrested for threatening to bomb a train station.
翻譯: 根據新聞報導，一名嫌疑犯因威脅要炸毀火車站而被逮捕。

例句: The invasion of the country caused widespread panic among the citizens.
翻譯: 該國的入侵在民眾之間引起了廣泛的恐慌。

例句: Historical records show how the Roman Empire sought to invade countries across Europe.
翻譯: 歷史記載顯示羅馬帝國如何試圖入侵其歐洲各國。
詞形變化: v.過去式：invaded；過去分詞：invaded；現在分詞：invading

例句: After reading about the horrors of war, Elsa had deep sympathy for those affected by the conflict.
翻譯: 閱讀了關於戰爭的恐怖後，Elsa對受衝突影響的人們深感同情。

例句: The horror of the accident left the witnesses speechless.
翻譯: 這場事故的恐怖讓目擊者驚恐地啞口無言。

例句: This book focuses on nineteenth-century British history and documents the lives of people living in Britain at that time.
翻譯: 這本書聚焦於十九世紀的英國歷史，記錄當時英國人民的生活。

例句: The identity card serves as an official document that records a person’s information, including the name and date of birth.
翻譯: 身分證作為正式文件，記載個人資訊，包括姓名和出生日期。

例句: Before airplanes were invented, traveling great distances was difficult and time-consuming.
翻譯: 在飛機發明之前，長途旅行既困難又耗時。

例句: The invention of smartphones has made a huge impact on how modern people live their lives.
翻譯: 智慧型手機的發明對現代人的生活方式產生了巨大的影響。

例句: Since the Internet has changed the way people communicate, it is considered to be a great invention.
翻譯: 由於網際網路改變人們溝通的方式，它被認為是一項偉大的發明。

例句: Steve Jobs was an inventor of devices that completely changed how we communicate and listen to music.
翻譯: 史蒂夫．賈伯斯是改變我們溝通和聆聽音樂方式的裝置發明者。

例句: The guards protecting the president of the country are well-trained and armed with weapons.
翻譯: 保護該國總統的警衛受過良好的訓練，並且配備武器。

例句: The tension in the classroom was high before the important exam.
翻譯: 在重要考試前，教室裡的緊張氣氛高漲。
詞形變化: v.過去式：tensioned；過去分詞：tensioned；現在分詞：tensioning | n.複數：tensions

例句: The atmosphere was tense during the final minutes of the soccer game.
翻譯: 在足球賽的最後幾分鐘，氣氛十分緊張。

例句: Despite John’s fatigue, he continued to wrestle with the complex math problem until he found a solution.
翻譯: 儘管John感到疲憊，他仍繼續解決複雜的數學問題，直到他找到答案。

例句: The view from the top of the mountain was stunning, and many visitors were fascinated by it.
翻譯: 山頂的景色令人驚嘆，許多遊客都為之著迷。

例句: The magician’s final trick stunned the entire audience.
翻譯: 魔術師的最後一個把戲讓全場觀眾驚訝不已。
詞形變化: v.過去式：stunned；過去分詞：stunned；現在分詞：stunning

例句: This communication app allows users to leave an audio message, which is very convenient, especially for visually impaired people.
翻譯: 這款通訊應用程式允許用戶留下語音訊息，這非常方便，尤其對視障人士來說。

例句: As a wedding photographer, Niki’s job is to capture the important moments for each couple at their wedding.
翻譯: 身為一位婚禮攝影師，Niki的工作是為每對新人的婚禮捕捉重要時刻。

例句: The prisoner was quickly captured after escaping from jail, which was a relief for the local people.
翻譯: 這名囚犯在逃獄後迅速被捕，這讓當地居民鬆了一口氣。

例句: To escape capture, the thief had plastic surgery to change his appearance.
翻譯: 為了逃避抓捕，該名竊賊整形以改變自己的外貌。

例句: The debate over the best pizza topping often boils down to subjective opinions, with each person championing their favorites.
翻譯: 有關最佳披薩配料的辯論往往歸結於主觀意見，每個人都會推崇自己最喜愛的配料。

例句: The use of animals in experiments is an ethical issue, and there is a growing trend against it.
翻譯: 在實驗中使用動物是一個倫理問題，反對這種做法的趨勢逐漸增加。

例句: The film portrays a brave and selfless hero fighting against evil.
翻譯: 這部電影描繪一位勇敢且無私的英雄，與邪惡勢力對抗。

例句: Although the explosion took place miles away, everyone was shocked by how loud it was.
翻譯: 儘管爆炸發生在幾英里外，每個人都對它的巨大聲響感到震驚。

例句: The fireworks display featured several explosive bursts that lit up the night sky.
翻譯: 煙火表演中有幾次爆炸性的綻放，照亮了夜空。

例句: The chef warned that the pressure cooker could explode if not used correctly.
翻譯: 廚師警告，如果壓力鍋使用不當可能會爆炸。

例句: David liked to quote a line from famous philosophers in his speeches.
翻譯: David喜歡在他的演講中引用著名哲學家的名言。

例句: “You must be the change you wish to see in the world,” is one of Gandhi’s most famous quotes.
翻譯: 「你必須成為你希望看到的改變」，是甘地最著名的名言之一。

例句: Tom never stays up late because he knows this behavior is a destroyer of good health.
翻譯: Tom從不熬夜，因為他知道這種行為對健康有毀滅性的影響。

例句: All of the mountain trails were destroyed by the typhoon, so there is no way to reach the top now.
翻譯: 所有的山徑都被颱風摧毀了，因此現在無法到達山頂。

例句: The destruction of any house made of wood is certain if white ants are not found in time.
翻譯: 如果沒有及時發現白蟻，任何木製房屋的毀壞都是必然的。

例句: The realization that Kelvin had won the lottery left him at a loss for words.
翻譯: Kelvin意識到自己中獎後，感到無言以對。

例句: The book had a profound impact on Tina’s understanding of history.
翻譯: 這本書對Tina關於歷史的理解有深遠的影響。

例句: The profound beauty of the landscape took everyone’s breath away.
翻譯: 風景的極致之美讓所有人感到驚嘆。

例句: The consequences of climate change affected populations living in low-lying areas.
翻譯: 氣候變遷的結果影響了生活在低窪地區的人口。

例句: Cathy wove her personal experience into her novel, and it added a lot of color to her writing.
翻譯: Cathy將她的個人經歷編進她的小說中，為她的寫作增添了許多色彩。

例句: This beautiful carpet is not machine-made. It was woven by Carla’s grandmother.
翻譯: 這條美麗的地毯不是機器製造的。它是Carla的祖母親手編織的。

例句: This handmade sweater has a tight weave, so it is warm and durable.
翻譯: 這件手工毛衣的編織緊密，因此保暖且耐用。

例句: There was a renewed interest in traditional crafts, leading to more workshops.
翻譯: 人們對傳統工藝重新產生興趣，造成更多工作坊的開設。

例句: The city council approved a project to renew the old park and add new playground equipment.
翻譯: 市議會批准了一個項目，以翻新舊公園並增設新的遊樂設施。
詞形變化: v.過去式：renewed；過去分詞：renewed；現在分詞：renewing

例句: The increasing number of wildfires has severe implications for the animals which live in the forests.
翻譯: 不斷增加的森林野火對生活在森林中的動物造成了嚴重的影響。

例句: J. Robert Oppenheimer was a brilliant physicist who led the scientific efforts of the Manhattan Project during World War II.
翻譯: 羅伯特·奧本海默是一位傑出的物理學家，在第二次世界大戰期間領導了曼哈頓計畫的科學工作。

例句: Ukraine is a large country in Eastern Europe known for its rich history and beautiful cultural traditions.
翻譯: 烏克蘭是東歐一個大國，以其豐富的歷史和美麗的文化傳統而聞名。

例句: Christopher Nolan is a renowned film director famous for his complex narratives and visually stunning movies like "Inception."
翻譯: 克里斯多福·諾蘭是一位著名的電影導演，以其複雜的敘事和視覺震撼的電影（如《全面啟動》）而聞名。

例句: Cillian Murphy delivered a powerful performance as the lead character in the critically acclaimed movie "Oppenheimer."
翻譯: 席尼·墨菲在備受好評的電影《奧本海默》中飾演主角，表現出色。

例句: The Manhattan Project was a secret research and development undertaking during World War II that produced the first nuclear weapons.
翻譯: 曼哈頓計畫是第二次世界大戰期間一項秘密的研發計畫，旨在製造出第一批核武器。

例句: The documentary showed how the Nazis rose to power in Germany before the start of World War II.
翻譯: 這部紀錄片展示了納粹黨在第二次世界大戰爆發前如何在德國掌權。

例句: Hiroshima is a city in Japan that tragically became the first target of an atomic bomb in August 1945.
翻譯: 廣島是日本的一個城市，在1945年8月不幸成為原子彈的第一個目標。

例句: Just three days after Hiroshima, Nagasaki also suffered the devastating impact of a second atomic bomb during World War II.
翻譯: 在廣島之後僅三天，長崎也在第二次世界大戰期間遭受了第二枚原子彈的毀滅性衝擊。

例句: Many Hindu festivals are celebrated with vibrant colors, traditional music, and delicious food throughout India.
翻譯: 印度各地會以鮮豔的色彩、傳統音樂和美味的食物來慶祝許多印度教節日。

例句: Many people find comfort and wisdom by reading ancient scripture from their religious traditions.
翻譯: 許多人透過閱讀他們宗教傳統中的古老經文來尋求慰藉和智慧。

例句: Jimmy has experienced many twists and turns in his life, which have led him to better appreciate the present rather than focus on the past or future.
翻譯: Jimmy的人生經歷了千迴百轉，這使他更能把握當下，而不是專注於過去或未來。

例句: Worries about money hung over Leonard as he had just lost his job and didn’t know how he could pay his rent.
翻譯: Leonard對金錢的擔憂在心中揮之不去，因為他剛失去工作，不知道該如何支付他的租金。

例句: The musician closed his eyes, focusing his entire perception on the subtle changes in sound.
翻譯: 音樂家閉上雙眼，將所有感知集中在音調的微妙變化上。

例句: The artist challenged traditional perceptions of beauty with her unconventional work.
翻譯: 這位藝術家用她不同尋常的作品挑戰了人們對美的傳統觀念。

例句: New technology is perceived to be a threat to many people’s jobs in the near future.
翻譯: 新技術被認為在不久的將來會對許多人的工作構成威脅。

例句: During the magic show, the magician invited an audience member to draw a random card from the pile.
翻譯: 在魔術表演中，魔術師邀請一位觀眾從一疊牌卡中隨機抽出一張。

例句: The chef attributes the delicious flavor of the dish to the use of fresh, high-quality ingredients. She says if she used other ingredients, the dish would taste totally different.
翻譯: 這位廚師將這道菜的美味歸因於其使用的新鮮、高品質食材。她說如果使用其他食材，這道菜嚐起來會完全不同。
詞形變化: v.過去式：attributed；過去分詞：attributed；現在分詞：attributing | n.複數：attributes

例句: How ancient Egyptians built the pyramids is one of the great mysteries. People are not sure how they moved such large stones.
翻譯: 古埃及人如何建造金字塔是最偉大的謎團之一。人們仍不確定他們是如何搬運這些巨大的石塊的。

例句: Amanda received a mysterious letter in the mail with no return address.
翻譯: Amanda收到了一封沒有回郵地址的神祕信件。

例句: A person’s eating habits can provide clues about their body shape. Those who eat slowly tend to be slimmer than those who eat fast.
翻譯: 一個人的飲食習慣可以提供關於身形的線索。那些吃得慢的人通常比吃得快的人苗條。
詞形變化: v.過去式：clued；過去分詞：clued；現在分詞：cluing | n.複數：clues

例句: The police are asking witnesses to offer any information or clues to help solve the bank robbery.
翻譯: 警方正在呼籲目擊者提供任何資訊或線索，以幫助他們破解這起銀行搶案。
詞形變化: v.過去式：clued；過去分詞：clued；現在分詞：cluing | n.複數：clues

例句: In a cinema, anyone who stands and blocks the projector would cast a shadow on the screen.
翻譯: 在電影院裡，任何站著並遮擋放映機的人都會在螢幕上投下陰影。

例句: The police have been shadowing the suspect for a month, trying to gather information to find out if he was involved in the crime.
翻譯: 警方已經尾隨嫌疑人一個月，試圖收集證據以確定他是否涉及犯罪。

例句: The restaurant draws customers from many surrounding areas.
翻譯: 這家餐廳吸引了來自許多周邊地區的顧客。

例句: Chameleons blend in with their surroundings so effectively that they are challenging to spot.
翻譯: 變色龍能與周圍環境完美地融為一體，因此非常難以被發現。

例句: The castle is surrounded by a high stone wall for protection.
翻譯: 城堡被高大的石牆圍繞，以提供保護。
詞形變化: v.過去式：surrounded；過去分詞：surrounded；現在分詞：surrounding | n.複數：surrounds

例句: The beauty of literature and artwork is that they are open to interpretation. Everyone can view the same piece but experience different emotions.
翻譯: 文學與藝術作品的美在於其解釋的開放性，每個人對同一件作品的情感體驗都不同。
